data.value: Enkolagana ey'okwesalirawo: goberera Connect API oluvannyuma lw'okuteekawo n'okutandika okuweereza. Synix ebikozesebwa bikyagenda mu maaso nga tebirina kabonero.

data.name: Satisfactory.StartFirst
data.value: Tandika ku server eyateekebwawo ne Synix, oluvannyuma ogiggyeko mu Satisfactory s in-game Server Manager. Ddayo wano okugatta API.

data.name: Satisfactory.ConnectedHint
data.value: API ekwataganyizibwa ne {0}. Okuzza obuggya okusobola okufuna obubaka obwesigika.

data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Emalirizza okuteekawo okusooka mu Satisfactory s Server Manager n'okusigala ng'omuddugavu atambulira ku -NewConsole.
Kukuba wansi. Synix asindika ekiragiro, asoma akabonero akapya, akakkirize, era n'akikuuma mu ngeri ey'obukuumi. Tewali kikoppolo oba kukusa.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.AmbiguousToken
data.value: Ekitebe ky'okuwummuliramu kyazzaayo obubonero obw'enjawulo. Tewabaddewo nkolagana yonna.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: Synix tasobola kuyingira mu kasolya k'omuddugavu aka Unreal. Tandika ne -NewConsole era kozesa eddembe lya Windows limu ku Synix ne server.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Ekiragiro kyasindikibwa, naye Synix teyasobola kusoma kabonero akapya okuva ku server eno. Gezaako okukakasa nti olupapula luddamu n'ennukuta ze ziyinza okuwandiikibwa. Enkolagana yonna eyateekebwawo yasibiddwa; Ekiragiro tekyaddamu.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: Ekitebe tekiddamu oba waliwo akakwate akaliko. Linda, oluvannyuma gezaako nate. Ekiragiro tekikoma kuddamu kukozesa bbanga lyonna.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Kino kiwa Synix omulabirizi okuyingira. Token eno efunyebwa ku akaawunti yo ya Windows era teriggibwa mu by'okuteekawo emizannyo oba mu nsonga z'okutandika. Satisfactory ebikulaga mu kyuma kye n'ennukuta ze; Weeyongere okukuuma ebintu ebyo nga bifiiriddwa. Okuggyawo ekikwataganyizibwa ekyateekebwawo tekivvuunula kabonero.

data.name: Satisfactory.SecurityHelp
data.value: Oluvannyuma lw'okuteeka mu Satisfactory, ntandika okuweereza nga -NewConsole. Mu Synix: Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API → Connect automatically. Enkolagana eno ey'okwesalirawo teyeesobola kuziyiza buyinza bw'abaweereza.

data.value: Weeyongere okuyita mu Control Center oluvannyuma lw'okuteekamu

data.value: Fulumya okusomanga ebisaanyizo ebyesigamiziddwa ku mudduukirizi ono. Yiga ebisaanyizo, oluvannyuma okole enkyukakyuka zo zokka. Ebintu eby'omuzannyo n'ebisaanyizo bikyali mu Lungereza. Ebitundu ebikyaliwo biyinza okwetaagisa okuddamu okutandika Synix.

data.value: Okuzza obuggya ku lukalala lw'ebikozesebwa by'obuwagizi. Okusooka okusitula kuggulawo akadde akaliko. Ebintu ebikubibwa tebitwalibwa mu butanwa. Ebitabo ebikuumibwa n'amannya g'emirimu tegakyusibwa.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Okutandika Amangu 1. Yingira erinnya ly'omuzannyo n'ennamba Steam Server AppID. 2. Yingira ekkubo ly'omuddugavu erisobola okukolebwa ku bikwata ku fayiro y'omuddugavu eyateekebwawo. 3. Yingira ekiragiro kyokka ekijja oluvannyuma lw'ekizikiza. Kozesa tag eziri wansi w'ebigambo nga Synix erina okuteeka enkola y'omukozesa. 4. Londa engeri omuzannyo gye gufunamu fayiro y'okuteekawo. Enkola ey'okulabirira efuna fayiro ey'okuteeka mu nkola yonna, so si ekyokulabirako ekimu. 5. Londa Validate & Preview. Yamba buli kizibu ekiragiddwa nga tonnasalawo kukyusa. 6. Ssaawo, yaddamu okuzimba Synix, genda mu kugezesa okw'amaanyi, oluvannyuma gezaako okuteekawo/okutandika/okuyimiriza/okukebera omuzannyo.
EBIKABWA • Erinnya ly'omuzannyo: erinnya abakozesa lye balaba mu Synix. • ID ey'okutegeeza: ID ey'enjawulo ey'ebitundu ebitonotono; Synix ekola okuva mu linnya ly'omuzannyo gy'oli. • Steam AppID: AppID eya server ey'enjawulo, so si bulijjo AppID y'omuzannyi. • SteamCMD app configuration: empisa ezisinga okuba nga tezimala. Emizannyo egya GoldSrc AppID 90 egigabanyizibwako ekozesa fomu "90 mod folder", gamba nga "90 mod cstrike". Synix ekkiriza fomu eno yokka ey'obukuumi. • Ekinaakolebwa: ng'ekyokulabirako Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Tewaaliwo fayiro ey'okuteeka. • Ebibuga: ebibuga eby'omuzannyo n'ebibuga eby'okunoonyereza ebikakasibwa. • Kaadi n'engeri z'omuzannyo: Yiga omuwendo gumu ogw'omuzannyo buli mutendera. Bino bifulumya eby'okulonda ebiragibwa nga bitonda oba nga biggyawo.
EKY'OKUTONDA Toyingiranga mu kizimbe ekyo kennyini. Kwata bendera z'omuzannyo ng'ebyawandiikibwa ebisanja era weeteeke ebibala byokka ku muwendo oguli wansi wa Synix. Ekyokulabirako: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
EBIKWANNYUMA EBIGATIBWA [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Ssa {rcon} mu nsonga z'okufulumya nga ekiragiro RCON eky'okwesalirawo kizingiramu. Mu RCON syntax, kozesa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Ekyokulabirako RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
OBWENYUFU bw'Ebintu • Tebakyakakasibwa: Synix terina fayiro y'okuteeka mu nkola. • Omuzannyo gubaawo oluvannyuma lw'okutandika: kozesa enkola ey'okutegeka n'okuddaabiriza ng'essomero. • Synix eyatonda okuva mu template: Synix essaako enkola yonna nga tennaba kutandika. • Okutandika ensonga zokka: omuzannyo tegwetaaga kuteekawo buyinza ku nteekateeka zino.
EBIGAMBO BY'EKITUNDU {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} awandiika omuwendo gwa nnamaddala gw'ennyinnyonnyola ng'ekigambo ky'omuddugavu kiriwo n'omuwendo gwaakyo ogw'obulimba ng'ekigambo ky'omuddugavu temuli. Kozesa Yongera ku fayiro z'entegeka ng'omuddugavu yeetaaga fayiro ezisingawo. Londa buli fayiro y'ensibuko yonna, oluvannyuma olonde ekifo kyayo ekikuumiddwa mu ntebe esobole okuba nga kikwata ku folder ya server. Synix ekakasa buli fayiro eyogerwako wamu, n'egatta, n'ewandiika, n'ekyuusa.
AMAFIRIMU G'OBUGIBWA AGASATULWA BY'OLUBA Yingira ekkubo limu ery'obukuumi buli mutendera, okusinziira ku fayiro ya server eyateekebwawo. Ebiwandiiko ebisaanyizo biziyiza okutandika okutuusa kati; fayiro ez'okwesalirawo zifulumizibwa bwe zizuulibwa naye tezilemesa kutandika. Bwe kiba nti fayiro ze weetaaga ziva mu mizannyo egy'akabonero, bannyonnyole buli kkubo omukozesa ly'akozesa mu bulagirizi bw'okuteekawo. Synix tagenda kuggya fayiro z'abazannyi ezirina layisensi, oba okuziggyako. Olupapula lw'ebigambo olw'ebweru ye linnya ly'olupapula Synix ayinza okunoonya wansi w'olupapula lw'ebigambo lw'omukozesa. Leka nga temuliiko kintu kyonna ng'omukozesa asazeewo okukopya fayiro ezo mu mikono.
Okusooka Okulabula n'Ekifaananyi Yamba okulabula ng'abakozesa balina okumaliriza okuteekawo nga tebannaba kutandika. Wandiika amakubo agali mu kiwandiiko ekyo n'okumanya buli kimu omukozesa ky'alina okufuna okuva mu kuzimba kwe. URL y'ekifaananyi kye ky'oyagala era olina okukozesa HTTPS. Synix ekomawo ku kifaananyi eky'omuddugavu ekiba kyateekebwawo bwe kiba nga tekiriiko kintu.
EBIKULIZIBWA n'OBUGUMI Tandika obuvvuunula obupya n'empapula mu revision 1. Weeyongere okukyusa entegeka buli lw'entegeka y'omuzannyo egenda okukyuka. Weeyongere okukyusakyusa ku template kyokka ng'olupapula lw'okuteekawo olukulembedde lukyuse. Synix yagaana okuvvuunula awatali kukyusa okw'amaanyi era n'okukuuma eby'okuziyiza ebikozesebwa.
EKY'OKUSINDIRA OKUTIKA Yamba Steam okukoppolola ekiseera ky'okutambuliramu kyokka ng'omuddugavu amaze okukakasibwa okukikola. Ekigendererwa kirina okuba endagiriro y'ekika ekiri munda w'okuteekawo kw'obuwagizi. Synix ekoppolola DLL zayo ssatu zokka eziragiddwa ku Steam.
EBIYIGIRWA mu Kiseera Ssaawo enteekateeka z'ebitundu ebitonotono RAM ku 0 ng'omuzannyo teguli na kintu kyonna ekikakasibwa. Okukebera ebyuma ne Windows okukebera ekiseera eky'okutambuliramu kulaga ebisaanyizo ebibulako nga tebinnaba kuteekebwawo era n'okuziyiza okutandika okw'obutalina bukuumi; tezikyusa mpisa za Windows. Londa .NET Framework oba Visual C++ runtime kyokka ng'ebisaanyizo by'omuzannyo bibikakasa. Synix yeetegereza entegeka ya Windows naye tassaamu oba kuggyako byetaago mu kasirise. Hyper-V yeetaaga Windows Professional oba ey'okusingawo, n'olwekyo ng'olonda Hyper-V olonda ne Windows.
EKY'OKUTUKUMA Kozesa okukwatagana kw'ebikukutu ebikozesebwa ku ma servers agategekeddwa. Okuteekebwawo okw'ebweru kuba kwa ntambula yokka, emmotoka ey'obuntu, oba okuteekebwawo okulala kwokka okufuga omutindo gw'obulamu bw'omuddugaza; ekikendeeza ku kunoonyereza kw'ebibuuzo. Ssaawo Omulabirizi Omulabirizi Akwetaagisa ku by'emizannyo ng'omulabirizi we ow'obuyinza asaanidde okusigala ng'agenze. Kino tekikwatagana na ndowooza y'omukozesa ey'okuteekawo ekiteeso ky'okwekweka ku kigero ekyo kyokka. Okutandika okw'omugaso kugobererwa ku fayiro za .exe, .bat, ne .cmd zokka. Yamba okuggyako ng'omukozesa asobola okutonda n'okutambuza fayiro ey'okufulumya eyavvuunuliddwa awatali Synix. Obubaka obw'okwetegekera bubikkulibwa oluvannyuma lw'okukebera okw'enjawulo okukolebwa. Ebitundu bino bisalawo empisa ez'oku Synix ezirimu enkola ey'okuzimba era tezisobola kutambuza biwandiiko oba plugins.
LOG DISCOVERY Yingira amakubo ag'ebyokwerinda agakwata ku fayiro ya server eyateekebwawo. Kozesa * eri ekitundu ekimu eky'olugendo oba erinnya ly'essanduuko n'eri ** eri amafooda agali mu kibinja. {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, ne {QueryPort} bye bifo ebikwatiddwa. Ebyokulabirako: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix anoonya amakubo gano kyokka ng'omukozesa asabye okuggula ekitabo ky'emizannyo ekiggya.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Ebitundu eby'obuvunaanyizibwa bigoberera Synix Confidentiality Mode setting.

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Ebiragiro ebikwatagana n'ebifaananyi: Ebisaanyizo ebitabeerawo bikomekkerezebwa mu ngeri y'emu olw'omuzannyo gw'olonda.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Okukyusa ekifo kino tekiggyawo by'okuziika okuva mu folda eyasooka.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Yingiza Erinnya ly'Omuddugavu n'olonda Ekifaananyi ky'Omupiira.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: 1 EBIGAMBO BYO BIKYAWULIZIBWA Sserva, ebisaanyizo, okuddaabiriza, ebiseera eby'okutambuliramu, ne SteamCMD bizimbiddwa wansi wa C:\Synix bwe kityo enkola ey'okukyusakyusa tezigenda kubisasula.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 ADD A SERVER Salawo omuzannyo, oguyingire mu mpisa ez'omukwano, era olekere Synix okuguteeka. Steam okuyingira kwe kwetaagisa kyokka ng'omuzannyo gwokka bwe gugwetaagisa.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 START, STOP, AND VERIFY Synix eraga ensonga ezikwata ku kutandika, okukakasa okutandika, okukozesa empisa z'okuyimirizaamu nga zikkiriziddwa, n'okukuuma ebitabo ebibaddewo.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: 4 NETWORK ACCESS Windows Firewall enzikiriza ne router port forwarding byawukana. Synix yeetegereza obutategeeragana obw'omu kitundu, naye tayinza kukyusa router yo.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: 5 OKUKOLA N'OKUKONDA Kozesa Enteeka > Advanced > Troubleshooter okujjanjaba obulwadde n'okuddaabiriza. Kozesa Backups nga tonnagenda ku Synix oba nga tonnakola nkyukakyuka ez'amaanyi.

data.name: Text.2B2D3EED7C841FFB78AA
data.value: Obukuumi bw'okutuuka, empisa ez'okutandika n'okuteeka mu nkola

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Erinnya ly'akaawunti, so si erinnya lyo ery'okuzannya Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Weeyongere buli template endala ey'omugaso omuzannyo gwe gwetaaga. Yiga Ekifo ekizimbiddwa nga buli kkubo libeera kkono ku fayiro y'omuddugaza eyateekebwawo.

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Obukakafu obwesigika buva mu bikolwa bya Synix; ensonga zeetaaga okugezesebwa kw'omuddugavu ow'amazima.

data.name: Text.BC489FF2DAD82D69C258
data.value: Olukalala lw'ebyokwerinda olukolebwa mu bwangu n'ebigenda mu maaso

data.name: Text.A8BC53DE427A5E93DAED
data.value: Ebitundu by'omuzannyo / omuddugavu bizimbibwa butereevu wansi w'olugendo lw'emizannyo olukoleddwa.

data.name: Text.FC52030FEF2C9AEC802D
data.value: Funa enkola z'omuzannyo ezikoleddwa mu butereevu

data.name: Text.1232008495CAD0B69745
data.value: Ebizimbe bitandika n'obulagirizi obweru bwa Microsoft okuggyako ng'ekiseera eky'okutambuliramu tekinnaba.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Blokka z'okuteekawo ng'olina obubaka obweru bw'omuggalo bw'atawagira AVX2.

data.name: Text.ED928782624AFCE2078E
data.value: Okuggyawo ekiwandiiko eky'okufulumya mu ngeri ey'obukuumi...

data.name: Text.95E3AA6BFFB7545B20EF
data.value: Manya ebiseera eby'okutambuliramu ebigabanyizibwako, fayiro z'abaweereza, enkola, ebifo, Windows Firewall, disk space, entambula ezikwatiddwa, ebitabo ebya kaakano, ne Synix update health okuva mu kifo kimu.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Fuba okukebera SteamCMD olabe ebikyusiddwa nga tonnatandika kuweereza.

data.name: Text.6B1DD744008E1B4658A6
data.value: Laba SteamCMD, runtimes, server files, config, ports, Windows firewall, disk space, process interrupted, recent logs, and update health.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Akebera okufuluma okw'okufulumya okutuufu awatali kuzimba Synix, okutandika okufulumya, oba okufuna C:\Synix.

data.name: Text.52A32013E2D94B00DBF7
data.value: Akebera Windows .NET Framework eddiba nga server tennatandika.

data.name: Text.445F89C824FEC1E5E372
data.value: Akebera okulaba obanga Windows erina obuyambi bw'okuteeka mu nkola era nga busobola okukozesebwa.

data.name: Text.B28F2358A90FE65BFCC8
data.value: Londa ekimu ku biwandiiko ebikwatagana n'obuvunaanyizibwa bw'obuweereza

data.name: Text.58ECD5D931201294DE1E
data.value: Londa omuze gwa server okulaga ebyafaayo bya local verification.

data.name: Text.C9F72F8A6A3B6CC20F72
data.value: Londa empisa ez'okutandika ez'okuzimba zokka ezaakakasibwa ku mudduukirizi ono.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Salawo ekimu ku biwandiiko eby'oku ddwaaliro ebirina okudda mu kifo ky'ebiwandiiko by'obuweereza.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Funa olulimi Synix lw'akozesa. Embeera z'omuzannyo n'ebisaanyizo by'okuteekawo bikyali mu Lungereza.

data.name: Text.54FE09AF7E87A247A21A
data.value: Londa ddi Synix lw'alina okukolebwako okuddaabiriza omuweereza.

data.name: Text.B09F5332EE858BE57F71
data.value: Ebiragiro bibeera ku kompyuta eno okuggyako ng'okoze enteekateeka okuteeka Java RCON mu nkola ey'okutuuka ewala.

data.name: Text.82A8EB3A96D059596D55
data.value: Mumala okuteekawo fayiro ezisaanyisibwa nga tebannaba kutandika kuweereza.

data.name: Text.17F05E768CFB4B761715
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ky'empapula ekikwatagana n'enteekateeka eziri mu nkola

data.name: Text.F0CDBB393CA93D39DF05
data.value: Enkola y'okuteeka mu kifo ky'olupapula lw'abaweereza oluteekeddwa

data.name: Text.1315F512F1E9EDAD63BC
data.value: Okukakasa okuggyawo amateeka g'ekizimbe ky'omuliro ag'olukalala

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Genda mu maaso oluvannyuma lw'okwetegereza amakubo ag'okuteeka.

data.name: Text.07754DEE7F94A6CA31B1
data.value: Kopya fayiro za runtime Steam eziragiddwa oluvannyuma lw'okuteekamu

data.name: Text.DA14A0D982E06E70BB06
data.value: Koppa fayiro z'ekiseera ky'okutambuliramu Steam ezikkirizibwa oluvannyuma lw'okuzimbibwa

data.name: Text.A388F0CE16C067DFA8C5
data.value: Ekikwatagana n'ebiseera eby'okuzimbula Microsoft ebikozesebwa ku baweereza ba 2015, 2017, 2019, ne 2022.

data.name: Text.2196E21E8E2F8ABE522B
data.value: Ssaawo ekiwandiiko ky'obuwagizi obukuumiddwa nga buli ntandikwa tennatandika.

data.name: Text.5D45286D0F2A822299E8
data.value: Ssaawo ennyinnyonnyola y'omuzannyo egikkirizibwa awatali plugins oba ebyawandiikibwa. Ennyinnyonnyola zikwekebwa mu pulojekiti era zibeerawo oluvannyuma lw'okuzimba Synix.

data.name: Text.1B96BBB49F73081D9DD4
data.value: Enkola ya Synix eyogera ku mbeera ya kati

data.name: Text.1F9D51EC4BA893F84146
data.value: Ensonga z'okuteeka mu nkola ezisooka (buli kimu oluvannyuma lw'ekizikirizibwa)

data.name: Text.692AE6A41D7574B63232
data.value: Lipoota y'okugezesebwa kw'ennyinnyonnyola yakoppololwa ku kipande.

data.name: Text.9F67BB0F58790841820E
data.value: Okulema emirimu egikolebwa ku nteekateeka gy'emirimu gikola kyokka nga Synix ekoleddwa.

data.name: Text.84A9F83EFC6F8A9F3401
data.value: Discord yaggula. Londa New Post mu lukiiko lw'okutegeeza obuzibu n'okunyumiza alipoota eyakolebwa.

data.name: Text.0BB9D8B879FB1885FD71
data.value: Teweerabiranga mawulire, webhooks, IP address, private configuration, oba complete launch command. Synix evaamu ebyama ebisanja nga tebannatumibwa.

data.name: Text.E32BFB60FF5B5AA7759C
data.value: Olupapula lw'ebiwandiiko ebikozesebwa ku butonde bw'ebintu ebyakolebwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo (ey'okwesalirawo)

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Buli tteeka lilaga nti C:\Synix\Games\ [Game]\[Server], naye olukalala lw'omupiira gwonna luwedde era tewali muddu wa Synix atuukiddwako alina ekkubo.

data.name: Text.46D0E2FA44635045064B
data.value: Yiga serverconfig.xml mu ngeri ey'obukuumi awatali kukyusa XML.

data.name: Text.947BC568AF81FE33EC61
data.value: Okugonjoola bwokka ng'okuteeka kwa SteamCMD okutumbula tekukyasobola era nga waliwo akaawunti ya Steam eyetaagisa.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Okukakasa bwokka ng'obuweereza tebusobola kutambuliramu bulungi awatali buyinza bwa Windows.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Yamba RCON ku byokulabirako by'emizannyo ebikwatagana n'ekiragiro eby'oku wala.

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Yamba ng'obuweereza bulina ekibuuzo ekikakasibwa oba enkola y'okufunamu amasannyalaze Synix gy'ayinza okukebera.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Weeyongere okuwandiika amannya g'omuntu mu ngeri gy'agasaanidde okutambuzaamu. Kozesa ekikomera, ebifo eby'enjawulo, oba akawumbi kamu buli mugambo. Synix teyeetaaga database y'amannya ga mod.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Yingira obubaka bw'omuzannyo, oluvannyuma obwesige nga tonnasalawo.

data.name: Text.E83F8984B15353372DF8
data.value: Ekyokulabirako: Sserva eggalawo oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika ntono

data.name: Text.6F9406E668F812A49DBB
data.value: Okuteekebwawo okw'ebweru kuba kwa ntambuza oba ebyuma ebiriko enkola ey'okuziika n'okukomya okwetegereza ebibuuzo.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Afuna amateeka agaali mu C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], naye omuddugavu oyo takyasigaddewo era n'olupapula lw'omuddugavu lwe lukende. Port n'amafolda ag'okuteeka ag'enjawulo tezigenda kussibwamu.

data.name: Text.07E7C9C515328484C872
data.value: Ebiragiro eby'okukozesa ku Firewall ebitegekeddwa okuggibwawo

data.name: Text.6D27A85CB8D78F9F3B3E
data.value: Obubaka obwasooka obw'okutandika okulabika eri omukozesa

data.name: Text.3BE6A898F14F4D050AF5
data.value: Embeera z'omuzannyo (omuwendo gumu ogwa nnamaddala buli mutendera)

data.name: Text.88ED3B522C4F0A8BD740
data.value: GitHub terikwatiddwa. Kopi n'enkola ya Discord bikyaliwo.

data.name: Text.9942D957346A0E83C15C
data.value: GitHub ewandiika butereevu nga tebannaggula browser oluvannyuma lw'okugatta akaawunti.

data.name: Text.4E4DEFAC10984CADF571
data.value: Kwekweka IP amadiresi, ebigambo eby'okuggya, n'ebirala eby'obuvunaanyizibwa ng'ogenda okugabana ku kifaananyi.

data.name: Text.A8578B710044B649B2CD
data.value: Engeri omukozesa gy'afuna n'okuteeka fayiro z'omuzannyo ze yeetaaga

data.name: Text.4E469076738CB74F0877
data.value: Nnakakasa erinnya ly'omuddugavu eryolesebwa, ebifo, ekkomo ly'omuzannyi, n'ebintu ebirala byonna ebikozesebwa mu makulu gano, nga mw'otwalidde ebigambo eby'ekiddukiro, RCON, enkola, ne mmapa/ensi bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

data.name: Text.13F02AECB00BE9833629
data.value: Obumanyirivu, ensi, omuzannyi, n'okumanya ku mikutu

data.name: Text.5D385B4C5044DA97B77C
data.value: EBIYINGIRWA Tewaaliwo mpeke eyalondeddwa Londa ekivvulu okukebera ekiseera n'ekifo.

data.name: Text.11639557E899BAF5BC2A
data.value: Yingiza tag ya nsonga Synix eyesigamiziddwa

data.name: Text.44D7882A1ADBECC9092C
data.value: Ssaawo ekivvulu kino mu Synix nga tonnaba kukebera nsonga zaakyo ez'okubonyaabonyezebwa.

data.name: Text.70CAC3F03884A4946236
data.value: Okuteeka, okutandika, okukomya, n'okukebera ebikwekweto biwandiisibwa butereevu. Okukebera ensonga kukozesa server entuufu eyateekebwawo n'okugezesebwa kw'ekiragiro ekirongooseddwa; enkola y'okuteekawo ekitundu ekisigadde ng'okwekebera mu fayiro.

data.name: Text.D3F2BA487FAA0A74E4A4
data.value: Akkiriza omukozesa okuteekawo fayiro ey'okutandika okwetegereza. Ggyamu ebiragiro eby'okukozesa ebirina okubeera munda mu Synix.

data.name: Text.2FD27154D5938042C2FF
data.value: Limita omuwendo gw'ebiwandiiko eby'obukuumi ebikuumibwa buli mudduuka.

data.name: Text.E749931070B84A1593D2
data.value: Okukolera ku buli nkola ey'okuweereza emizannyo egikulemberwa.

data.name: Text.908BFBA75F9F88B71363
data.value: Ebikwata ku by'okukola n'ebikwata ku nteekateeka

data.name: Text.F31BBCEE0082BEEE372A
data.value: Map and mode choices ziva butereevu mu template y'omuzannyo ogulondeddwa.

data.name: Text.FDA8F741D724B426C343
data.value: Mapu oba ebifaananyi (omuwendo gumu ogw'amazima buli mutendera)

data.name: Text.A5C1D46A9B2A472DF537
data.value: Obubaka obulabika oluvannyuma lw'okukebera okw'enjawulo okukolebwa (obutabaako ky'okolawo)

data.name: Text.71F9139AF2A58247E590
data.value: Minimum system RAM mu GB (0 tekitegeeza nti wabaawo minimu)

data.name: Text.0F38AC5E2C273A4B6642
data.value: Londa ebifo eby'okuweereza ebikyaliwo olw'enkuba ey'ebikonde ebituuka n'obutegeeza ku buzibu bw'ebidduka by'entambula.

data.name: Text.1C310A469AD1721A3E91
data.value: Fuba okukebera n'okukuuma buli muddubuzi w'omuzannyo okuva mu kifo kimu eky'okukola.

data.name: Text.A6D637EAA965641CEB00
data.value: Gamba ekifo kino, giteeka ku webhook ya Discord, era olonde ddala ebikolwa bya Synix by'efuna.

data.name: Text.8DDA097844BB6EDCFA10
data.value: Tekikyusiddwa: fayiro z'omuzannyo, sserava ezirokoleddwa, amateeka ag'ebidduka byokka, ffoda z'okuteeka mu nkola, n'amateeka g'ekizimbe ky'omuliro awatali C:\Synix\Games.

data.name: Text.4DC50DE227F1D75CFF26
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekikwatagana ne webhook kyokka kye kiragibwa. Open Server Settings okulaba oba okukyusa ekiruubirirwa ekiriko.

data.name: Text.A8796566765C1117B49C
data.value: Omutindo gwokka gwe mukyusa gwe gusasulwa; Ennyiriri, ebitundu, okuteekamu ebiwandiiko, ebigambo, n'okuteeka wakati w'ebiwandiiko n'entegeka y'ebimu ku bintu ebikulu tebikyonoonese.

data.name: Text.8736DCB51A77046719F5
data.value: Ssa essimu y'omuzannyo mu ddwaaliro ng'omuweereza w'omuzannyo atandise. Ggyamu enkola eno obutambuza bakozi mu ddoboozi ery'omunda.

data.name: Text.C8CF5C841F7BF2F1E0F3
data.value: Yanguza ekivvulu kya Synix okugonjoola obuzibu

data.name: Text.656F6C1DD0569874658F
data.value: Ebiwandiiko eby'okufulumya eby'okwesalirawo (ebigenda mu maaso, emu ku lugero)

data.name: Text.CB904327966ABA4B8621
data.value: Enkola ey'okwesalirawo RCON syntax ?? okufulumya ensonga erina okubaamu {rcon}

data.name: Text.BF239CF13522B7D2F15A
data.value: Enkola y'okuteeka mu ngeri y'emu ekuumibwa

data.name: Text.36B18A6020F2CE06DF28
data.value: Okuggyawo SynixEnsibuko y'okuteekawo ebikwekweto ku baserva abalabirirwa okuyitira mu ddirisa lyabwe.

data.name: Text.F2492B6E06AE47BEB928
data.value: Obwesige obw'okubeerawo kw'ebibuga bukeberezebwa mu butereevu nga bukeberezebwa ku nkola ezikoleddwa n'abaweereza abalala aba Synix.

data.name: Text.F13396A9BD6FFF26191D
data.value: Enkola y'obukuumi ekweka obujulizi buno obw'okuyingira. Yingiza koodi ey'enjawulo, oba ogileke nga temuliiko kintu kyonna ng'otandika okugitegekera Windrose.

data.name: Text.82F665628E2402225B0F
data.value: Obumanyirivu bw'okukebera n'okukozesa ebyuma ebiriko obulamu ku buli muddubuzi w'omuzannyo ogukozesebwa.

data.name: Text.517D0391800FC8C55AD3
data.value: Ekikuumibwa mu Synix era ekikwekeddwa mu biwandiiko byayo. Ebiwandiiko by'ebiwandiiko ebikolebwa birimu akabonero akayinza okukozesebwa mu ndagaano esobola okusomebwa.

data.name: Text.49CDA0DED2FDB6421A49
data.value: Okufulumya folda eyalondeddwa. Fuba okukebera ng'oli mwetegefu.

data.name: Text.EC423125FB2CAF05C95B
data.value: Quick Commands ?? y'alonda emu ey'okutegeka, oluvannyuma n'agisuula n'agisindika

data.name: Text.15599B0016F3C3591CF5
data.value: Ebisaanyizo eby'okusoma byokka bisobola okulondebwa n'okukoppibwa ku bikwata ku kutegeera

data.name: Text.69EDD9A74D913D8F77D6
data.value: Okukebera ku butonde bwa template, okukyusakyusa, n'ebintu ebikuumibwa mu Server Settings. Emiganyulo gy'ekizingirizi tegiragibwa.

data.name: Text.D4BEB0C27C58D53CCFA7
data.value: Okusoma n'okukebera mu tterekero ly'ebifaananyi by'omuzannyo...

data.name: Text.54C8BBF4B91A6012A87B
data.value: Ready ?? Windows asaba omulabirizi okuweebwa olukusa okuggyako ng'emisingi gyetaaga okuggibwawo.

data.name: Text.2B2FF7B1710C1AE35612
data.value: Weeteeseteese okukebera fayiro ezifulumiziddwa n'essente y'okukebera eyateekebwawo mu kiseera kya Publish.

data.name: Text.C0BAAF3EA26A1A69CE63
data.value: Mwetegefu. 30-minute run ne 30-second samples kiragirwa okwekebera amangu.

data.name: Text.0C10BD130731730DDC5C
data.value: Okuzza obuggya okusitula obubaka bw'omuzannyi butereevu okuva ku muddubuzi w'omu kitundu.

data.name: Text.1DE733236BD0DED6BA11
data.value: Ebiwandiiko ebijja okufulumizibwa bijja kulabika wano.

data.name: Text.4CB636A73FAD7D71BC94
data.value: Okugezesebwa okw'obwesigika kwaggibwawo. Tewabaddewo nkyukakyuka mu nteekateeka za server.

data.name: Text.FE3F7B0A38B0EEDF20EB
data.value: Synix yaddamu okukebera eby'okujjukira, ebikozesebwa, emiggo, n'okukebera obulwadde bw'ensimbi ez'okusoma. Tekitandika, tekimala, tekiteeka, tekikyusakyusa, oba tekikyusa server.

data.name: Text.88E68081C6F4A7C6EEE2
data.value: Weetaaga enjuyi y'omulabirizi w'obuweereza okusigala nga eriwo

data.name: Text.9E09BE4B90E9259491DD
data.value: Ebirima ebisaanyiziddwa bissa mu nkola y'omuzannyo gw'otaddewo.

data.name: Text.AD654849FC9CF1C6D997
data.value: Ebiwandiiko ebisaanyiziddwa n'ebitontome ebyateekebwawo Synix bikubiriza okulabula.

data.name: Text.B0DAEADE1B96AB9F8EB5
data.value: Kwetaagibwa olw'engeri ng'eya Hyper-V ezitabeerawo ku Windows Home.

data.name: Text.5BA4DAF696F2453133A8
data.value: Ensonga z'okutandika ezisaanyiziddwa zifulumirirwa mu ngeri ey'amaanyi n'obubaka bwo obwenkanankana nga teunnaba kutandika. Osobola okuteeka ebikonde ebirala eby'olunyiriri lw'ekiragiro ebitafunibwa mu nnyiriri ez'obutebenkevu mu kitundu Extra Arguments.

data.name: Text.5DC5CE2CCFBCC1F3AE31
data.value: Ebiwandiiko ebisaanyiziddwa omukozesa (ebitundu eby'enjawulo, kimu ku lugero)

data.name: Text.A95511418E3B85D2CCA6
data.value: Yongera okutandika ku ssaawa ng'okozesa ssaawa z'essaawa 24

data.name: Text.2D41AABA41C2EF3FED5C
data.value: Yongera okutandika ennaku ez'olubereberye mu kiseera ekikwataganyizibwa ng'okukuuma obubaka bw'omutandiisi w'enteekateeka.

data.name: Text.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Weekenneenye engeri Synix gy'ezimba ekiragiro ekikozesebwa okutandika okuweereza kuno.

data.name: Text.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Weekenneenye amateeka ga layisensi nga tonnakkiriza ntandikwa ya server esooka.

data.name: Text.A2CBC7E3EEB055BE8AFC
data.value: Yogerako ku byetaago bino eby'okuteekawo nga tonnagenda mu maaso.

data.name: Text.B38F7F9752C285B4B90B
data.value: Okutambuza enkola y'ebipakiti, SHA-256, n'okukebera antivirus...

data.name: Text.5D719633D44DEE05A861
data.value: Okunoonyereza okusinziira ku mizannyo, ebikolebwa, oba embeera y'okuwagira...

data.name: Text.4CDDB86B34725DFF943D
data.value: Okwekenneenya okw'eby'okwerinda kwalemesa ekikozesebwa. Tewaaliwo fayiro zaakyusibwa.

data.name: Text.8C5A71A792CF70840F4B
data.value: Laba ddala Synix ky'asobola okuteeka, okuteekateeka, okukebera, n'okubuuza nga tonnaba kutandika kuweereza.

data.name: Text.339761CAC4ADD79725CB
data.value: Laba ekifo kya Discord kye kifuna buli ngeri ya Synix okubuuliramu ku muddu oyo.

data.name: Text.FFF9C013BFE465B863CB
data.value: Londa omuzannyo ogusobola okukyusakyusa obukakafu bwawo obw'okukakasa.

data.name: Text.F576F35548B3364CBEDB
data.value: Londa server eyateekebwawo n'okukakasa ekiragiro kyayo.

data.name: Text.DA03B7F52F79500329AF
data.value: Tuma status, backups, maintenance, and problems to different Discord channels.

data.name: Text.A50A426E7FA853DA7584
data.value: Ekifo ky'ennukuta z'omuddugavu (ekkubo limu oba akafaananyi ka wildcard buli mutendera)

data.name: Text.52D1EA9EC1761138D30F
data.value: Bulaga okulabula kw'okuteekawo ku ntandikwa y'olubereberye

data.name: Text.9C3A965A650194E6FECC
data.value: Bulaga Ebimu ku Biri mu Magezi

data.name: Text.D72917FA7B697BD4F0E1
data.value: Okwolesebwa okusobola okukakasa nti ekiragiro ky'okutangula tekirina nsonga ezifiiriddwa.

data.name: Text.20C57F23AC717E8E040D
data.value: Ntandika okuweereza okuyitira mu Synix. Alindirira omutegeevu we ow'okuwuliriza okuddamu...

data.name: Text.091C22C7EE122D76DAE4
data.value: Atandika okukebera ennyuma bw'otandika okuyingira Windows. Okusiba ekitebe kya Synix bulijjo kifuluma Synix mu bujjuvu mu kiseera kino.

data.name: Text.106E51E2A0CD985A0FBC
data.value: Ekikwekweto ky'ekigendererwa kya Steam mu budde bw'okudduka, nga kikwatagana n'ekikwekweto kya seva

data.name: Text.AD5BE8100C99D831B948
data.value: SteamCMD download speed mu megabits ku ssekunde

data.name: Text.6DC2259A4335DB1F7C92
data.value: Okulemesa omuweereza ow'okugezesa okuyita mu Synix...

data.name: Text.AFC6E98203B42710D6D2
data.value: Weekuumire ebiwandiiko by'obwesigamiziddwa ku maserva n'ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza mu folda ey'enjawulo.

data.name: Text.A03EE332F98F4733802C
data.value: Yiga ekitebe kya Synix wakati w'ebifaananyi ebiriko ekitangaala n'ebiriko ekizikiza.

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: Synix ekola ekiragiro eky'amazima ng'akozesa enteekateeka z'omupiira eno eziriwo, ekweka buli pasaala, n'agizimba mu ngeri entuufu, era n'alinda obukakafu obulaga nti omupiira yakkiriza okutandika.

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: Synix teyeggula kabangali y'okufuga ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti. Ennyiriri eziri mu Synix zikuumibwa mu kitundu, era n'ebisaanyizo eby'omugaso biziikibwa mu bitabo by'emirimu.

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: Synix efulumya loader ya server eyalondeddwa ne Java ey'obuvunaanyizibwa. Weeyongere okukyusakyusa oluvannyuma lw'okuteekawo.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: Synix ekiteekeddwa okufuula omuntu ow'okubeera ku game-server okutegeerekeka awatali kwekweka ebyo ebikyusibwa ku kompyuta yo.

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: Synix ekakasa obukuumi bw'ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana n'obutuufu bw'ebiwandiiko, ebiteeka mu biwandiiko ebyalondebwa mu ngeri ey'obukuumi, era n'ejjirawo mu butanwa singa okuzza obuggya tekugenda mu maaso. Ekiwandiiko kya Synix ekyaweereza ekyateekebwa n'obutendekebwa bwakyo tebikyusibwa.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: Synix ekakasa buli kikolwa nga kigenda mu maaso ku PC eno.

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Tubuulire kye wakoppolola, Synix kye yalaga, era n'engeri y'okukizzaamu.

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Okukebera buli nnyinnyonnyola n'empapula mu ngeri ey'obukuumi...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: Kugezesa buli mupiira oguyingiddwamu, okukwataganya enteekateeka ezikoleddwa, template ey'okuteekawo mu bujjuvu, okuvvuunula, ekkubo, ekifo ky'olukuŋŋaana, n'ekikolwa ekiragiddwa oluvannyuma lw'okuteekawo. Sserva eziteekebwawo tezigenda kukyusibwa.

data.name: Text.D1227935539D1BA6B9E6
data.value: Omulimu gw'okuweereza omuzannyo tegukyali mu nkola

data.name: Text.8421EE422CBE769494A6
data.value: Omulimu gw'okuweereza omuzannyo guli ku Intaneeti

data.name: Text.849FF4D03C300A88F143
data.value: Enkolagana y'omu kitundu yaggibwawo. Ggyamu Synix ku lupapula lwa GitHub olwatandika.

data.name: Text.199AA28C30C28597C6E2
data.value: Lipoota eyafulumiziddwa ku bikwata ku by'obukuumi yakoppololwa era esobola okuteekebwa mu lukiiko lwa bug Discord.

data.name: Text.0117F5327FA39CD0DABB
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ky'okufulumya kyaggibwawo. Tewaaliwo fayiro z'ebiwandiiko ezaakyusibwa.

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB
data.value: Lipoota ey'obwesigika ejja kulabika oluvannyuma lw'omutendera ogusabiddwa okuggwa.

data.name: Text.D9718558CFBB91F44CFF
data.value: Ekiseera ky'olukuŋŋaana kiwandiikiddwa mu nteekateeka z'omuddugavu ono.

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B
data.value: Sserva eyalondeddwa yeetaaga akaawunti ya Steam okusobola okuteekebwawo. Yingira erinnya ly'akaawunti SteamCMD gy'alina okukozesa.

data.name: Text.D305131EE6798E1D30FA
data.value: Sserva erina okusigala nga yeeyimiridde mu kiseera ky'okuzzaawo

data.name: Text.BCB4E85BFE366942E9D4
data.value: Sserva yaggwaako nga tebannatandika. Weekenneenye ebyawandiikibwa bye eby'edda n'engeri gye byategekeddwamu.

data.name: Text.946FF9E0EB0FA926E2AF
data.value: Sserva y'okugezesa eggyiddwa. Obujulizi obuli mu nsonga eno bwekuumibwa.

data.name: Text.7B3AC1F3AD7BA73ED0CC
data.value: Ebisaanyizo bino bisobola okukolebwa kyokka ng'essomero ly'omuddugavu eryo lye lyategekeddwa likuwagira.

data.name: Text.7CB94F75343DF207439A
data.value: Ekifaananyi kino kiraga ensonga Synix ezikozesa ng'azimba ekiragiro eky'okutandika.

data.name: Text.6440A1A6AB337CD371BA
data.value: Yingira buli lunaku ng'ekiseera eky'okuddamu okutandika kirina okutandika.

data.name: Text.09872897779CD02DAC70
data.value: Okukyusakyusa tekyatandika • Synix ey' kati teyakyusibwa

data.name: Text.348C3C8FD21539135DB5
data.value: Ebikwata ku by'obutebenkevu ebikyasinzeeyo bisangibwa wano.

data.name: Text.A8142050CBD33EE95F3F
data.value: Kozesa okuteekawo, okukyusakyusa, okuddaabiriza, n'okukakasa ebyuma ebikozesebwa mu mizannyo.

data.name: Text.60ADFA0715E4E83522DF
data.value: Kozesa webhook emu kuweereza ono n'olonda obubaka bw'alina okuweebwa.

data.name: Text.4910EE68C0A14BD4AF19
data.value: Kozesa bwokka ng'okugezesa kulaga nti omuweereza yeetaaga fayiro za Steam DLL ezikkiriziddwa. Ekigendererwa kirina okusigala mu fayiro ya server.

data.name: Text.1433E221238B95E942F7
data.value: Kozesa bw'oba ng'olupapula lusindikiddwa okuyitira mu bikwekweto bya Hyper-V oba Windows.

data.name: Text.F2029FAFB53EFFEE6890
data.value: Akozesa ekiseera kya kompyuta n'essaawa ya 24.

data.name: Text.229193F097F563A43177
data.value: Olukonde lw'okukebera lwaggulwa okuva ku bujulizi bwa Synix obwokoleddwa.

data.name: Text.A7678DBAFBD9E2842236
data.value: Ebisaanyizo by'ensimbi ebikakasibwa n'ebyetaago bya Windows ebikakasibwa nga Synix tennatandika kutandika kuweereza.

data.name: Text.16FB4FBCA9A11AC839AE
data.value: Okukebera amakubo g'ebiwandiiko n'obwesigwa bwa SHA-256...

data.name: Text.29CAE0D1FFE7D67CA266
data.value: Nga tulindirira ekyokulabirako ekisooka • Okuzzibwamu amaanyi buli ddakiika 1

data.name: Text.FF395F5EEE87F691A065
data.value: Biki Ebituuka ku Ggwe Oluvannyuma lw'Okukomawo?

data.name: Text.9B1DF515009197F7B731
data.value: Synix kati amanyi engeri y'okuteeka, okuteekateeka, okutandika, okukebera, n'okukebera omuzannyo guno.

data.name: Text.DDE7244B8E964BD733E4
data.value: Synix kye yali akola ng'ekizibu kyabaawo

data.name: Text.C29162E9E78CEEA6A66B
data.value: Bwe kiba nga kisobola, okuggyawo olupapula lwogera eri omulabirizi okuggyawo amateeka ga Windows Firewall. Ggyamu kino okusobola okwekutula ku buyonjo obwakolebwa mu kiseera eky'okuggyawo.

data.name: Text.9D352A1132C068237394
data.value: Windows asaba omulabirizi akkirize. Synix oluvannyuma aggyayo amateeka g'ekizimbe ky'okuziyiza agatuukagana n'amakubo agali waggulu era n'addamu okukebera okukakasa obuyonjo.

data.name: DynamicText.2ECD4E03F90BD36A3ACB
data.value: • Ebimu ku bintu ebikoleddwa mu kiseera ekituufu n'ebikwata ku nteekateeka

data.name: DynamicText.C0DC4B8E2D0B8558D8E2
data.value: • Ekitundu kino kiwandiikibwa mu nkola y'okuweereza.

data.value: Okukakasa ebisaanyizo ebirabika mu mupiira nga tonnaba kuteekawo okukakasa.

data.value: programu z'abaweereza ezisoboka. Londa omuzannyo ogutuufu wansi.

data.value: yafulumizibwa ku kompyuta eno. Kakasa erinnya ly'akaawunti ya Steam SteamCMD esobole okuzzaawo okuyingira nga tannaba kutandika.

data.value: Okukebera ensonga okuwandiikiddwa ku Synix v

data.value: Weeyongere okuwaayo ebifo eby'okuweereza n'okukuuma obukulembeze obw'ewala.

data.name: DynamicText.973CB1044C2D435579D5
data.value: Okukebera kompyuta eno n'obuweereza bwonna obwateekebwawo...

data.name: DynamicText.B74B06EC6EEB1F159449
data.value: Salawo fayiro ey'ekiddukizo oba eya bulijjo erimu byonna ebiri mu C:\Synix, oba okuzzaawo ku kompyuta empya.

data.name: DynamicText.CB565F94960FAEEC9A40
data.value: Londa olupapula lw'obuwagizi oluliwo okusobola okweyongera.

data.name: DynamicText.793006985DD52D518C6D
data.value: Salawo ekikwekweto ky'omuddugavu n'okukyusa ensonga z'okutandika.

data.name: DynamicText.A621C06C3B84375BB5BD
data.value: Salawo w'onoobeera n'omuddugavu. Synix ebawa ebisaanyizo eby'okulonda.

data.name: DynamicText.36A6C5ECE85999A4BE81
data.value: Okutumbula ekiragiro kwalemererwa. Longoosa obuvunanyizibwa obwalemereddwa nga tonnatandika kukebera.

data.name: DynamicText.99916B9A2D79AE0044D5
data.value: Okukakasibwa kw'obukulembeze kwawedde. Tandika okugezesa okukakasa nti omuweereza ow'amazima akikkiriza.

data.value: Olukalala lw'abantu abalagiddwa okubeera ab'enjawulo luli kumpi. Omuzannyo gujja kuggya oba okukyusakyusa ebitundu eby'omuweereza ng'omupiira gutandise.

data.value: Omuzannyo guno gufugibwa mu bujjuvu okuyitira mu nsonga z'okutandika, n'olwekyo tekyetaagisa kugezesa fayiro y'enteekateeka ey'enjawulo.

data.value:

Ebintu ebirala byonna ebikwatagana n'obukodyo bijja kuggibwawo.

data.value: Linda okuteekebwawo, okukyusibwa, okuddaabirizibwa, oba okuggibwawo okukomekkerezebwa nga tonnaba kukakasibwa.

data.name: ModManager.Error.LinkedPath
data.value: Omulimu guno oguyongerwamu gukozesa fayiro oba olupapula olukwataganyizibwa. Funa olukalala lw'olukalala; Synix tajja kugoberera kikwataganyizibwa ekyo.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekiddako ekyetaagisa okuzza obuggya kibula. Tewaaliwo fayiro zaakyusibwa. Ddamu okuzzaawo fayiro ey'okuzza obuggya eyabula oba kozesa entegeka y'ekidduka ku muddubi nga tonnaggyawo add-on eno.

data.name: ModManager.Error.RecoveryRetained
data.value: Omulimu gw'okukozesa add-on gulemereddwa era enkyukakyuka ezimu tezisobola kukyusibwa. Ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza byateekebwa ku {0}. Ssaabala akuyimye n'okuddaabiriza fayiro ezo oba okuddaabiriza sseraeva nga tonnatandika.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Ekifo eky'okulonda {0} tekisobola kuyita mu ngeri ey'obutebenkevu okuyita mu kivvulu kino eky'ekika kya Windows. Ebivvuunulwa ebiri ebyateekebwawo, okuwummula kw'omugera, oba ebigambo ebikyusibwa tebikwataganyizibwa wano. Omutindo ogwo tegwakyusibwa.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Ekiragiro ky'ekikonde ekikomekkerezebwa kirimu enkola y'ekiragiro ey'obutaba na bukuumi oba eky'okwongera ku nkyukakyuka. Okwekenneenya ebisaanyizo eby'okutandika n'ensonga endala; Tewali kintu kyonna ekyali kitandise.

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML line {0} terina mugaso oba ekozesa ekintu omutunzi ono ky'atasobola kukyusa. Ekiragiddwa: ekiwandiiko ekimu nga kirina empapula/olukalala n'omugaso gw'omugaso gumu. Ebiwandiiko by'okufuluma, ebisaanyizo eby'emirundi mingi, ebiwandiiko, ebinyweza, n'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo tebikwataganyizibwa. Tewali kintu kyonna kyawonyezebwawo.

data.name: GameInput.WorldSeed.RequiredNumber
data.value: {0} yeetaaga ensigo y'ensigo: kozesa ennamba yonna okuva ku {1} okutuuka ku {2}. Golola mu Setup ya Server > World Generation.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.RangeHint
data.value: Omuwendo gwonna okuva ku {0} okutuuka ku {1}. Olw'ensi eriwo, beera n'ensigo yaayo ey'olubereberye.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.Hint
data.value: Funa ensigo ey'ensi empya, oba genda mu nsi yo. Olw'ensi eriwo, beera n'ensigo yaayo ey'olubereberye.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Enkola eno ey'okuteekawo ekitundu ekikwatagana n'ebiwandiiko bya Empyrion byokka.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Kozesa erinnya ly'enkola y'amabaluwa ga 1–80, nga temuli bbugwe, amannya ga Windows agategekeddwa, oba ebifo eby'olubereberye/ebikyasembayo. Erinnya ly'ebifaananyi terisobola kuba nnamba ya Workshop yokka.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Londa ekifaananyi kyonna ekiriko ebintu ebikubiddwa ku kompyuta oba ekitundu eky'ekizikiza eky'okuteekawo, so si ekifaananyi ky'omuzannyo, ekitabo kya Workshop, enkola y'ebikonde, oba ekitabo ky'ensibuko.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: gameoptions.yaml n'ebintu byayo eby'omutindo, ebifo eby'okuzannya, ebitongole, oba ebikozesebwa nga bitongozebwa birina okubeera awamu mu ZIP root oba munda w'olupapula olumu olw'ebifaananyi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Ekitundu kino kirimu DLL, C#, oba JAR code. Yingiza koodi y'omubbi ey'enjawulo okuyitira mu Empyrion server mods oluvannyuma lw'okwetegereza ebiragiro by'omuwandiisi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Londa ekitundu eky'omuddo omujjuvu: DLL fayiro n'ebiwandiiko byazo eby'obuyambi birina okubeera ku muggo gw'ekitabo oba munda mu ffoda z'omuddo ezimu. Ebitabo eby'enjawulo n'ebiwandiiko by'abaweereza byonna tebikkirizibwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Ekyo tekisoboka. Yanguwa okusooka okufulumya ekifaananyi kyonna, oluvannyuma okironda mu lukalala lw'ebintu ebyateekebwawo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Olunyiriri oba okuteeka ebisaanyizo byakyusiddwa ng'akatundu kano kaali kazuuliddwa. Muggirewo n'okuddamu okulonda ekifaananyi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Obuyambi obwo bukyaliwo. Olunyiriri olulala lwetaaga erinnya eriggya, ery'okwerinda eritalina kukozesebwa. Synix teyaggyawo wadde okuggyawo ensi eriwo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: dedicated.yaml yabula, nnene nnyo, oba terina setingi y'emu eya GameConfig.CustomScenario ne GameConfig.GameName. Okusookera ddala, yogerako n'omulabirizi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: Synix teyasobola kukuuma kuyingira kwa server. Enkola ey'okutuusa ku ssennyiga eyaliko emabega ekoleddwa; Ekibiina ky'eby'okuyimirizaawo kikyaliwo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: Synix tajja kuggyawo mbeera oba ebintu ebyakolebwa nga waliwo ensi ezirokoleddwa. Ensi ezo zisobola okwesiga fayiro ezo. Tewaali fayiro z'ebifaananyi ezaakuggibwako.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Ebiwandiiko by'ebifaananyi byaggibwa mu nsi. Ensi gye tulimu kati n'embeera gye tulabamu tebyakyusibwa. Kozesa "Scenario" okulonda ekifaananyi n'erinnya ly'oyinza okukuuma. Weekuume erinnya ly'enkola y'olupapula olumu ng'ofulumya obuggya.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Weeyongere okuwandiikira Steam n'oleka download emale, oluvannyuma welonda olupapula lw'ebifaananyi wansi wa steamapps\workshop\content\383120, oba welonda ebifaananyi byonna ZIP. Kino kifulumya kopi y'ekifo; Steam tajja kussa mu nkola kopi y'omuddugavu bwereere.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Londa ZIP oba folda ey'omuwandiisi gwe weesiga. Weeyongere okukuuma DLL, _Info.yaml (bw'obawa), ebyesigamiziddwa ku bintu n'ebintu wamu. Synix tezitwaliramu bikwatagana oba okufulumya mod code yokka.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Erinnya ly'olupapula lw'ebigambo ku muddu (kozesa linnya lino okuddamu okukyusakyusa)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Olunyiriri n'okulonda okukuuma byawonyezebwa. Tandika okuweereza ng'ali mwetegefu, oluvannyuma weetegereze ekitabo ky'omuzannyo n'okwataganya n'omugenyi. Ebiwandiiko ebiriwo mu nsi byakuumibwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Save name (GameConfig.GameName ?? so si linnya ly'okwolesebwa kw'omuddugavu)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.NewSaveNotice
data.value: Embeera eyawukana yeetaaga okuwonyezebwawo. Synix eraga erinnya eriggya era teriggyawo oba okuggyawo ensi eriwo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Scenarios
data.value: Yingiza olupapula oluggyiddwa oba ZIP. Kozesa Select Scenario oluvannyuma; ebyuma ebikyaliwo bikwatiddwa obukuumi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Mods
data.value: Yingiza ffoda z'ebiwandiiko ebikwatiddwa oba ZIP. Weekenneenye engeri omuwandiisi gy'asinziirwamu; Kkoodi yeetambuza mu Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Okuggyawo ebintu ebiriko {0}? Ffaayiri zonna eziteekeddwa mu kivvulu ekyo zijja kuggibwawo oba okuddaabirizibwa mu buwandiike bwazo obwasooka, nga mw'otwalidde n'ebivvulu ebirala ebiri mu kivvulu. Ebiwandiiko ebikyusiddwa ebweru wa Synix bijja kuziyiza okuddaabiriza. Weeyongere okukuuma obukuumi obw'omuweereza nga tonnagenda.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Enkola eno ey'okuddaabiriza tegyawagira butonde bwa buwandiike. Londa emu ku fayiro za packet eziriko obuyambi.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Londa ffooda ya mod oba ya scenario yonna erimu fayiro z'ebipakiti ze weetaaga, so si entambula y'omuzannyo oba ekitundu ky'ebintu ebiteekeddwawo.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Size
data.value: Ekivvulu kino kisukka ekkomo ly'okuleeta mu nsi endala, oba ekitundu kyaakyo kikyusiddwa ng'ekikoppololwa. Tewali kintu kyonna ekyali kyateekebwawo.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Londa Mod ZIP oba olupapula olw'omuzannyo n'oluggya ebyalondeddwa. Weeyongere okukuuma obuwandiike bwe, ebyetaago bye n'ebintu bye. Weekenneenye ekifo ky'ogenda okukyaliramu era weetegereze ebivudde mu kunoonyereza nga tonnaba kukiteeka.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.SelectFolder
data.value: Londa olupapula lw'ebifaananyi byonna oba olupapula lw'ebifaananyi, so si entandikwa y'omuzannyo

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Import.ExistingScenario
data.value: Olupapula luno oluliwo dda. Ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana bijja kusasulwa, ebiyinza okukwata ku nsi ezikozesa ekifaananyi kino. Weeyongere okukuuma obwesige bw'omuddugavu obujjuvu era kozesa erinnya eddala ly'olupapula olw'ekifaananyi ekirala. Ebiwandiiko ebiri mu nsi ey'obuddukiro tebijja kukyusibwa.

data.name: ModManager.Error.NewerInstallation
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekiggya kati kirina fayiro eziri mu kivvulu kino. Okusookera ddala ggyayo ebintu ebipya.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileChanged
data.value: fayiro ey'olubereberye eyateekebwawo ekyuse. Okuddaabiriza kwayimirizibwa nga tebannakyusa fayiro za server. Bwe kiba kyetaagisa, fuba okuzzaawo ekiwandiiko ekyesigamiziddwa ku sseraeva yonna.

data.value: Funa ebyongerezeddwako mu kitundu kino eky'okuteeka...

data.value: Okuteekawo akapapula akazze kafulumizibwa n'okuteeka kopi ez'enjawulo...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Removing
data.value: Okukebera ekivvulu kyonna n'okuddaabiriza fayiro ez'edda...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Framework
data.value: Okuteeka entegeka y'omuddugavu. Nkwegayiridde, gumawo akasolya kano...

data.name: ModManager.Framework.SaveFailed
data.value: Ebiwandiiko by'ekitebe byateekebwawo, naye Synix teyasobola kukuuma nteekateeka za server. Weekenneenye ebisaanyizo by'olupapula era weekuumire enkola y'okuweereza omulundi ogw'okubiri nga tonnatandika. Ebiwandiiko ebikwatiddwa tebyaggibwawo.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Failed
data.value: Okukola ekyo tekyasobola kumalirizibwa. Weekenneenyeeko ensobi eyo, oluvannyuma weeyongera okwetegereza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Ready
data.value: Mwetegefu. Tewali mudduula atandikibwawo mu butanwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Funa obuvunaanyizibwa obw'okukozesa Minecraft wano. Mulekere awo nga tonnakyusa fayiro, ensi, packs, oba runtime. Tandika, leka, era otandike okuddamu okukozesa Synix's lifecycle safeguards.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Kozesa enteekateeka ez'okuddaabiriza n'okukuuma, nga mw'otwalidde okulindirira abazannyi n'okusooka okuzzaawo ekiwandiiko ekirala. Times ekozesa ebiseera bya PC eno. Synix ateekwa okuba ng'atambulira ku nteekateeka ye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Fuba okuggya amannya ku Intaneeti n'olukalala lw'okutuuka ku bintu ebyokoleddwa. Londa erinnya ly'omuzannyi, oluvannyuma weetegereze ekikolwa. Ebiragiro byetaaga omuweereza atambuza n'okugatta kw'ekifo eky'okukola. Bedrock tegwagira biragiro bya Java okugaana.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Yiga server.properties n'ebiwandiiko bya mod/plugin. Ebisaanyizo ebikozesebwa Synix bikwatagana nga server.properties ekoleddwa. Erinnya eryamanyiddwa / MOTD lyawukana ku linnya ly'ekifulumiramu kino. Okuzza obuggya kutereeza enkyukakyuka ez'okuteekawo okw'ebweru nga zikomeddwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Save ekola kopi ez'okuzuukira. Enkyukakyuka mu byalo, ensi, ensigo, embeera y'omuzannyo, ekkomo ly'omuzannyi, ne Minecraft ez'okufuga eziwa obuyambi nazo zikyusizza Synix. JSON, XML, ne YAML bifulumizibwa nga tebannasalawo; ebitundu ebirala byetaaga okutegekebwa obulungi. Weeyongere okukuuma obujulizi bwo obw'ekyama.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Yingiza Java oba Bedrock world ZIP mu folda empya, oluvannyuma olina okugikozesa. Ensi eziriwo tezigenda kusasulwa. Ebiwandiiko tebikyusibwa. Okukyusa tekusobola kukyusa, kukendeeza, oba okukakasa nti omuzannyo gw'ensi yonna gufaanaganira ddala ne mode; sooka oyimirire.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Kwekebera metadata ya JAR n'obwesigamye, okulabirira add-on ez'enjawulo, oba okwetegereza ekibinja ky'abaweereza ekituukiridde. Kozesa emizingo gy'omuzannyo era n'okuteekawo omutwalo. Okukebera okukwata ku kukwatagana kuba kubuulirira era tekulaga nti koodi ya bukuumi oba nti buli mod ejja kukola.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Eby'okuziyiza byonna birimu olupapula lw'abaweereza, ensi, ebyongerezeddwako, n'enteekateeka. Ssaako server esooka. Weekenneenye obugolokofu bwo nga tonnaba kuddamu. Okuddaabiriza kuggyawo fayiro z'abaweereza; ebiwandiiko ebikakasa obugolokofu bw'ebiwandiiko, so si obanga ekiwandiiko ky'obwesige kirimu ekizibu ekyaliwo edda.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Buli enkyukakyuka eyakolebwa ku bikwata ku bintu ebikyaliwo n'ebiwandiiko ebikyaliwo. Londa enkyukakyuka eyakolebwa oba eyakolebwa okuzzaawo. Okusoomooza ku nkyukakyuka empya ezisooka. Ebiwandiiko ebikyusiddwa ebweru n'ensi ekikwataganyizibwa n'ebintu ebiggibwa ebweru birina obukuumi. Weeyongere okuteekawo eby'obugagga byonna ebikozesebwa mu kiseera ky'okutambuliramu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Fuba okunoonyereza ku bizibu ebitera okubaawo mu loogi y'abaweereza gye buvuddeko awo ne mu lipoota y'ebizibu. Ebizuuliddwa bye bimu ku bintu ebireetedde abantu okufa, so si ebyo ebikakasa ensonga. Enkola CPU/RAM si Minecraft TPS/MSPT; bakozesezza enkola ey'okuwandiika ebifaananyi ku mudduukizi ng'obukodyo bw'okukebera ebikolwa bya tick.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Oyinza okukomya omuweereza ono okuyita mu Synix?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Yongera okutandikawo olupapula luno okuyitira mu Synix kati?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Okuteekawo enkyusa ey'omuzannyo, loader, n'okuzimba okuva mu nsibuko zaabwe ez'obuyinza? Kino kisobola okuggyamu Java n'okutandika okuteeka Forge/NeoForge. Ebiwandiiko bya server bifulumiziddwa okusooka; fayiro ezaali zikyusiddwa zaakuumibwa okuddaabirizibwa. Ensi n'ebintu ebirala byekuumibwa. Fuba okuzzaawo ekiwandiiko ekimu nga tonnakyusa kya mupiira. Tewabaddewo muddu wa mizannyo gwatandika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Okutuma ekiragiro ky'omuzannyi? Omuweereza afuna obuyinza obw'amaanyi ku muddubuzi w'omuzannyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Oyinza okukozesa ensi ey'olubereberye? Ensi ey'okutuusa kati ebeera ku diski. Funa ensi yokka egirina akakwate n'enkyusa ya server eno, enkyusa, ne mods.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Okuggya mu nsi ekiwandiiko kino eky'obwesige? Modrinth pack esobola okulonda fayiro ezikozesebwa okuva mu nsibuko za HTTPS ezaasiimibwa. Mods n'ebiwandiiko by'omuzannyo bifulumya koodi munda mu server y'omuzannyo. Enkola y'okukozesa ebikozesebwa, enkola ey'okukakasa nti ebikozesebwa bikwatagana, n'ebikozesebwa mu kukozesa ebikozesebwa ku bulumbaganyi tebikuuma bukuumi. Weekenneenye enkyukakyuka zonna ezikoleddwa nga tonnazikozesa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Enkola y'okukebera esoma metadata nga tebikubye koodi ya mod. Enkola ez'enjawulo ez'okuvvuunula, enzikiriza ez'ekimu n'ebiwandiiko ebimu eby'obugagga byetaaga okukeberezebwa mu mikono. Okukebera kuno tekukakasa nti programu enkambwe zikwatagana oba tezikyaliwo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Okuteekawo entegeka y'obwesimbu ey'obuweereza buno obwali buyimiriddwa?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Okuzzaawo eby'okuyimirizaawo byonna? Ebiwandiiko ebikyaliwo ku muddubi bijja kusasulwa. Weekenneenye ebiwandiiko n'okwata fayiro yonna gy'oba okyali weetaaga nga tonnagenda mu maaso.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Funa fayiro ezisooka ez'ekyukakyuka kino. Fayiro eziteekebwawo mu nkyukakyuka eno ziggibwawo bwokka nga tezikyusiddwa. Ebiwandiiko ebikyusiddwa biziyiza okuwonawo. Okuddaabiriza okujjuvu kwetaagisa okuggyawo okukyuka kwonna okw'ensi okukolebwa oluvannyuma lw'okutandika emizannyo egy'enjawulo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Tewaaliwo kabonero konna akazuuliddwa mu biwandiiko eby'edda. Kino si kivvulu kya bujjanjabi. Kozesa Obwetegefu okukebera obutali butuukirivu obwasooka okumpi n'ekiseera eky'okulemererwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Okwekenneenya nga tonnaba kukozesa: {0} empya • {1} ekikyusiddwa • {2} evaamu. Ebiwandiiko eby'olubereberye bisigibwa okusobola okuwonyezebwawo. Tewabaddewo sserva yonna eyatandika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Ekizimbe ky'omuddugavu ekiragiddwa oba metadata ze zikoleddwa tezisangibwa. Fuba okuzza obuggya enkola y'okukyusa/okuzimba n'okuddamu okugezaako.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Ekitundu kino kisukka ku fayiro eyesigamiziddwa, metadata, oba ekkomo ly'obukulu bwabyo bwonna.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Ebintu eby'okuddaabiriza bibula oba tebikwatagana. Weekuume olupapula lw'okuddaabiriza n'okukozesa obwesige obw'amaanyi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Okukola ebintu ebikyaliwo emabega kyetaaga okuddaabirizibwa. Open Change recovery era oggyemu nga tonnakola nkyukakyuka endala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekikyusiddwa okuva mu kunoonyereza oba okuva mu nkola eno. Weeyongere okwekebera. Tewajja kubaawo biwandiiko by'obutaba na nkolagana nabyo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Enkola oba ekkubo ly'ekitundu si ddembe, lya njawulo, oba terimu buyambi. Londa ekiwandiiko ekikwataganyizibwa n'obuweereza oba Archive y'ensi yonna.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Eno ye nsi ey'ebintu ebingi ebiggibwa mu nsi endala. Genda mu nsi endala nga tonnaggyako buyambi bwayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Olupapula olwo lukyaliwo. Londa erinnya eriggya ly'olupapula; Ensi eziriwo tezigenda kuggibwa mu bujjuvu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Londa ekiwandiiko ekirimu ensi emu ne level.dat. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, ebiwandiiko ebikozesebwa ku ma servers gonna n'ebiwandiiko ebikozesebwa ku nsi ezitali zimu bikozesa enkola ey'okuddaabiriza oba okuzzaawo ebintu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Ensi eno tegikwatagana na server edition oba erema fayiro z'ekitundu/ensibuko y'eby'okukozesa ze yali asuubira. Ensi za Java ne Bedrock tezikyusibwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Kozesa erinnya ly'enkola y'ensi erimu obukuumi, nga terina makubo oba amannya ga Windows. Bw'oba oyogera ku nsi ezimu, kozesa ennukuta, ennamba, ebifo eby'enjawulo, oba ebintu ebirala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Akakiiko kano k'emirimu ke ga Java server mods/plugins. Kozesa Bedrock's own supported add-on workflow; Java JAR tezisobola kutambulira ku Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Tewabaddewo kintu kyonna ekiweereddwa ku muddu. Scripts za Launcher, fayiro z'omugenyi, ebiseera eby'okutambuliramu, ensi, n'obutonde bwa root server tebitwalibwa mu modpack workflow.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Ekitundu ky'omutindo tekikwatagana na programu ya server eyalondeddwa. Mods zeetaaga loader y'omuddo egukwatagana; Bukkit/Paper plugins zeetaaga plugin runtime.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Kino kye kiwandiiko kya kasitoma wa CurseForge, so si server pack yonna. Download server z'omuwandiisi ZIP erimu mods n'ebiwandiiko; fayiro ezitabeerawo teziggwaawo mu ddoboozi ery'omunda.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Minecraft ya pack ne loader/build erina okukwatagana ne server eno. Okusookera ddala, sooka oyongere okwekebera. Ebintu eby'okutereka ebitawagirwa tebigenda kukyusibwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Enkola y'okuvvuunula oba okuddaabiriza si nsibuko ya HTTPS eyasiimibwa. Kozesa ZIP y'omuwandiisi w'ebitabo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekiragiddwa tekyakwatagana n'obukulu bwabwo oba hash ya SHA-512. Tewali kintu kyonna ekyali kyateekebwawo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Omutindo gwa Minecraft ogukozesebwa Synix tegukyali wa mugaso oba guli mu butategeeragana. Manya ebifo, ekkomo ly'omuzannyi, engeri y'okuzannyamu, n'obulagirizi bw'okubikuuma nga tonnasalawo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix teyasobola kukuuma bubaka bw'omuddugavu obwedda. Okukola okwo tekwakkirizibwa; fayiro ez'okuddaabiriza zaakuumibwanga bwe zaabanga zeetaagisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Enkolagana ya Synix ey'okukuuma Minecraft erina okusigala ku localhost. Teweerabikanga ku Intaneeti.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Port eyateekebwawo y'eya Synix server endala. Funa ekifo ekirala nga tonnasalawo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Londa ekikolwa ekikwataganyizibwa n'erinnya ly'omuzannyi eddungi. Okugaana Java si biragiro bya Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Omuweereza teyatandika. Weeyongera okugezaako, gezaako okukebera Obwetegefu n'olupapula lw'emirimu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Metadata teyasobola kusomebwa mu bujjuvu. Weetegereze fayiro n'ebigendererwa by'omuwandiisi waayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Aba JAR ab'omutindo ogusinga obumu be bawa ekiwandiiko kino. Weekenneenye n'okweggyamu enkyusa ey'enjawulo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: JAR eno yeeyita ey'abakasitoma bokka. Tokazimbye ku server ey'enjawulo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Metadata ya JAR eno tegikwatagana na loader/software eyalondeddwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Obwesige obwetaagibwa obutasangiddwa mu metadata ezaakolebwa: {0}. Gezaako okukebera obwesigamye oba obwesigamye nga tonnaba kuteeka kintu kyonna.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Okuteeka essira ku byetaago bya {0}: {1} eyetaagisa, {2} eskennebwa. Ekitundu kino/ennyiriri eno tekitegeerekeka bulungi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Olukuŋŋaana luno lulaga nti Java/class-version ekontana. Kozesa enkyusa ya Java eyetaagisa omuweereza n'omutambuzi wa mod.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekiraga nti Java teyalina bbanga ddene ery'okujjukira. Weekenneenye RAM eriwo, ekkomo ly'obubonero bw'omupiira, n'okumanya obanga obuweereza obulala bukutwalira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Ekitabo kyogera ku byetaago eby'okuddaabiriza. Weekenneenye ekikyamu ekyasooka, oluvannyuma weetegereze mod, obwesigamye, enkyusa y'omuzannyo, n'okuzimba loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekiraga nti ekifo ky'okuyitamu kati kikozesebwa. Weekenneenye enteekateeka endala n'ebibuga ebikwatiddwa ku mudduukirizi ono; temuggula mayumba ga firewall agatali gamu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Ekitabo ky'ebitabo kyasaba Minecraft EULA okukkirizibwa. Soma era okkirize okuyitira mu nkola y'omulimu ogw'okutangira okukola, bw'oba okkiriza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Empapula z'oku mutimbagano zigamba nti ebikondo bitambula mpolampola oba nti omukuumi aluddewo. Gezaako CPU load, world generation, entities, ne mods. Ebirala RAM byokka biyinza obutasobola kugonjoola kino.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Ensobi y'ekikonde emirundi mingi ekola nga waliwo enkola ey'okuzimbulukusa n'ey'okuzimbulukusa. Weekenneenye ensonga esooka mu alipoota y'obutakkaanya n'ebiwandiiko ebisaanyiziddwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Olukuŋŋaana lwogera ku nsobi eziri mu kusoma kw'ebintu ebiri mu nsi yonna. Yimirire server n'okukuuma fayiro za kati nga tonnagezaako kuddamu okukakasa nti zikwatagana.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Ekizimbe kino eky'edda tekirina fayiro ya runtime eyateekebwawo. Kozesa entegeka y'ekidduka ey'omupiira okugizzaawo; Synix tajja kuteebereza loader ye eyasooka n'ennyiriri ze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Ekiseera ky'okutambuliramu ekyateekebwawo tekikwatagana n'ekivvuunulwa, enkola, loader, oba Java ekyetaagisa. Ggula Minecraft Control Center era kozesa Apply Runtime nga tonnatandika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Omutindo gwa {0} tegulina mugaso. Yamba okukyusa enkola eno nga tonnasalawo kukyusa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Tewali kintu kyonna kye tuyinza kwoleka. Okuzza obuggya oluvannyuma lw'okongeza omutindo oba okukyusa enteekateeka y'omuweereza ono.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} add-ons ze zaategeerekeka • {1} bye byazuulibwa okwetegereza. Akakiiko kano tekakyusa fayiro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Tewabaddewo byongerezeddwako mu fayiro ya Mods oba Plugins ezikoleddwa ku server eno.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Tewaaliwo buzibu bwonna mu kunoonyereza ku metadata eziriwo. Kino tekitegeeza nti buli mod oba plugin ejja kukola wamu.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Londa ASA Windows-server ZIP eyaggibwa ku kompyuta oba olupapula oluggiddwawo. Synix esanga ebyogera ku mod mu mpeke ez'ebbeeyi, ezikoleddwa, oba ezitali zimu era n'eteekateeka ID za CurseForge ezo okuzisuubirwa. Ebiwandiiko bya ZIP tebikoppololwa wadde okuteekebwa. ASA eggyayo era n'ewandiisa enteekateeka y'omupiira eya mu kiseera kino ey'omuweereza bw'otandika omupiira; Kino tekitegeeza nti ZIP y'emu ku zo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Londa ZIP oba olupapula lw'olina okukebera. Tewajja kubaawo nkyukakyuka mu nteekateeka za server oba fayiro okutuusa lw'onoogenda otunuulira n'owonya olukalala lw'ekikwekweto kya mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Ensonga z'omutendera tezitegeerekeka. Okukimanya tekitegeeza kukebera programu embi, okukebera obutuufu bw'ebiwandiiko, oba okukakasa nti omubuulizi ye muntu.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Okusoma metadata z'epakiti. Tewaabaddewo koodi ya mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: {0} Mods ze zaategeerekeka; {1} ebisaanyizo ebipya okubyongerako. Akatabo k'obuntu akaliwo gakwata ekiragiro kyabwo. Weeyongere okwetegereza olukalala lwonna nga tonnasalawo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Okukebera ekivvulu kyaggibwawo oba kyamala ekiseera kiwanvu nnyo. Londa olupapula olutonotono era gezaako omulundi ogw'okubiri.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Londa ARK server mod ZIP oba folda ya mod eyaggibwawo. Emizingo emirala egy'ebiwandiiko tegikwataganyizibwa n'omusomi ono.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Ekivvulu kisukka ekkomo ly'omusomi w'ensimbi. Londa olupapula olutonotono oba ZIP oluli n'ebiwandiiko ebyogera ku mod 100.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekyo kirimu amakubo agatali ga bukuumi, akakwate, amakubo ag'enjawulo, fayiro ez'enjawulo, oba ffooda nnyingi. Tewaali nkyukakyuka yonna.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Tewabaddewo .uplugin mod descriptor. Londa Mod ZIP oba olupapula lwe lwaggyibwawo; ebiwandiiko ebikwatiddwa mu kisaawe kirina okusooka okuggibwawo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: Enkola y'okuwandiika enkola si ya bwenkanya, JSON. Tewaali nkyukakyuka yonna.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ekiraga nti ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge tekitegeeza pulojekiti. Synix tajja kulowooza ku mupiira oba ID ya mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: Ekiwandiiko ky'okuwandiika tekirina CurseForge project ID (cf_ugcID) emu. Kozesa Manage Mod IDs ng'olina ID okuva ku lupapula lwa CurseForge lw'omuwandiisi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Mod erina WindowsServer package etategeerekeka oba erimu fayiro .ucas/.utoc eyogeddwako. Funa Windows-server download, so si client build.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Ekiwandiiko kino kirimu enkola esinga emu ey'okulaga ekiwandiiko kye kimu. Londa ekitundu kimu eky'ekimu n'okiddamu okukitegeera.

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Londa ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP oba folda eririmu .mod descriptor n'olupapula lwayo oluvuganya. Synix esoma ekiwandiiko ky'omukozi okuva mu kiwandiiko, so si erinnya lya ZIP. Fayiro tezikoppololwa wadde okuteekebwawo: oluvannyuma lw'okukebera, Synix addamu amaanyi ActiveMods ne ModIDS ku kkubo ery'okuddaabiriza eddala lya ARK. Mapu n'okukyusibwa kwonna biyinza okwetaagibwa okuteekebwawo kwa server ey'enjawulo. Empaka za ASA CurseForge tezikwatagana.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Kino si kye kitongole ekikkirizibwawo eky'okusuubula ebitundu bya ASE. Weegatta .mod descriptor n'olupapula lw'ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana ne mod.info n'ebintu ebyakolebwa. Ekiwandiiko ekirimu ekiwandiiko ekyo kirina okukwatagana n'erinnya ly'ekiwandiiko kyonna eky'omuwendo. Raw Workshop .z downloads awatali fayiro ya .mod eyateekebwawo teziganyulwa mu musomi ono; Kozesa Manager Mod IDs mu kifo ky'ekyo.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Ekitundu kino kirimu ekiwandiiko ekiraga ensibuko y'ekitabo ekirala ekya ARK. ASE Steam Workshop mods ne ASA CurseForge mods tezigenda kusasulwa. Londa ekipakiti ku muddubuzi gw'olonda.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help

data.value: Londa olupapula oluli munda mu kivvulu ekirina omutwe oguli mu kifo ekya server. Ebifooli by'ebiwandiiko ebikozesebwa bifulumizibwa. Osobola okuggyawo ebikopo by'okukoppolola ng'olonda olupapula olw'omunda. Ebiwandiiko byokka ebifulumizibwa bijja kutwalibwa; fayiro eziriwo zifuna kopi z'okuzuula. Kino tekikyusa mods ezitafaanaganira ddala.

data.name: ModSupport.ImportRules
data.value: Synix erina amateeka ag'okuleeta ebintu mu nsi ezitali zimu. Packet erina okukwatagana ne loader eyateekebwawo, enkyusa ya server n'obwesigika.

data.value: Tewali tteeka ly'okuteeka mu ngeri y'emu eryaliwo ku lunyiriri luno. Soma enkola eri wansi nga tonnaba kusalawo kifo ky'oyinza okugenda; fayiro nazo ziyinza okwetaaga okukyusibwa mu nteekateeka oba mu bawagizi.

data.value: Obuyambi obuli mu buwandiike si bukakafu obulaga nti obwesigamiziddwa ku nkola y'okuweereza. Mods z'abaweereza, mods z'abakiriya n'abaziguzi ba loader zaawukana. Tewali kintu kyonna ekikoppololwa, ekiteekebwawo, oba ekitandikibwawo mu kitabo kino.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LoaderMissing
data.value: Okutwalira ebintu ebikyaliwo ku nsi kiziikiddwa: ekirungo ekyenkanankana kikyaliwo oba ekipakiti tekikwatagana na kirungo ekyandibaddewo ku nsi. Weetegereze enteekateeka z'omubbi n'obuyambi bwa Mod & setup.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderCompatibility
data.value: Ebisaanyizo by'omuwaabi byokka. Enkyusa za Mod, obwesigika n'okusatuukagana kw'empapula tebikeberezebwa. Kakasa nti buli kiragiro ky'omuweereza kiwagira omuddugaza ono.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderActivation
data.value: Weeyongere okuteekawo amannya g'obuntu agalagiddwa, oluvannyuma otandike okuweerezaza wekka era weetegereze ekitabo kyayo eky'okuggya ebintu ku kompyuta. ZIP eyalondeddwa teyeekakasa kivvulu kya mupiira/muwaabi ky'awangudde.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Okuvvuunula fayiro tekuteeka loader oba okuwandiisa/okuyamba mod. Goberera Mod support & setup n'obulagirizi bw'omuwandiisi bw'omuddugavu, oluvannyuma otandike omuddugavu wekka era weetegereze ekitabo kye.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation
data.value: Okuggya ebintu mu nsi si kye kifuula ensi okuba ey'emirimu. Kozesa Funa Scenario okulonda ekifaananyi kino n'okukikuuma nga tonnaba kutandika. Ensimbi eziriwo tezigenda kukyusibwa butereevu.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileActivation
data.value: Loader/ensimu eyalondebwa esoma fayiro ezifulumiziddwa bw'otandika okuweereza. Okusookera ddala, jjuza enteekateeka z'omuwandiisi n'ebyetaago by'omugenyi, oluvannyuma weetegereze ekitabo ky'okutandika. Synix terina kutandika server.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Yimiriza omuddugavu, welonda ekintu ekikuumizibwa era kozesa Roll Back Import. Kino kizzaawo fayiro ezaali zikyusiddwa era kiggyawo fayiro empya okuva mu buyambi obwo; Enkyukakyuka eziddako ziyinza okulemesa okuddaabiriza. Tebuzzaawo nkyukakyuka mu nsi. Funa ekiwandiiko eky'okuyimirizaawo nga tonnaba kutandika.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery
data.value: Ssaamu omuddugavu n'otegeka olukalala lw'abakkiriza okweggyako ebikozesebwa oba okuzzaawo ekiragiro kyabwe ekyasooka. Kino tekiggyawo fayiro z'abawadde oba okuzzaawo enkyusa za mod ez'edda/ennyiriri z'ensi. Weeyongere okukuuma olukalala lw'abantu abakadde n'okuteekawo olupapula lwonna nga tonnaba kutandika.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioRecovery
data.value: Embeera ey'obuvunaanyizibwa oba ebikozesebwa ebikyaliwo biyinza okulemesa okuggibwawo.

data.name: Language.PreviewNotice
data.value: Okulabula okw'olubereberye: ebiragiro ebikulu bivvuunuddwa. Ebimu ku biyamba mu kutegeeza endwadde bikyali mu Lungereza.

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: Synix akkiriza ekyawandiikibwa eky'ensi yonna. Buli kibanja ekiri wansi kirina embeera yaakyo ey'obukakafu; obuwagizi bw'omutwe tebukakasa buwagizi bwa pasaala. Okutakkiriziganya tekitegeeza nti tekwesigamiziddwa era tekitegeeza nti etteeka erikwata ku Lungereza lyokka. Ekiwandiiko si kigezo kya buli kivvuunula ky'omuzannyo, ekiwandiiko ky'omugenyi oba enkola y'okuyingira.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Weeyongere okukuuma ebigambo eby'ekiddukiro nga bwe byateekebwawo: obubonero obwenkanankana buyinza okuba n'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo. Ebiragiro ebikyaliwo eby'okuzannya n'ebyeyawula ebikyaliwo bikyaliwo. Obukodyo obw'okulaga obutuufu, ID, amannya g'amafooda n'amannya g'abakozesa b'omuzannyi balina amateeka ag'enjawulo.

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Okunoonyereza okwakolebwa ku Intaneeti tekwakakasa nti waliwo obuwagizi bwa nsi yonna ku nsonga eno. Weekenneenye ekiwandiiko ky'omuzannyo era weetegereze abalungi b'omuzannyo nga tonnaba kwesiga. Ekifo ekikugiddwa mu Synix tekitegeeza nti kibeerawo mu muzannyo.

data.name: GameText.InvalidCatalog
data.value: Katalogi ey'okuwagira abalungi ku mudduwa si ya mugaso.

data.name: GameText.InvalidUnicode
data.value: {0} erimu enkola ya Unicode etatuukiridde. Ddamu oyingire; Synix teriddamu bigambo bya password oba erinnya mu ddoboozi ery'omunda.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: Euro Truck Simulator 2 erina okuggyayo fayiro ze z'ekaadi, DLC, ne mod package okuva mu mizannyo emisanvu nga server ey'enjawulo tennatandika. Goberera ebiteeso eby'okuteekawo ebiragiddwa; Synix ajja kuyingiza fayiro ezifulumiziddwa mu mudduuka ono.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Obukodyo bw'ekizikiza obuli ku ludda lw'abaweereza bukyaliwo, nga mw'otwalidde n'obukodyo bw'omutunzi bw'ebitabo ebikozesebwa. Enkola y'okuteeka ebintu mu nkola, ebyesigamiziddwa ku byo n'okukyusibwa kw'ensi bikwatagana n'omutindo gw'omuzannyo/omutendera; Tewali kigendererwa kya DLL ekiragiddwa.

data.name: Content.027ABB3BADA8C0B33854
data.value: Funa Mods ku nteekateeka y'ensi/ye server mu kifo ky'okukopya ZIP ey'omugaso. Steam ne crossplay/mod.io byawukana. Plugins z'abaweereza zeetaaga enteekateeka ennungi ey'okuteeka mu nkola abaweereza n'okuzimba plugins.

data.name: Content.02F77AA927B80C70293F
data.value:
EKY'OBUGANYA KIKULU KY'EKYetaagisa:
1. Bwatula omuweereza omulundi gumu okuleeta 'PCServer-UDKGame.ini', oluvannyuma ogimuggyeko.
2. Yiga fayiro okulabirira okutambula kwa mmapa n'emisingi egikwata ku kwonoona ttiimu.
3. Ekiwandiiko ky'Obuyinza: https://chivalrythegame.com/

data.name: Content.03C3E5851F1A6D5D93B8
data.value: Java erina rcon.password; Bedrock talina ntandikwa ya Java RCON. UTF-8 configuration support tekitegeeza nti buli kasitoma wa RCON alina engeri gye yeeyisaamu. Funa obukakafu ku muddubuzi n'omugenyi awamu.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Weeyongere okukuuma buli packet y'omutu n'eya filelist.xml wamu n'okuyamba packet mu nteekateeka ya server. Ebimu ku bintu ebikwataganyizibwa n'ebitabo ebikubibwa omukulembeze byesigamiziddwa ku kyawandiikibwa; okukakasa amakubo ag'omu maaso.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Kozesa ekitabo kino okuteekawo olupapula olusoose. Synix ekola ku kompyuta eno, bw'otyo leka kompyuta ng'abantu bazannya. Teweetaaga kulemba kiragiro kya kutandika okuteeka mu nkola ey'enjawulo.
1. Ggula Synix era olekere SteamCMD okwekebera okukomekkerezebwa. 2. Londa Add Server, oluvannyuma olina okuteekawo server empya. Bwe kiba nti fayiro z'omuddugavu zikyaliwo, mu kifo ky'ekyo sooka olonde Import Existing Server. 3. Ku General, jjuza erinnya ly'omuddugavu ery'enjawulo n'olonda omuzannyo. Bw'oba ng'osobola okusalawo ku nsonga eyo, fuba okulonda ekitundu ky'olupapula olwo, emizannyo gy'ozannyirako, oba ekirala kyonna. 4. Weeyongere okugoberera emitindo egyo okuggyako ng'olina ekintu ekirala ky'oyagala. Weekenneenye empapula z'okuteeka ezikkiriziddwa era ozuule obubaka obwetaagibwa obw'okuteeka wansi. 5. Salawo Save Server. Kino kyongerayo ekiwandiiko ku dashboard; tekitegeeza nti omuzannyo gukomekkerezebwa. 6. Londa ekiwandiiko ekyo n'olonda Start. Leka okulonda n'okuteekateeka okusooka okutandika okukomekkerezebwe, ng'ogoberera ebiragiro byonna Synix by'alaga. 7. Okumaliriza enteekateeka yonna ey'omuzannyo, gamba ng'endagaano, okuyingira mu akaawunti, oba okuteekawo akadde mu mulabirizi w'omupiira gw'omuzannyo. 8. Weegatta ku kompyuta eno oba ku kyuma ekirala ekiri ku mukutu gwo. Ekyo bwe kinaagenda mu maaso, fuba okusooka okukikozesa ng'otandise okukyusa oba okukola enkyukakyuka ezikulu.
Bw'Ofuna Obulumi Ggula Obwetegefu bw'omupiira gw'otaddewo era osome Activity & Diagnostics. Kolera ku nsobi ey'enjawulo mu kifo ky'okukubira Start enfunda n'enfunda. Ku Minecraft oba Satisfactory, ekitundu kya Game Guides kinnyonnyola amakubo ag'enjawulo.
Okukuŋŋaanya abantu abali ebweru w'omukutu gwo kye kintu ekyesigamiziddwa ku nkolagana. Okusookera ddala tukakasize nti olupapula lukolera mu kitundu.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Buli kiwandiiko kya dashboard kyetaaga erinnya lyakyo n'olupapula lw'okuteekawo. Synix efuula erinnya ly'omuddugavu erinnya lya Windows ery'obutebenkevu eri folda eyesigamiziddwa n'ebipimo eby'okutandika. Kino kikuuma ebitundu eby'enjawulo okuva ku kussaamu fayiro mu bugenderevu; si kyuma kya kompyuta oba enkomerero y'ebyokwerinda.
EBIWUNDU EBIGAMBA • C:\Synix ?? main Synix data workspace. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ?? ebikozesebwa mu kuzimba abaweereza. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? ensibuko y'omuggo gwa bulijjo. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? ebiwandiiko by'okusaba n'ebiwandiiko by'obutakkaanya.
Ebiwandiiko bya MSI by'okukozesa bibeera wansi wa %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Ebimu ku bintu bye wandyagadde n'ebintu ebyakuumibwa ku Windows nabyo biri mu akaawunti yo ya Windows.
EBIKWALA by'Ebisuubizo Kozesa Install & Launch ng'olonda olupapula lwa server. Okusobola okuteekawo ekintu ekipya, welonda olupapula lw'ebiwandiiko ekirimu ekifo ekimala eky'okuzannya omuzannyo n'obwesomesa. Teweerabiranga biwandiiko bibiri mu katabo kamu.
Open Server Folder ekiraga ekifo kyennyini ekya server eyalondeddwa. Open Backup Folder ekiraga ekifo eky'okuwagira; teweerabira kkubo lyonna okuva ku linnya ly'ekifaananyi.
ABANTU ABAWULIZIBWA basobola okubeera mu kifo ekirala Omuzannyo guyinza okukuŋŋaanya ensi mu AppData, Documents, drive endala, oba mu nkola yaagwo ey'okukozesa. Fuba okukakasa ekifo ekituufu omuzannyo kye guli nga tonnaggyayo oba nga tonnaggyayo.
Okukyusa erinnya oba okufulumya folda mu File Explorer tekitegeeza nti buli kkubo erigobeddwa lijja kukyusibwa. Kozesa Synix obuyambi bw'okufulumya/okukyusa emirimu n'okwetegereza amakubo nga tannaba kutandika. Ebitundu eby'enjawulo nabyo byetaaga ebifo eby'amasannyalaze ebitalina kukontana.
