data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers ekozesa Dedicated Server Manager ye ey'omu butongole, gye Synix erina okukuuma nga eriwo. Ku mulundi ogusoose okuggula, welonda Local/Console, welonda Continue to server configuration, weeyongere okuteeka enkola y'okuweereza n'ensi, era welonda Save & start. Kozesa omulabirizi w'ebintu eby'enjawulo, ensi, mods, abafuzi, n'ekifo kyayo. Synix ekwata ekifaananyi kino wansi w'olupapula lwa Instance olwa server. Enkola ya Local/Console ey'olubereberye tewetaaga ddembe lya maneja; okuteekawo Windows. Ebisaanyizo eby'obuyinza bye .NET Framework 4.8 oba ebipya, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 ne 2017, waakiri 6 GB z'ensimu RAM, ne UDP port 27016 ekkirizibwa okuyita mu Windows Firewall era eyasindikibwa mu kkubo eri abazannyi ba Intaneeti. Akakiiko akaakulembeddwamu: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Omukuumi alabirira enkola z'abaweereza ezimanyiddwa era asobola okutandika okuzza obuggya obukoleddwa oluvannyuma lw'okufuluma mu butanwa oba okuzuula ekizibu.
EKY'OKUKOLA OBULAMU Kozesa Synix's Stop and Restart controls okukola enkyukakyuka ez'omunda. Synix ekozesezza ebikolwa ebyo n'ekibinja eky'obulabirizi bwe kityo okukomya okukoleddwa tekukwatibwako ng'okubonaabona.
Okusiba ekifaananyi ky'omuzannyo, okukutta mu Task Manager, oba okukikomya okuyitira mu maneja omulala kiyinza okulabika nga tekisuubirwa era ne kiviirako okuwonawo.
BWE Baddamu Okutandika Yima omuddugavu ng'ayita mu Synix, oluvannyuma weekenneenye ekitabo ky'omuzannyo. Olina okugonjoola ekizibu eky'ekiseera ky'okutambuliramu, enkola y'okuteekawo, ekibuga, obwesige, oba ekizibu kya mod nga tonnaddamu kutandika. Okuzuukiza tekusobola kuggyawo mod ekitafaanaganira wamu oba okuteekateeka okw'omuzannyo.
Obunafu bw'enteekateeka n'ekibuuzo ekitafunibwa byawukana. Ekiseera eky'okuddamu okuwonawo kisinziira ku mizannyo n'embeera gy'olina mu kiseera kino, bwe kityo, tokkiriza kulwala buli kiwummulo ng'okozesa ekiseera ekimu.
EBIKWALA Synix eronda abatambuzi abawagirwa n'enkola z'omwana ezibeera ku muddu. Emizannyo egikozesebwa ebweru oba obuweereza obw'okuteeka mu nkola busobola okuwangaala omutambuzi n'obwetaavu bw'okubikuuma.
Enja ey'obukuumi si y'eyinza okudda mu kifo ky'ebiwandiiko ebikakasa oba okulabirira olupapula oluggya okukyusibwa ng'olutandise obulungi.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Kozesa Synix's lifecycle buttons ku nkola ya server. Kino kiyamba omukuumi okwawulawo okuyimirira n'obwegendereza ku kabenje.
START Londa ekiwandiiko n'olonda Start omulundi gumu. Synix yeetegereza ebisaanyizo ebikyaliwo, amakubo, ebifo, n'okukuuma ebikozesebwa nga tebinnatandika, ateekateeka fayiro ezaaliwo, era atandika okuweereza. Linda ekivudde mu kino osobole okuddamu okukigezaako.
STOP Salula Stop n'oleka ekiseera ky'omuzannyo okuwonya n'okusigala. Synix ekozesa okukomya okusinziirwamu nga bwe kiba kisoboka, oluvannyuma n'okukomya enkola ey'okuzikiriza mu mitendera singa kiba kyetaagisa. Okugonjoola kuyinza okuviirako omuntu okufiirwa ebikolwa bye.
KYOKOLA N'olonda Restart okuyimiriza ekibiina ky'enkola ekiriko kati n'okutandikawo ekimu ku byo. Tosaanidde kutandika kukoppolola mu ddwaaliro ng'ebyo bikyaliwo.
BWE KY'OBA OKUTEEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKKE Omulimu omulala guyinza okuba nga gukozesebwa dda ku muddubuzi, enkola y'okuyingira eyinza okuba mu mbeera ey'okukyuka, oba omuzannyo ogwo guyinza okukozesa obuweereza obw'ebweru. Soma obubaka obw'emirimu n'obusobozi bw'ekiwandiiko.
Weewale okutta omuddugavu mu Task Manager oba okumulemesa okuva ku ky'okukozesa ekitaliiko nkolagana gy'alina n'okuddaabiriza. Ekyo kiyinza okulabika ng'ekyewuunyisa era ne kiviirako omuntu okuddamu amaanyi.
Emizannyo egikolebwa okuyitira mu masimu ag'obuntu oba obuweereza obw'okuteekawo ebweru beetaaga okukebera obulamu bwabwe. Okusigalawo kw'ensimbi tekukakasa nti obuweereza obwo buyimiridde.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory yeetaaga okuteekebwawo mu server manager ye. Synix esobola okuteekawo n'okutandika omuddugavu omwetegefu, naye tegusobola kuggyawo kwogera ku muddugavu oba okutonda ekitundu kye.
ENTONDO y'Omupiira 1. Ssaawo ekiwandiiko Satisfactory era otandike mu Synix. 2. Linda omuweereza eyeewaddeyo okumaliriza okusitula. 3. Ggula Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager n'oggyako add oba select the server. 4. Weeyongere okukikola, otandike okukozesa ekigambo ky'ekigambo ky'omulabirizi, era weeyongere okuyingira ng'omulabirizi. 5. Ssaawo oba weeyongere okussa essimu gy'oyagala okukozesa.
Synix ekozesa ebisaanyizo eby'okufulumya/ebisaanyizo, nga mw'otwalidde ekifo eky'okufulumizamu ne MaxPlayers. Ebiwandiiko ebikolebwa biri wansi wa FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Yamba omuddugavu okutambulira ku -NewConsole. Check ebiwandiiko ebiggiddwa oba eby'edda; bw'oba ogatta ensonga eno, yaddamu okuyita mu Synix. 2. Kozesa Windows y'emu eri Synix n'eri server, okusingira ddala ebisaanyizo by'omukozesa. 3. Londa server eyo n'oggula Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Londa Connect automatically omulundi gumu n'olindako.
Synix esindika server.GenerateAPIToken, asoma ebyaggibwa byonna ebippya, akakasa API y'omu kitundu, era n'azika akabonero akaakwekebwa ku akaawunti yo eya Windows. Tokeni eno ewadde omulabirizi eddembe, so si kulabirira.
Ennyiriri z'obuwanguzi Token yakakasibwa era n'ekuumibwa mu ngeri ey'obwesige era n'eggula Overview. Tekikwetaagisa kukoppolola lugero lw'ekipiira oba okunteeka akabonero ako mu mikono.
Bwe kiggwaako, Synix esobola okukuuma akakwate konna akakuumibwa nga tannaba kuddamu kukozesa kiragiro ekyo. Soma ebyavaamu nga tonnaddamu kugezaako.
Kino kikwatagana ne server eyalondeddwa ku PC eno; tekwetaaga tteeka lya router eriggya ku Synix. Okutandika, okukomya, n'okuddamu okutandika bikyagenda mu maaso awatali API.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Londa ekiwandiiko kya dashboard n'oggula Server Options. Ebintu byokka ebikwataganyizibwa n'akabonero ako n'embeera yako kati bye biweereddwa.
AMAFIRI N'OKUKUMBIRA • Open Server Folder ne Open Backup Folder bisobola okuggula ebifo ebikozesebwa. • Omuwandiisi w'ebiwandiiko afuba okuggula fayiro z'ebiwandiiko by'omuzannyo. • Update Server etereka emizannyo egikwataganyizibwa. • Yamba okukakasa nti fayiro z'omuzannyo zikebeddwa oba zizimbibwa. • Okuddaabiriza n'okuzza obuggya okukuuma oba okuzza obuggya ekizimbe ekirondebwa. • Create Batch File etera okuggyayo ekikopo eky'okutandika nga profayiri ekirwanirira. • Delete evaamu ekiwandiiko n'ewa obusobozi bw'okuggyawo fayiro bwokka obuli mu kukakasibwa.
EBIYUMBA N'EBIYUMBA BY'Okwesanyusaamu Ebikwata ku nkolagana biraga amadirisa, ebifo, n'ebikolwa eby'okukoppolola. Ebigezo by'okugatta, Mod & Plugin Manager, Minecraft ebikozesebwa, ne Satisfactory Control Center birabika nga bikkirizibwa.
OMUweereza Abeera mu Buwanguzi Koppako emirundi ebiri ku lugero lwayo okusobola okumanya ebisingawo. Live Process Details erina ebikozesebwa ebikakasibwa, abasuubuzi b'ekifo ky'okuwummuliramu, n'enkola z'abakozi eziri mu kiwandiiko ekyo. Omuzannyo oguliko enkola ennyingi gusobola okuba n'ekika ky'enkola esinga ku kimu.
Kozesa omulabirizi w'ebikozesebwa okukebera CPU y'omupiira ogwo n'ebyafaayo by'eddembe. Okusoma kuno kwawukana ku kivvulu kya kompyuta yonna.
Okusiba akasanduuko k'ebintu oba akawungeezi k'eby'obugagga tekimalako muzannyo. Kozesa ekiragiro "Stop" eky'oku ttivi bw'oba oyagala okukikola.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Funa eddiyo ya Minecraft nga tonnaba kusala mods oba entekateeka z'okugatta. Java ne Bedrock ze zimu ku ngeri z'abaweereza; Bedrock si loader ya Java.
LOWOOZA OMUKONDA 1. Ssaawo ekiwandiiko Minecraft n'olonda Java oba Bedrock. 2. Ku Java, welonda enkola ya Minecraft, loader, ne enkola ya loader ekwatagana ey'abalabirizi. 3. Laba ensi, engeri y'okuzannyamu, ekkomo ly'omuzannyi, obukakafu, ebifo eby'okukuuma, n'ebitundu eby'ebyokwerinda ebikkirizibwa. 4. Save and Start through Synix. 5. Soma endagaano yonna oba otandike okugitandika nga tonnakkiriza. 6. Linda ensi okumaliriza okusitula, oluvannyuma weegatta n'ekitabo ky'omugenzi ekikwatagana n'eky'okuvvuunula. 7. Weeyongere okukola emirimu gy'omu nsi nga tonnaba kuddamu.
Java NA BEDROCK Java by'osalawo birimu Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, ne Purpur nga wabaawo ebikozesebwa. Kozesa enkyusa n'okuteekawo eby'okulonda; Paper ne Purpur bakozesa plugins, ate Fabric, Forge, ne NeoForge bakozesa mods zaabwe. Synix afulumya ekiseera eky'okutambuliramu ekiragiddwa okuva ku muweereza we ow'obuyinza.
Bedrock ekozesa enkola ya Bedrock Dedicated Server n'etakozesa Java.
YINGIRIZA ENKONDO Salawo loader eyagambibwa abagenyi bo. Gisaana ne Minecraft eddiini, loader, ebyesigamiziddwa, n'ebisaanyizo byonna eby'omugenyi.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, n'ebipakiti bya plugin-server tebikyusibwa. Okutonda folda ya mods oba plugins tekuteeka loader oba entegeka y'omuddugaza gye yeetaaga. Browse Catalog si modpack oba installation y'obwesigika.
EKY'OKULONDA Configure efuga server.properties n'obutonde obukwata ku nkyusa. Java era esobola okukuyamba mu ngeri ya Spectator. Ebisaanyizo n'ebiragiro bya tekinologiya bibeera nga Minecraft bw'etusuubira.
Mu Server Options, ggula Minecraft Control Center. Olupapula lw'Ebikyusibwa lulaga fayiro z'okuteeka ezikozesebwa ku muddu. Edit File efulumya editing y'ebigambo; Structured Editor ebawa omutegeka w'ebitundu ebiriwo. Bombi bikwata ku nkyukakyuka ng'omuweereza akyekeddwa. Ebitundu bya server.properties ebimanyiddwa nga port, player limit, world, seed, mode, and command-channel settings nabyo bikyusizza entandikwa ya Synix eyafulumizibwa. Erinnya/MOTD erisangibwa mu bulangirizi liyawukana ku linnya ly'okuyingira ery'omu kitundu. Ebitonde by'ebifaananyi ebitaali bimanyiddwa bibeera mu fayiro zaabwe.
Synix addamu okusoma enkola eno nga tannaba kukyusa oba okutandika, era ne bwe kigenda okukozesebwa nga kiyimiriddwa. Bwe kiba nti eddiyo ey'ebweru si ya bwenkanya oba ng'ekontana n'ekiwandiiko ekirala, mugonjoole ekizibu kino mu kifo ky'okutandika okuweereza enfunda n'enfunda. Omukulembeze agaana okuwandiika ku fayiro eyakyusiddwa okuva lwe yaggulwa; yaddamu okugiggula okussaamu ebintu ebipya.
EKY'OKUKUBIRA OBULAMU BWA Sserva Weeyongere okuteekawo olupapula lw'obuwagizi nga tonnakyusa byavvuunula oba ebikozesebwa. Londa ekiseera ekiggya eky'okutambuliramu mu Setup, bumba ekiwandiiko ekikyusiddwa, oluvannyuma welonda Apply Runtime mu Minecraft Control Center. Synix etegeka runtime ey'obuyinza okwawukana, ekuuma server.properties n'amafooda ag'ensi yonna, era n'okuwandiika fayiro z'ekiseera eky'okutambuliramu ezaazimbiddwa. Tekyatandika kuweereza. Okutandika kukuziyizibwa ng'ekiseera eky'okutambuza ekiragiddwa n'akabonero akakoleddwa tekkiriziganya.
Okuggyawo fayiro tekuggyawo nkyukakyuka z'ensi ezikolebwa oluvannyuma lw'okuteeka ku nkola. Tokitwala nti ensi eyaggulwa ne Minecraft empya oba enkola ez'enjawulo zisobola okutwalibwa mu ngeri ey'obutebenkevu nga zikozesebwa mu biseera eby'edda; Mu kifo ky'ekyo, baddemu ebyuma byonna ebituukirawo.
Ema nga tonnakyusa fayiro eziba zeetaaga okuddaabirizibwa. Teweerabiranga nsi eriwo n'essomero eriggya ng'ekkubo ly'okuddaabiriza.
OMUTANSI bw'Atasobola Kubeerawo Weekenneenye eddiyo, emizannyo/embeera z'okuzimbamu, mods ze weetaaga, n'ekifo ekituufu eky'okuzimbamu/protocol y'eddiyo eryo. Bw'oba oyagala okufuluma mu kiseera ekitali kya wala, weetegereze mu katabo k'emizannyo obanga waliwo ensobi eziri mu kukkiriza, mu kiseera ky'okutambuliramu, mu ndowooza, oba mu ngeri gye weesigamye ku bintu.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Ggula Satisfactory Control Center oluvannyuma lw'okugatta API y'omu kitundu. Londa obubonero bw'omulimu gw'oyagala.
AMAGEZI G'Okukebera Funa Refresh osome erinnya ly'omukolo, omuwendo gw'abazannyi abakwatiddwa, embeera y'omuzannyo, omuwendo gwa tick, ekiseera ky'okuzannya, n'ekitundu ky'obuchwepheshe.
Dasiboodi y'ekiyimba ekibalirira okukyusibwa mu butereevu ng'okugatta kuli bulungi; Ekiwandiiko ky'ekitabo ekirimu ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana n'ebiwandiiko ebirimu ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana n'ebiwandiiko ebyo. API eno ereeta okubala, so si lukalala lw'abakinnyi. Enkuŋŋaana eziyimiriddwa oba omuweereza alindirira enkuŋŋaana teziyimiriddwa.
EBIGAMBO BYA SERVER Genda ku Fresh, olina okukyusa ebisaanyizo ebikwataganyizibwa, era oluvannyuma Weeyongere okukola enkyukakyuka. Yongera okukebera ebisaanyizo ebibaddewo oluvannyuma lw'okuzza obuggya. Ebimu by'osobola okukola byetaaga okutandikawo nate; Okukola enkyukakyuka tekitegeeza nti omuzannyo gutandise nate.
Okuteeka amakubo n'ebisaanyizo ebikkirizibwa bikyali mu lulimi lw'omuzannyo.
EBIKONDO EBIYOMBWA • Weekuumire kati: Yiga erinnya oba kozesa erinnya erya Synix ery'edda. Okuddamu okukozesa erinnya kisobola okuggyawo ekimu ku bintu ebikyaliwo. • Omulimu gw'okukozesa gwalondebwa: Weekenneenye obukakafu. Synix essaawo enkulaakulana ey'omu kiseera kino ng'olukiiko lugenda mu maaso; Okutambuza ebintu bisobola okusaanyaawo abazannyi. • Upload save: Agattako fayiro eyalondeddwa era ayinza okudda mu kifo ky'okuteeka eddiini eyalina erinnya limu. Tekizitwala ng'ekintu eky'omuwendo. • Download y'olonda: Ekyusa kopi ku kkubo ly'oyagala.
Beera n'ebyuma eby'okuyimirizaawo nga tonnassaawo oba nga tonnatwala nsi yonna. Ensimbi z'okukuuma zirina ekkomo ly'obutebenkevu 512 MB. API eyinza obutabeerawo mu kiseera ekitali kya wala ng'omulimu guba gugenda mu maaso.
EKY'OKUKUMBA EKY'OBUZIMA Tuma ekiragiro kimu eky'omuzannyo oguyambibwako omulundi gumu era osome obukakafu. Scripts, ebiragiro bya token/password, n'okukyusakyusa okw'okutuuka mu ngeri etali nnongoofu biziikiddwa wano.
Ebiragiro by'okuyimiriza ebikwataganyizibwa bitambuzibwa okuyitira mu Synix's stop workflow. Ekiragiro ekifulumiramu kibeera mu ddirisa lino mu kifo ky'okuteekebwa ku dashboard oba ku Synix text logs; omuzannyo guyinza n'okusigala nga gwawandiika ebiwandiiko byawo.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Omutunzi w'ebiwandiiko buli plugin subfolders for Java-edition server plugins. Enkyusa za kati n'ez'edda zikozesa API ez'enjawulo; okukakasa eddiyo eyateekebwawo n'enkola ya plugin nga tonnaba kukozesa kigendererwa.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
AMAFIRIMU G'EKITONDO EKY'EKITONDO KIGENDERERWA:
Synix essaako akasanduuko aka server ey'enjawulo naye tasobola kuvvuunula, kukoppolola, oba kusasulira fayiro eziri mu layisensi okuva ku mizannyo emisanvu. Singa omuweereza alaga nti waliwo ebintu eby'enjawulo ebitalabika oba nga wabaddewo obubenje ng'oyimiriza oba ng'akyusa mmaapu, ggyamu Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer okuyitira mu Steam ng'okozesa akaawunti eyalina ekiwandiiko ekyo. Kopya mpsrc multiplayer content okuva ku game installation mu folda eno ey'omubbi, era beera mukakafu nti mapcycle.txt ne maplist.txt zirimu mmaapu z'oyagala okutambuza.
Ekitundu kino kirina okukolebwa omukozesa ng'atuula ku mudduuka. Emizannyo gy'omuzannyo gwe 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, ne 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Soma ekivudde mu Connect nga tonnaddamu kugezaako. Ekiragiro ekiragibwa mu kasolya k'emizannyo tekiraga nti okukwata, okukakasa, n'okuziika byonna byasobodde.
LOWOOZA OKUBUKA • Console etasobola kubaawo: Kakasa -NewConsole, olupapula lwe walonda, n'ebipimo by'eddembe Windows ebikwatagana. • Ekiragiro ekitali kikomekkerezebwa mu kiwandiiko ky'okukozesa: Kiggyawo wekka. Synix tagenda kukyusa. • Ekiragiro kigenda mu maaso naye tewali kabonero ke kakwatibwa: Leka okutandika kumale, kola akafaananyi ku mizannyo egisobola okuwandiikibwa, era okkiriza okufuluma okuppya okujja. • Ebivvulu biyingirira: Ggyamu ebivvulu ebikwatagana n'ebyo ebikwatagana n'ebivvulu ebikwatagana n'ebivvulu ebikwatagana n'ebivvulu. • Port ya API egenda mu nkola endala: Yamba ekibuga ky'omuzannyo ekikoleddwa ku muddubi gw'olonda. Toweereza kabonero ako eri omuwulizi atali munno mu bufumbo. • Token eyagaaniddwa oba ey'okugatta eyakuumibwa teyisobola kuggulwa: Yiga enteekateeka y'omuzannyo, oluvannyuma oggyemu okugifuula. • API tebikyaliwo: Linda okuzimbibwa oba weekuumire okuzimbibwa era weetegereze akawandikiro k'omuzannyo.
Eky'okuddamu ekippya kiyinza okuba n'omugaso gwe gumu ng'eky'okuddamu ekyayita. Capture ekozesa output eyafulumizibwa oluvannyuma lw'ekiragiro, so si akabonero ak'edda mu log.
OKUKUBA oba OKUKOLA OKUSINZIIRA Satisfactory efulumya obubonero bw'omulabirizi mu kyuma kye n'ebitabo. Bafuule ba siriimu era baggyeko emizingo gy'obubonero mu bifaananyi by'okukozesa ne mu lipoota.
Synix ekakasa nti enkomerero y'ekifo kino ye server eyalondeddwa era n'ekakasa obukakafu bwayo. Teweerabiranga kukebera kwa ssemateeka okusobola okugonjoola obutali bwenkanya.
Ggyayo akabonero akakuumibwa kaggyako enkolagana eya Synix eyakuumibwa; tekuggyawo kabonero ku muddu.
Okusobola okuggyawo obubonero obw'okukozesa ebikozesebwa, kozesa server.InvalidateAPITokens mu Satisfactory'Console ya server ye oba Console ya Server Manager. Kino kikwata ne ku by'okugatta ebirala ebikozesa obubonero obwo.
Ku akaawunti endala eya Windows oba ekizimbe ekiggiddwa, yaddamu okukikwataganya bw'eba nga tekisoboka kukozesa nkolagana eyakuumibwa.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Soma ekitabo ky'emirimu n'emizannyo eby'oluvannyuma ku muddubuzi gw'olondawo. Fuba okunoonya obuzibu obwasooka mu kifo ky'okunoonya obubaka obw'okuyimirizaawo.
OKUTONDA OKUTONDA oba OKUTONDA OKUTONDA 1. Kakasa olupapula lw'okuteeka, ekikozesebwa, olupapula lw'omuzannyo, n'omutandiika gwe walonda. 2. Weekenneenye fayiro ezisaanyisibwa, RAM/disk space y'eddembe, n'ebifo ebituukiddwako. 3. Weetaaga okujjuza endagaano yonna, okuyingira mu akaawunti, obwetaavu bw'obubonero, oba okuteekawo ekitundu ky'omuzannyo. 4. Okumanya engeri ezikozesebwamu, geraageranya omuzannyo, loader, ebyesigamiziddwa ku muntu, n'ebigendererwa by'omugenyi. 5. Ssaawo Synix nga tonnakyusa fayiro, oluvannyuma gezaako.
Omutambuzi ow'obulamu asobola okusigala ng'omuddugavu omutuufu avuddeyo. Sserva ey'obulamu era esobola okulinda okusitulwa okw'ensi yonna oba okuba n'ekibuuzo ekitafunibwa/API. Weekenneenye ebitundu ebyo byokka.
KITwala Obudde Okukomawo oba Okuddamu Okukola Emizannyo gyetaaga ekiseera okusobola okuwonya n'okukomya ebikolwa by'abakozi. Linda Synix okuzuula era osome obubaka bwe. Omuntu bw'agwa mu kabi, asobola okulekera awo okukulaakulana.
Tokomya mirimu mu kiseera kye kimu, otandike kopi endala, oba okozesa maneja omulala ku nteekateeka y'emu.
Ekintu eky'Okusobola Okukola oba Ebintu by'Okozesa Bibuze Fuba okukebera obusobozi bw'ekifaananyi n'embeera y'ebintu. Enkola ezimu ziyimiriddwa olw'okuba omuzannyo gubirina oba olw'okuba tewali kkubo ly'obukulembeze liliko. N/A player data si y'ekintu ekivuddemu obutali bwenkanya bwa server.
Bwe kiba nti ekizibu ekyo tekinnaggwaawo, fuba okuwandiika ekikolwa ekyo, ensobi gye wakola, n'ekitundu ekimala eky'olupapula lw'amawulire olukoleddwa nga tonnakola nkyukakyuka endala.

2. Longoosa fayiro z'obutonde bw'abaweereza okusalawo okukyusa enkola y'okuyimba n'okukugira abazannyi.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
OKUSIMBULA oba Okussaawo Server MODPACK 1. Fuba okuddaabiriza olupapula lwonna n'okuyimiriza olupapula. Kozesa Synix ng'olina ebisaanyizo bya Windows. 2. Ssaawo n'otandika okukozesa enkyusa ya Minecraft, loader, ne loader. 3. Mu Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, welula Import Server Pack. Londa Modrinth .mrpack oba ZIP ey'obuweereza obujjuvu erimu mods/plugins ez'amazima n'ebiwandiiko by'enteekateeka. 4. Mods z'omuddugavu ez'okwesalirawo ziggibwawo okuggyako ng'okuteekawo mods z'omuddugavu ez'okwesalirawo kulondeddwa. Modrinth entuuyo z'omugenyi zokka n'ebiwandiiko by'omugenzi ebikwataganyizibwa nabyo tebifulumizibwa. 5. Weekenneenye ebivudde mu kunoonyereza, okukebera metadata, omutindo gw'omutwe ogutabaamu, n'ebiwandiiko byonna ebigenda okwongerwako, okuddaabirizibwa, oba okuggibwawo. Bikkirize kyokka singa ensibuko n'enkyukakyuka bikyali bituufu. 6. Tandika okukikozesa oluvannyuma lw'okuteekawo, soma ekiteeso, era gezaako okukebera akakwate ak'omugenyi.
Omufulumizi tassa mu nkola biwandiiko bya kutandika ebiweereddwa mu mpeke, takyusa nsi, wadde okuwandiika ku server.properties. Download server pack ey'omuwandiisi bw'eba ng'ekiteeka kya CurseForge kirimu ekiragiro ky'okukoppolola kyokka. Okuzannya ebintu eby'ekyama, host ezitawagirwa, oba loaders ezitawagirwa zeetaaga fayiro z'omuwandiisi eziwagirwa; Synix teyeefiiriza buzibu bwa bawagizi.
Modrinth downloads ze ziddukiddwa. Metadata ya JAR eyesigamiziddwa yeetegerezebwa ku loader, omutindo gw'omugenyi gwokka, ID ez'enjawulo, n'obwesigika obwategekeddwa awatali kutambuza JAR. Obulungi bw'ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana n'ebiwandiiko by'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo tebitegeerekeka. Okukebera obulungi oba obutasobola kulaba buzibu bwonna tekitegeeza nti mod erina obukuumi oba nti ekwatagana. Enkolagana ezisooka tezitwalibwa mu bugenderevu.
Okuyingiza mu kibinja kye kimu ekiyitibwa kisobola okuggyawo JAR ezikoleddwa edda nga tezikyaliwo, naye ng'ezo fayiro zikyagenda mu maaso n'okutuusa ku hash ezaazimbiddwa. JAR n'ebiwandiiko by'ensi ebitali mu buyinza tebiggibwawo. Ebiwandiiko by'okuteekawo ebiweereddwa mu kivvulu ekiggya bisobola okudda mu kifo ky'ebiwandiiko eby'edda; Ebisooka bibalaga nga tonnakkiriza. Kwata erinnya ly'essanduuko y'e-server-ZIP lye limu ng'okolera packet eyo okusobola okukitegeera ng'ekikonde kye kimu.
OBUKULU BWA BULUNGU Kozesa Ensi okuwandiika ensi ezimanyiddwa. Yingiza World ZIP ekikopo ekimu eky'ensi ekikwatagana n'ekitabo mu folda empya eyitibwa; tekikoma kuwandiika nsi eriwo oba okukyuka wakati wa Java ne Bedrock. Funa ensi eyateekebwawo n'okukolamu ensi okukyusa linnya ly'omutindo n'ensi ya Synix wamu. Okutandika okw'okubiri kuzimba ensi eyalondeddwa. Okukyusa ensigo kukwata ku kuzaala ensi empya, so si nsi eriwo kati.
EKY'OKUKOLA Okuzuula kuwandiika enkyukakyuka ez'omu fayiro ezikoleddwa mu kifo kino. Undo ezzaawo fayiro ez'olubereberye eziwandiikiddwa oba efuna fayiro ezaateekebwawo enkyukakyuka eyo. Ggyayo ensi ey'ebbeeyi nga tonnaggyawo nsi eyo ey'ebbeeyi. Synix bw'alemererwa okuwandiika fayiro ezo oluvannyuma; okukuuma ebikyusibwa era n'okukozesa ekiwandiiko ekituufu eky'obwesige bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
Okuddamu okuddaabiriza okukyaliwo kuddamu okutuusa ng'okuddamu kumalirizibwa n'ekiwandiiko ekirokoleddwa kikwatagana n'ebiwandiiko ebyaddemu okuddaabirizibwa. Ebizimbe eby'edda ebitali na kabonero k'ekiseera ky'okutambuliramu ekiragiddwa byetaaga okuddaabirizibwa kwonna okusobola okuzzaawo ekiseera ky'okutambuliramu. Backups zikyagenda mu maaso ng'ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza ebya server-folder, nga tebikwatagana n'ebiwandiiko by'enkyukakyuka ezimu.
Oluvannyuma lw'okuzza obuggya entegeka y'obwesimbu mu bujjuvu, ebiwandiiko eby'edda ebikyusakyusibwa mu kifo ky'ekifo ky'okukola biwandiikiddwa ng'ebiwandiiko ebyo bye byasimbiddwa entegeka y'obwesigye. Zisigadde nga zirabika ng'ebikozesebwa, naye tezisobola kuggibwawo ku fayiro ezirongooseddwa. Okuggya oba okukyusa omutindo oluvannyuma lw'okuddaabiriza kireetawo ebiwandiiko ebipya eby'okuddaabiriza.
EBIKAMU N'EBIKAMU Okusoomoozebwa kusoma ebitundu eby'okuddaabiriza ebivuddeko n'ebivuddemu ebya Java, ebizibu by'okujjukira, okwesigama, ekifo, ensi, n'ebiseera eby'okukyuka. Tewali kifaananyi kyonna ekizuuliddwa si bukakafu obulaga nti omuweereza mulamu bulungi. Ebirungi by'obuvunaanyizibwa bisobola okuggulawo omulabirizi w'ebikozesebwa; CPU ne RAM ez'okulonda si ze zisinga okuteekawo akabonero k'omutindo gw'empaka.
Essuula ziggula Synix eziriwo okuddaabiriza n'okuddaabiriza. Londa ennaku ze wandyagadde, essaawa, engeri omuzannyi gy'alindamu, bye wandyagadde okukola, n'engeri gye wandyagadde okukyusibwamu. Ekifo ky'emirimu tekikola nteekateeka ey'okubiri oba okukyusa enteekateeka yo mu butereevu.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Genda ku Minecraft, oluvannyuma oggule Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Empapula za Console ne Players zikweka command ne player tools wamu. Empapula endala ziwa ebisaanyizo, ensi, ebyongerezeddwako, eby'okuziyiza ku sseraeva yonna, okuddaabiriza enteekateeka, okuwonawo, n'okulaba obulwadde.
EBIGAMBA BY'EBIGAMBA Enkola ezikozesebwa zisobola okukozesa ekiteeso ekifugibwa Synix, enkola ey'okukuuma localhost, oba RCON ey'okwesalirawo. Enkola eriwo yeesigamye ku kivvulu n'enteekateeka y'omuddugaza.
Olutindo olufiiriddwa luyinza okuleka ekkubo ly'ekiragiro eky'omu kitundu ekiriko obuyambi. Bwe kiba nti obuyinza bulemereddwa, gezaako okukakasa nti olupapula lugenda mu maaso era nti ebisaanyizo byalwo eby'okulabirira bikyali bituufu.
EBIKOLWA Synix bw'eba nga yeesigamiziddwa, efulumya okulangirira, olukalala lw'abazannyi, okulongoosa, okukyusakyusa kw'omukozi n'omuwandiisi w'ebiwandiiko, okufuga ebiseera/embeera y'obudde, n'okuwonya.
Londa omuzannyi gw'oyagala era osome ekikolwa ekyo nga tonnakikkiriza. Okuwa omulabirizi eddembe ly'okuzannya emizannyo. Tokkiriza kubaako ky'okolawo okusobola okugonjoola ekizibu eky'okubeera n'enkolagana.
EBIKONDO EBIKA Kozesa ebigambo ebitegekeddwa mu kiwandiiko ekyo. Ebiragiro gamba ng'olukalala n'okukuuma byonna bye birimu emizannyo era tebivvuunulwa na interface ya Synix. Weetegereze amateeka g'omuzannyo nga tonnatuma kiragiro ekikyusa ensi oba ebisaanyizo.
ABANTU N'Amannya Ekibuuzo kisobola okuwa omuwendo gw'abazannyi awatali lunyiriri lw'abatuuze. Olukalala lw'amannya tegulaga nti tewali muntu yenna yeekwataganye.
Kozesa ekitebe ky'okuyimiriza oba okuddamu okutandika okukola enkyukakyuka mu bulamu bw'omuntu okusobola okulaba nti omulabirizi amanyi nti okuyimirizaawo kubadde kwa bugenderevu.
Weeyongere okukuuma RCON oba endpoints z'obukulembeze nga ziri mu bifo byammwe okuggyako ng'olina enteekateeka ey'okufuga okuva ku wala. Emizannyo gy'abantu bonna tegitegeeza nti ebisaanyizo ebyo oba enkomerero zikozesebwa.

data.name: Content.F91F63CB8463862C6775
data.value:
SYNIX CONTROL PANEL
Okuvvuunulwa kwa layisensi 1.4 ?? November 11, 2026
Kino kye kivvuunula kya layisensi, so si kya Synix. Copyright © 2026 Jason Turner Obuyinza Bwonna Buweereddwa. Amerika Enkola ey'okuwandiisa ebitabo by'obukulembeze bw'obutonde bw'abantu
License eno eyogera ku Synix Control Panel software, nga mw'otwalidde code yaayo ensibuko, binaries ezikoleddwa, user interface, documentation, artwork, logos, n'ebintu ebirala ebizingirwamu (mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, software).
Ebitundu 13 ne 14 nabyo byogera ku bikolwa eby'okukuuma eby'ekyama ku mukutu gwa Synix ogwa ofiisi, omuwendo gw'emirimu, n'omulabirizi ow'ewala ow'okwesalirawo. Bogera ku buweereza obutuuseeko; teziggyako layisensi ey'obuntu, ey'obutaba ya bya bugagga erisangibwa wansi.
1. Obuyinza
Ssoftware erina layisensi, terutundibwa.
Jason Turner akwata obuyinza bwonna, ekitiibwa, n'omuganyulo mu na ku Software, nga mw'otwalidde ebiragiro byonna eby'obukulembeze n'obwannannyini obw'amagezi. Tewajja kuweebwa buyinza bwonna okusinziira ku layisensi eno.
2. Okuweebwa layisensi ez'enjawulo
Okusinziira ku mateeka gonna agali mu layisensi eno, okkirizibwa okufuna layisensi erina ekkomo, eritagobererwa, eritayinza kusindikibwa, eritayinza kusindikibwa, era erisobola okuggibwawo:
- Download era kozesa programu ku bwetaavu bwo, obutali bwa bya bugagga. - Laba n'oyiga koodi y'ensibuko. - Funa kopi ez'oku ddwaaliro ez'okukozesa. - Yamba omuntu okukyusa koodi y'ensibuko asobole okugikozesa mu bujjuvu. - Yiga n'okukozesa ebikozesebwa by'olina oba by'oyinza okufuga.
Obuyinza bwonna obutabaweebwa layisensi eno buweereddwa omwami ow'obukulembeze.
3. Enkyukakyuka ez'Omuntu
Osobola okukyusa programu okusobola okutuukiriza ebyetaago byo.
Enkyukakyuka ez'obuntu zirina okusigala nga za kyama okuggyako nga Jason Turner akuwadde olukusa olw'okubikuba.
Tokkirizibwa kukuba, kussa, kugabana, okufulumya, okusaasaanya, oba okuteeka koodi y'ensibuko eyakyusiddwa oba binaries ezakyusibwa ku bifo ebya bulijjo ng'ennyiriri ez'enjawulo eza Synix.
4. Ebisaanyizo
Tokkirizibwa, awatali kukkiriza okw'omuwandiisi okuva eri Jason Turner:
4.1 Okukozesa mu by'obusuubuzi
- Okuguza, okupangisa, okupangisa, okugaba layisensi, okugaba layisensi, oba okusasula ku programu. - Okutunda oba okusaasaanya binaries ezikyusiddwa oba ezitakyusiddwa. - Kozesa programu oba koodi y'ensibuko ng'ekitundu ky'ekintu ekisasulwa oba obuweereza obw'obusuubuzi. - Okufuna enkizo ey'okugaba, okugaba layisensi, okuddaabiriza oba okufuna programu.
4.2 Okugabanyizibwa n'Okutambuza Abantu
- Upload, mirror, or host the Software on another website, repository, download service, file sharing platform, or application store. - Okusaasaanya enkola y'ensibuko oba ebibinja ebikwataganyizibwa, ka bibe bikyusiddwa oba nga tebikyusiddwa. - Ssa oba bifulumizenga ebikozesebwa eby'okuteekawo ebitaali bya mu mateeka, ebipakiti ebituukiddwako, ebifaananyi, oba download links. - Okufulumya ebivvuunulwa okuva ku ffujjo oba kopi eyakyusiddwa ey'E programu. - Okuteekawo ekifaananyi, enkyukakyuka, oba enkola ey'okuvvuunula ng'ekintu ekitaliimu oba eky'okuvuganya.
4.3 Okuddaabiriza n'Okukwasa
- Ggyamu, kikweka, oba kikyusa erinnya lya Synix, ebiragiro by'obukulembeze bw'ebitabo, ebiwandiiko by'abawandiisi, ebiragiro bya layisensi, amalogo, oba obuwandiike. - Okukyusa erinnya oba okukyusa erinnya ly'Entegeka y'Ebintu ku lw'okufulumya oba okugigaba eri abantu. - Yagamba nti ye yatonda programu eyasooka. - Kozesa erinnya lya Synix oba obubonero mu ngeri etegeeza bulimba obuwagizi, okusiimibwa, obumu, oba embeera ey'obuyinza.
4.4 Reverse Engineering and Protection Bypass
Okusinziira ku mateeka agakkirizibwa, tosobola kukyusa enkola ya tekinologiya, okuggyawo, okuggyawo, oba okugezaako okukyambula ebiwandiiko by'obukkiriza, okwewaayo, ebitundu eby'obukuumi, okukebera ebikyusibwa, oba obubonero obuli mu kiwandiiko ekiriko obubaka.
Ekiragiro kino tekikugira ddembe lyonna ery'obutakkirizibwa erikuweebwa etteeka eryaliwo.
5. GitHub Ebirungo n'Ebintu Ebiweereddwa
Ekiwandiiko kya Synix kisobola okulabika mu lujjudde ku GitHub. GitHub'platform esobola okuleka abakozesa okulaba n'okukuba entegeka y'abantu okuyita mu GitHub's built-in functionality.
Fork ya GitHub etakkiriza:
- Bafulumizenga ekiwandiiko ekitali kya mu mateeka ekya Synix. - Okusaasaanya binaries ezikyusiddwa oba ezitaakyusibwa. - Rebrand Synix. - Okukozesa olupapula lw'okukoppolola abantu oba ekifaananyi ekyawukana. - Buulira ekiwaawaatiro ng'ensimu yo. - Okusaasaanya Entegeka y'Obusuubuzi ng'oggyeko obusobozi obutonotono obuweebwa GitHub.
GitHub fforks zisobola okukozesebwa okunoonyereza ku koodi, okuteekateeka ekiwandiiko, oba okusindika okusaba okuggya mu ddwaaliro lya Synix. Enkyukakyuka ez'omuntu yennyini ezitaweebwayo ng'omugabo zirina okusigala nga ziri mu kitundu era nga za bwenkanya.
Bw'oweereza ekitabo ky'ensibuko, obuwandiike, ebifaananyi, oba ekiwandiiko ekirala mu ddwaaliro lya Synix, otegeeza nti olina eddembe okukitumiza era n'okuwa Jason Turner layisensi ey'olubeerera, ey'ensi yonna, etali ya bwenkanya, ey'obutayinza kuggibwawo, ey'eddembe ly'obwetaavu bw'okukozesa, okuzzaawo, okukyusa, okufulumya, okusaasaanya, okussaako layisensi, n'okuteeka ekiwandiiko ekyo mu Synix.
6. Synix Erinnya n'ekitiibwa
Erinnya lya Synix, logo, obubonero obw'okulaba, n'ebirala ebikwatagana nabyo bikyali bya Jason Turner.
Tewaweebwa layisensi ya kabonero oba ya kabonero kano okuggyako okulaga erinnya lya Synix eritalina kukolebwa enkyukakyuka ng'okozesa Programu.
Okukozesa Synix okutagobererwa kiyinza okwonoona amateeka agakwata ku ddembe ly'obukulembeze, akabonero k'obusuubuzi, empaka ezitali za bwenkanya, oba amateeka amalala.
7. Okuggibwawo
Obuyinza bwo wansi wa layisensi eno buyimirira bw'obutta ku tteeka lya layisensi eno.
Oluvannyuma lw'okuggyawo, olina:
- Leka okukozesa n'okukyusa programu. - Leka okugaba oba okulaga kopi yonna ey'obutakkirizibwa. - Ggyamu kopi ezitali zimu, ebifulumiziddwa, ebifaananyi, oba ebikozesebwa okuvvuunula ebiriko obuyinza bwo. - Funa kopi z'ebiwandiiko by'omuntu bw'oba ng'olina okubikolerako.
Ebitundu ebikwata ku bwenkanya, ebisaanyizo, ebiweebwayo, okugaana obuvunaanyizibwa, n'okukangavvula bikyaliwo.
8. Okuteeka mu nkola
Omukuumi w'ebiwandiiko eby'obukulembeze ayinza okunoonya obuyambi bwonna obwesigamiziddwa ku mateeka agakkirizibwa ku bikwata ku kukoppolola, okubunyisa, okukuŋŋaanya abantu mu lujjudde, okutunda, okuddaabiriza erinnya lyabwe, oba ekintu ekirala kyonna ekikontana n'amateeka.
Eby'okulongoosa ebiyinza okubaawo biyinza okuzingiramu okusaba okuggibwawo, enkola ez'okuggyawo ekitebe, obuyambi obw'okuvunaanibwa, ebisago, n'eby'okulongoosa ebirala eby'obwenkanya nga bwe kiba kyetaagisa mu mateeka.
Tewali kintu kyonna mu layisensi eno ekikakasa nti etteeka erimu ery'okukangavvula lijja kubaawo mu buli buyinza.
9. Okutwalibwa kw'Ebizibu n'Okukugira Obwetaavu
SOFTWARE EYOGIBWA nga bw'eri era nga bw'eri eriwo, awatali buyambi bwa ngeri yonna, obutegeerekeka oba obw'omugaso, nga mw'otwalidde n'obuyambi bw'okusaasira, obutuufu bw'ekigendererwa ekimu, omutwe, n'obutavunaanibwa.
Okumala ekiseera ekisingawo ekikkirizibwa mu mateeka, JASON TURNER tajja kuba wa buvunaanyizibwa ku kabi konna akali butereevu, obutali butereevu, akatono, ak'enjawulo, ak'oluvannyuma, oba akabonero, oba ku kufiirwa kwonna okw'ebitabo, ebivaamu, ensimbi, fayiro z'abaweereza, ensi y'emizannyo, bizineesi, oba obuweereza obuva oba obukwataganyizibwa n'okukozesa software oba byayo.
Olina obuvunaanyizibwa obw'okukuuma eby'okuziyiza n'okukakasa nti Programu ekikwatagana n'enteekateeka yo n'embeera y'ensimbi z'omuzannyo.
10. Ebintu eby'Abalala
Programu z'abantu abasatu, ebitabo, fayiro z'abaweereza b'emizannyo, ebintu bya SteamCMD, obubonero obw'obusuubuzi, n'ebintu ebirala bifugibwa nnannyinibyo era bikyali wansi wa layisensi zaabwe n'ebiragiro byabwe.
License eno eyogera ku bitundu bya Synix ebya Jason Turner byokka.
11. Okukkiriza okw'Okuwandiika
Enkyukakyuka eziri mu layisensi eno zikyali za muganyulo kyokka nga zikoleddwa mu buwandiike bwa Jason Turner.
Ebibuuzo oba okusaba okuweebwa olukusa birina okukolebwa okuyitira mu ddwaaliro lya Synix GitHub oba engeri endala ey'okuwuliziganya ne Synix.
12. Ensibuko z'Okutunda
Funa Synix okuyitira mu nsibuko zino ez'obuyinza:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Kopi eziweebwayo ku mikutu emirala tezikakasibwa Jason Turner era ziyinza okuba nga tezimala, nga zaakyusibwa, nga zikaddiye, oba nga zikozesebwa mu programu endala. Obukuumi bwabwe n'obutuufu tebikkirizibwa Jason Turner.
Okuteeka Synix ku lukalala, okukwataganya ne GitHub, oba okuwa ekikopo tekivvuunula buyinza oba tekitegeeza kukkirizibwa, kufuuka, okusiimibwa, oba obutuuze obw'obuyinza. Synix ekyakyali kya Jason Turner.
Okusobola okukuŋŋaanya ebitabo, okubikozesa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, okubikolerako mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa, okubikolerako mu ngeri endala, oba okubikozesa mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa, kyetaagisa okuwandiisibwa nga bukyali. Enkolagana eri ensibuko ey'obuyinza tewa ddembe eryo.
Ekitundu 4.2 tekikugira kukwataganya butereevu n'ebitabo bino eby'obuyinza ebikkiriza bulungi Synix ne Jason Turner. Enkolagana ng'ezo tezifuula mukutu gwa Intaneeti oguyambako okuba ensibuko y'obuyinza.
WinGet package ubidzz.Synix y'engeri ey'okuteekamu ekikkirizibwa ng'eggyayo ekizimbe ekitali kikyusiddwa butereevu okuva mu biwandiiko bya GitHub eby'obuyinza. Kino tekikkiriza muntu wa busatu kusembeza oba okuddaabiriza.
13. Ebintu Ebikolebwa mu Ngeri ey'Okubeerawo n'Eby'Okwewaŋŋanga
Synix erimu omuwendo gw'emirimu egikolebwa mu kiseera ky'obulamu ogusobola okuteebereza omuwendo gw'emirimu egikolebwa ku Synix ku https://synix.info. Osobola okuggyawo ekiseera kyonna mu Bikolero > Obukuumi n'Ebyokwerinda > Share active count nga teweerabirira ebitundu ebirala bya Synix. Enkola ey'okuteeka mu nkola entegekeddwa edda eyakuumibwa.
Bwe kiba nga kikoleddwa, Synix esindika akabonero k'okubeerawo kwa HTTPS ku https://synix.info/api/presence ng'eyatandika era kumpi buli ddakiika lya 10 ng'enkola ekola, nga mw'otwalidde ne mu ttaka. Akabonero kano kalimu koodi y'okuwummula ey'akaseera obuseera era n'ekintu ekikwatagana ne Synix, nga tekirina bubaka bwa bubaka. Kkoodi y'omulundi egobererwa mu kijjukizo kyokka n'ekyusibwawo ng'omulundi ogw'okulangirira omulundi ogupya gutandise; si kitonde kya bulijjo eky'obukodyo.
Akawundu kano tekateekako linnya lyo, email address, passwords, server oba player information, configuration values, files, or machine identifiers.
Ku buli nteekateeka y'okubeera ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti, ekitebe ky'okubeerawo kyekuumira kasanduuko k'enteekateeka y'okubeerawo n'ekiseera eky'akabonero ako akasembayo. Omukutu gwa Intaneeti oguli ku mukutu gwa palamenti gulina omuwendo gwokka ogw'abantu ababeera ku siteegi eno, nga guno gwegero mu kifo ky'okubala abantu abatali bamu. Olukungaana lukoma okubalibwa oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika 15 awatali kabonero. Enkola y'okwerwanako ey'obutaba na mugaso eba esobola okuggibwawo oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika 30 era evaamu ng'okwerwanako okw'okwerwanako kuweddewo. Synix tekikwataganya biwandiiko bino eby'okuvuganya n'amaakaunti ag'omulabirizi ow'ewala oba obubonero obw'okukozesa kompyuta.
Okuggyawo ekintu kino kikomya obubonero obulala obw'okubeerawo n'okusaba okufuba ennyo okuggyawo olukiiko luno. Okuziba Synix nakyo kifuba okuggyawo; singa okuggyawo tekusobola kutuuka ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti, olukiiko lulekera awo okubalibwa oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera eky'obutakola.
Nga bwe kiri ku nkolagana yonna ey'oku Intaneeti, obuweereza bw'okubeera ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti bufuna obubaka obutuufu obw'enkolagana, gamba ng'olupapula lw'e IP n'ekiseera eky'okusaba, era buyinza okubukolerako oba okubikuba mu mateeka gaabwe ag'obukuumi. Ensonga zino teziterekebwa mu Synix's activity counter tables oba teziragibwa mu kubala kw'abantu bonna.
14. Obukuumi n'Ebyokwerinda
14.1 Obuyinza obw'Okusobola Okufuna Ebimu ku Biri mu Kigambo kya Katonda
Obukulembeze obw'oku wala ku https://manager.synix.info bwa bwetaavu era buzimiriddwa okutuusa lw'onoogatta kompyuta n'okukkiriza akaawunti eyasaba mu programu ya Synix ku kompyuta eyo. Osobola okukozesa Synix awaka nga tolina akaawunti ya maneja. Ekibinja ky'emirimu gy'abantu bonna kyawukana era kisobola okuggibwa mu nkola.
Synix tegutunda, okupangisa, kusuubula, oba okuteeka mu nkola obubaka bw'akaawunti yo, obubaka bw'okukozesa ku kompyuta, ebikolwa eby'oku wala, oba obubaka bw'omuddugaza eri ababuulizi b'amawulire oba abasuubuzi b'ebitabo. Synix teyakozesa bubaka buno ku bikwata ku kulangirira oba okuzimba ebifaananyi eby'okulangirira okuva mu bubaka obwo. Ebimu ku bintu ebikozesebwa mu kukozesa enkola eno bikwataganyizibwa n'ebyo by'osalawo, okukakasa obutuufu bw'okufuna obubaka, okukozesa obuweereza, n'okubukuuma obutakozesebwanga bubi.
Enkola ey'okubeerawo okuva ewala si buweereza obw'okukuŋŋaanya ebintu. Kyetaaga obuwandiike obutonotono obw'akaawunti, obuwandiike obw'okusiba awamu n'obw'okukuuma ebikozesebwa nga byogerwako wammanga. Ebiwandiiko ebyo tebifulumizibwa mu kiwandiiko ky'emirimu gy'abantu oba okutegeerekeka ku biwandiiko by'abakulembeze abalala okuyitira mu buweereza.
14.2 Ekibeera ku Kompyuta Yo
Synix teyeetikka mu butereevu ensi z'emizannyo, fayiro z'okuweereza emizannyo, ebiri mu fayiro ez'okuteekawo, ebiri mu buwumbi bw'ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza, ebyava mu konsolo, oba ebigambo eby'omuggalo by'okuweereza emizannyo ebikuumibwa. Okuddaabiriza n'okuzza obuggya ebikozesebwa ku kompyuta eyambadde; fayiro z'obwesige zikyali mu bifo ebyateekebwawo eyo. Bw'osalawo okuteeka ekiragiro ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti, obubaka obuli mu kiwandiiko ekyo butereezebwa era ne busindikibwa ku kompyuta, nga mw'otwalidde n'ebisaanyizo byonna by'oteeka mu kyawandiikibwa ekyo. Manager si cloud backup storage era tewa ddeskitokopi ya wala, Windows command-prompt access, oba okulambula fayiro mu bujjuvu.
Synix essaawo ebisaanyizo byayo eby'omu kitundu, olukalala lw'abaweereza, ebyafaayo, eby'okuziyiza, n'embeera y'okukwataganya ku kompyuta yo. Ekyuma eky'okuteeka omukono ku kompyuta ekikwatagana n'omuntu kibeera mu Windows key storage. Synix yeetwala ng'ekintu ekisingayo okuba eky'omuganyulo bwe kiba nti kisobola okukuumibwa ne TPM era bw'oba nga kisobola, kyekuuma software key eyakuumibwa ne Windows, nga mw'otwalidde ne ku VM ezituukagana. TPM okubeerawo tekitegeeza nti kompyuta terina kikyamu.
Ebigambo bino byogera ku Synix remote management. Emizannyo, Steam, mods, okugatta kwa Discord, okusookera ddala, n'obuyambi bw'osalawo okugabana nabyo birina enkulaakulana yabyo. Teweerabiranga bigambo bya fayiro oba obubaka obulala obw'omwanguka mu mannya g'amasimu, amannya g'abaweereza, oba amannya g'ebiwandiiko eby'okuziyiza, kubanga ebiwandiiko ebyo biyinza okulabika mu maneja.
14.3 Ensonga z'Omulabirizi Ebitundutundu n'Ensigo
- Akaawunti n'okutegeeza obutuufu: Erinnya ly'okukozesa ly'osalawo, akaawunti y'okutegeeza, ekiseera eky'okutonda, ebisaanyizo by'obukuumi, hash ey'ekizigo ekirimu omunnyo, ekyama ky'okutegeeza obutuufu ekikwatiddwa nga kikyusiddwa, obujulizi bw'ekiddukiro bw'abantu bonna nga bukyusiddwa, n'ebitabo eby'okwekebera eby'ekiseera. Enkola ey'okuteeka omukono ku bubaka bw'okuwandiisa n'ebikutu eby'okukubaganya omukono ku bubaka bw'okuwandiisa ebikozesebwa; amannya g'ekiddukiro ag'enkalakkalira tegasibiddwa ng'ekigambo ekisobola okusomebwa. Synix teyeetaaga kuggya ku ngalo zo, ku kifaananyi ky'amaaso go, ku nsawo ey'ekiddukiro, oba ku nsawo ey'okuteeka omukono ku kompyuta. Okuwandiisa tekusaba linnya lyabwe oba e-mail. - Okukwataganya n'okugatta: Akakiiko k'ekkompyuta ke wasooka okulonda, akabonero ak'ekintu eky'okulowoozaako, omuggalo gw'okuteeka omukono gwabwe ku bantu bonna, ekitundu ky'akaawunti, enkola y'omuwaabi w'omuggalo gwe wagambibwa, embeera y'okukwatagana n'ekiseera eky'okugatta ekisembayo. Enkolagana ey'okuwummula ey'okutumbula esobola okusigala nga yeeguddewo ng'ate Synix ekoleddwa olwo webusayiti esobole okuzuukusa app eyambaddeyo amangu ddala. Ebiragiro eby'okubeerawo/okweggyamu obukuumi n'ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana n'omutindo gw'okubeerawo, si bya fayiro z'omuzannyo oba ebifaananyi bya server. - Embeera eyakolebwa: Ebikwekweto bya server, amannya, amannya g'omuzannyo, embeera y'okutambuliramu, omuwendo gw'abazannyi, ekiseera eky'okuyimirizaawo, ebikolwa ebiriko, obudde/embeera y'okuddaabiriza gye buvuddeko awo, okugatta CPU ne RAM okusomebwa okuva ku mirimu gy'omuzannyo (nga mw'otwalidde abatandikawo n'abakozi baabwe abateekeddwa), n'ekipapula kyonna ekyeyawukana CPU, RAM ekikozesebwa/ekikungo, n'emitindo gy'okuweereza/okufuna mu mitwe. Ebimu ku bintu ebikwataganyizibwa n'okukozesa enkola y'empuliziganya, bye bikwataganyizibwa n'ebintu ebyakolebwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo. Ebimanyiso by'omuguzi, amadirisa ga IP, omutindo gw'epakiti, n'ebifo eby'okukebera tebitumibwa wamu n'okusoma kuno. Enkola eyo esindika ebivvulu bino ng'okwolesebwa kw'omulabirizi okukakasibwa kukyali ku ddaala. CPU/RAM updates cover paired computers; Enkyukakyuka ez'enjawulo ezikoleddwa ku muddubi zikwata ku kompyuta eyalondeddwa. Enkyukakyuka zitera okukolebwa buli ddakiika 10 era ziyimirirwe oluvannyuma lw'okulaba ebifaananyi ebikukwatako nga biwedde, nga biweddewo, nga biweddewo, oba nga bifiiriddwa. Ebiseera ebirala eby'okukebera ebikozesebwa bisobola okukuuma ebifaananyi byabwe nga bikyuse. - Ebikolwa ebyasabiddwa n'ebiwandiiko eby'okuziyiza: Ebiwandiiko bya server/ebikolwa, ekiseera eky'okusaba, okukulaakulana/ekivaamu, era, bw'oyagala eby'okuziyiza, ebiwandiiko by'okuziyiza, amannya g'ebiwandiiko, ennaku, ebitundu, n'ebiwandiiko eby'obwesigwa. Ebintu eby'okuddaabiriza n'amakubo ag'omu kitundu tebitumibwa ku nsonga eno. - Ebiragiro by'omuzannyo: Ekiwandiiko ekitali kya lwatu eky'okukozesa emizannyo, okukkirizibwa okuggulawo okumala akaseera katono, n'ekigambo ky'ekiragiro ky'oweereza. Ekyawandiikibwa ekimala okufunibwa kiwandiikiddwa mu database y'obuweereza era kiggibwa ku ndagaano eyo ng'okuweereza kukkirizibwa. Tekiri mu lukalala lw'ebikolwa ebikolebwa gye buvuddeko oba mu biwandiiko eby'okubuulirira ku bikwata ku akawunti. Ekivaamu kitegeeza nti ekyawandiikibwa kyasindikibwa mu kizinensi, so si nti ekizinensi yakikkiriza oba yakikomya. Eby'okuddamu eby'omuzannyo n'omuti gw'enkola w'omu kitundu tebikuumizibwa. - Ebyokwerinda n'okuziyiza ebikolwa eby'obutali butuukirivu: Enkola y'okuyingira eyalemererwa, okubala n'ebiseera eby'okugezesebwa mu kibinja, enkola y'okufuna obuyambi/ebikolwa eby'obutebenkevu, n'ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana nabyo. Ebitabo ebiriko ekkomo ly'omuwendo eby'ebiseera ebitonotono bisobola okukozesa hashes eziri mu kibugu kya IP ey'okugatta n'ebitonde bya akaawunti. Synix's account alert records do not contain attempted passwords, verification codes, raw IP addresses, or browser fingerprints. Abasuubuzi b'ennyonyi bayinza okukebera obubaka obw'okugatta okwawukana nga bwe kyalagulwa mu Kitundu 14.6.
Omukutu gwa Intaneeti gwetaaga okulabirira obuvvuunula n'ebiragiro ebikkirizibwa okusobola okuwa obufuzi obw'oku wala. HTTPS n'okubikkako kw'omuggo okulabikibwa okwekuuma entambula mu kkubo; Kino tekitegeeza nti obuweereza obw'okusembeza abantu tebusobola kukola ku by'okukozesa.
14.4 Okubeerawo n'Okuggibwawo
- Okukkiriza kw'akaawunti n'obukodyo bikyaliwo okutuusa akaawunti lwe yaggibwawo. Ebiwandiiko ebikwataganyizibwa n'obubanja bibeerawo okutuusa kompyuta lw'eba nga tebikwataganyizibwa oba ng'akaawunti eggiddwawo. - Ebifaananyi eby'omunda n'ebitundu bya CPU/RAM bikyusibwa ebitundu ebipya ne bifuuka ebisaanira okulongoosebwa oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika z'e 15 nga tezizzeemu. Ekiseera eky'okugatta ekisembayo kikyagenda mu maaso ng'ekimu ku bintu ebikwatagana. - Ebyafaayo by'ekiragiro ekyesudde, ebivuddemu, n'ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza ebituukiddwako bifuuka ebisaanira okulongoosebwa oluvannyuma lw'essaawa za 24. - Ebiragiro by'omuzannyo-console ebikyaliwo biwedde oluvannyuma lwa 30 mu ddakiika. Ennyiriri ezitali zimu zifuuka ezisaanira okuggibwawo ng'ekiseera kyazo kituuse oba nga zikomye; okuleetebwa okukkiriziddwa kukkiriza amangu ddala. Okukkiriza kw'ekifo eky'okuwummuliramu kuggwako mu ddakiika ssatu. Ekiwandiiko ky'okwoleka ebikolwa n'ekivaamu eky'okuleeta ebiragiro bikwatagana n'ekiseera ky'okuwandiika ebikolwa mu ssaawa 24. - Ebintu eby'okuddaabiriza/eby'obukuumi n'okulemberwa kw'okuwandiisa okulemereddwa bifuuka ebisaanyizo eby'okulongoosebwa oluvannyuma lw'ennaku 90. Enkola y'okuwandiisa eyalemererwa ekwata ku 100 ezisingayo okuba ez'ebyafaayo; obuzibu obwesigika mu kiseera kya 10-minute butegekebwa wamu. - Enkuŋŋaana z'obwannannyini ziweddewo oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika 30 awatali kubuulirira kwa maneja oba oluvannyuma lw'essaawa 8 zonna. Okugezaako okukakasa kuggwako oluvannyuma lw'ennaku 5; Okuzuula okw'akaseera obuseera kw'ekigambo ky'omuggalo kuggwako mu ddakiika 10 era kugikozesebwa omulundi gumu. Ebyafaayo by'okukebera, okuvvuunuka, okukuuma okuddaabiriza, n'ebiwandiiko eby'omugaso biggibwawo mu kiseera ky'okuyonja. Enkola y'okuwandiisa ensimbi ezitali zimalirizibwa eba esobola okwerongoosebwa oluvannyuma lw'essaawa za 24.
Okusaanawo kuggyawo okuweebwa obuyinza nga tebannaggyawo buwandiike. Okuyonja kw'amasomero g'ebisaanyizo kujjira mu kiseera ky'okusaba obuweereza okuweddewo, waakiri omulundi gumu buli 10 eddakiika z'okuyonja kw'omulabirizi, n'olwekyo ebiseera ebyogeddwako waggulu bye biseera eby'okuggwaamu amaanyi oba eby'okugonjoolebwa mu kifo ky'okusuubiza okuggibwawo mu kaseera akatono. Ebitabo by'abaweereza n'ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza birina obulamu obw'enjawulo.
Okuggyawo obufumbo kuggyawo obufumbo obwateereddwawo n'ebiwandiiko byayo eby'oku wala okuva mu database y'obuweereza obukoleddwa. Ebyafaayo by'okuddaabiriza/obutabanguko bisobola okusigala ku akawunta y'ekiseera ekiragiddwa waggulu. Okuggyawo akaawunti y'omulabirizi kuggyawo ebisaanyizo byayo, okukwataganya, ebifaananyi, ebiragiro, n'ebiwandiiko eby'okukuuma akaawunti/okuzzaawo okuva mu database ya service entuufu. Tekiggyawo bisuubuzi by'emizannyo gy'omu kitundu kyo, ensi zo, ebisaanyizo byo, oba fayiro ezikozesebwa okuddaabiriza. Ebyafaayo eby'ebiseera ebitonotono eby'okuziyiza ebikolwa eby'obugwenyufu n'ebiwandiiko oba ebitabo eby'obukuumi ebikwatiddwa ababiweereza tebigenda kuggibwawo mu bwangu nga bakoze ekintu kyonna.
14.5 Ebiragiro byo n'Okukuuma Okuyingira
Okuyingira kwetaagisa ekigambo kyo eky'ekizingirizi awamu n'ekiddukiro ekikoleddwa oba eky'okutegeeza obutuufu, gamba nga Google Authenticator. Akaawunti ezikoleddwa nga zeetaaga enkola zombi zikwatanga ebisaanyizo byombi. Okukyusa ekigambo ky'okuyitamu, okuggya kompyuta ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti, n'okuggyawo akaawunti y'omulabirizi byetaagisa okukakasa nti enkyukakyuka eyo yaakwatibwa.
Okuggulawo enkola y'okuzannya ey'ekikonde ky'emizannyo ey'enjawulo era kyetaagisa ekigambo ky'ekikwekweto ekiddako n'okukakasibwa okuppya okusinziira ku byetaago by'enkola eziriwo mu akaawunti. Okukkiriza kukwataganyizibwa n'omulimu gw'okukebera omulamwa, kompyuta ey'okusiba awamu, olupapula olukoleddwa n'omuzannyo ogutambuzibwa okumala eddakiika ssatu. Okuyimiriza, okuddamu okutandika, okukomya ekiteeso, okukomya ekiteeso ky'okukomya oba okufiirwa enkola kikulemesa okukola ekiragiro ekirala. Okuggya oba okwekweka akabugu k'omulabirizi kumalawo okukkirizibwa kw'akabugu ke. Ebbugumu ly'okuweereza ebikozesebwa mu nkola erimu likuuma obwetaavu bwabwe obw'okuyingira. Enkolagana z'okuyingira ezikozesebwa mu mizannyo zokka ze zikkirizibwa; enkola y'okumanya ey'enjawulo yokka etakkiriza kuwandiika mu Windows command prompt.
Kompyuta eyakolebwako nga yeeyongedde okukkirizibwa esobola okukuwa password ey'akaseera obuseera singa weerabira password yo ku mukutu gw'empapula. Tasobola kusalawo akaawunti endala. Password ey'akaseera obuseera teyejjusa oba okuggyawo ebisaanyizo byo eby'okukozesa passkey/authenticator ebiriwo, era olina okulonda password empya nga tonnayingira manager. Okumaliriza okuggyawo kuggyawo ebitundu byo ebirala eby'okukebera.
Omulabirizi wa Synix akuuma obukodyo bwe obw'okuyingira mu browser mu ndowooza ya tab eno, so si mu cookies, local storage, oba session storage. Okuzza obuggya oba okukomya tab eba yafiirwa okuyingira. Kino tekiremesa mulabirizi wo oba omulabirizi wa password okukuuma ebisaanyizo bw'osalawo, era tekyogera ku cookies eziteekebwawo okwawukana n'abaweereza ba hosting/security oba obuweereza obw'okuvvuunula webusayiti.
Osobola okufuluma, okuggyawo ebitundu byonna eby'okukebera, oba okuggyawo kompyuta. App ya Synix ey'omu kitundu eyinza okukomya n'okugoba ekikuumiro kyayo eky'oku wala awatali kuyingira ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti. Bw'oba ng'oli offline, ekema okuyingira okuva ku ttivi mu kitundu era n'okuddamu okuggyawo webusayiti nga waliwo akakwate. Okuddamu okutandikawo programu oba Windows tekikoma kuzzaawo ky'ogenda okukomya. Okukozesa mu kitundu kyokka kukyagenda mu maaso.
14.6 Okukuŋŋaanya Ebizimbe, Empapula z'Abantu, n'Eby'Okwekuuma
Akakiiko k'eby'empuliziganya akakozesa OpenAI's Sites hosting n'obuweereza bwa Cloudflare okugaba, okukuuma, obukuumi, n'okubeerawo. Abasuubuzi bano bakola obubaka obwetaagibwa okuwaayo obuweereza obwo era bayinza okufuna amadirisa ga IP, okusaba emitwe, ebiseera, n'ebintu ebirala ebikozesebwa ku nkolagana, oba okukuuma ebitabo byabwe eby'emirimu n'ebiwandiiko byabwe. Enkola zaabwe ez'obukuumi zikwata ku kukozesebwa kwazo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ ne https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Okuvvuunula okw'emirundi emirala n'okukoppolola GitHub bikwatagana n'abaweereza baabwe. Omulabirizi w'ebitabo by'obwannannyini yeeyawudde ku biwandiiko ebiriko obubaka bwa bantu bonna era tasobola kussaawo biwandiiko bya bavvuunuzi b'ebitabo oba eby'okulangirira ebiwandiiko. Synix tegamba nti okukyalira oba ku mukutu gwonna gwa Intaneeti tekitegeeza nti wabaawo cookies, logs, oba obubaka obukuumibwa. Ebimu ku bintu ebikwataganyizibwa n'emisingi egiri mu ssuula eno biyinza okukolebwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo. Endagaano eyogeddwako waggulu ey'obutabaako ky'otunda tekiremesa kusindikibwa kw'ebizimbe oba okutegeezebwa okw'amateeka.
Synix ekozesa obufumbo obwesigamiziddwa, okusaba kwa kompyuta okuteekebwa omukono, enkuŋŋaana z'amasannyalaze ezikoleddwa, okukebera kw'okuyingira mu akaawunti, n'okukkiriza okw'akaseera katono okukendeeza ku kuyingira okw'obutakkirizibwa. Ebiragiro bino tebikakasa nti okufunibwa okuva ku kkubo erimu tekuliiko buzibu oba nga tebikakasa nti wabaawo obulumbaganyi bwonna, kompyuta/browser eyonoonese, amakubo ag'obukakafu agabbiddwa, oba obuweereza obwonoonese. Weekuumire Synix ne Windows nga bikyusiddwa, weekuumire akaawunti yo n'engeri z'okwekebera, era weeyongere okukakasa kompyuta n'amaakaawunti byokka by'ofuga.
Okutegeeza kuno kwa bonna ku https://synix.info/license/ era kuzingirwa mu kitongole ky'obuyambi n'okuteeka programu. Ebibuuzo by'obukuumi bisobola okuzuulibwa okuyitira mu bikolwa eby'obuwagizi ku https://synix.info/support/. Tosuula bigambo bya fayiro, koodi z'okufuna obuyambi, oba obubaka obulala obw'akaawunti ey'ekyama mu bubaka bw'obuwagizi obwa bonna. Enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa mu bubaka buno zirimu okukyusibwa n'olunaku oluggya.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Open Settings → Report a Problem okutegeka lipoota, oba kozesa ebifo eby'okuwagira ebiriko wammanga.
KUBA OKUSOBOLA OKUKOLA OLUBANYUMA Weeyongere okutegeeza enkola y'okuteeka, enkyusa za Synix ne Windows z'okozesa ddala, omuzannyo/profiiri, n'ebirala ebikwata ku kivvulu/omutunzi.
Nnyonnyola: • By'okoze oba by'ozeeko enkyukakyuka. • Biki bye wandisuubidde n'ebyo ebyaliwo? • Ekibi ekituufu n'ekitundu ekimala ekyawandiikibwa ng'ekiseera kituuse. • Kyandiba nti enteekateeka eyo yali ekola bulungi mu biseera ebyayita n'ebyo ebyali bikyuse.
OLUBAKA OLW'OKUKIRIZA Ggyako ebigambo eby'okuggya, obubonero, URL za webhook, amakubo g'omuntu, n'ebikwata ku mukutu gw'empuliziganya by'otayagala kubeere ku bantu. Enkola y'obukuumi tekumenya buli fayiro eyongeddwako. Teweeyongeranga ku biwandiiko ebituukiridde oba ku nteekateeka z'omuzannyo nga tozirebedde.
Bw'oba oyagala okuvvuunula Bayibuli, genda ku lulimi lwo, erinnya ly'akatundu ako, n'ebigambo by'oyinza okulaba. Ku kizibu eky'okutegeeza emizannyo, weeyongere okuteekawo enteekateeka y'okuteeka awamu n'ebitabo eby'omuzannyo.
EBIGENDERWA EBIGENDERWA Ennyiriri ezikwata ku biwandiiko: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Obumu Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Ekiwandiiko kya pulojekiti: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Okutandika oba okuzimba enkola ey'empisa ennungi tekusobola kugezaako buli lugoye, mod, ne network environment. Amakubo ag'okuzaala obulungi gayamba okwawula ekizibu kya Synix ku kizibu ky'omuzannyo oba eky'okuteekawo omulabirizi.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Koppera ku mutendera gwa server nga tonnaba kukozesa by'ofuga wansi. Olunyiriri olulondeddwa lugeraageranya ku muddubuzi ekikolwa kye kikwata.
Funa Omuweereza Kozesa akasanduuko ak'okunoonya okufuufuula okusinziira ku linnya ly'omuzannyo oba lya server. Ekivvulu ky'embeera kikendeeza ku lukalala. Bwe kiba nti ekiwandiiko kirabika nga kibula, ggyamu ebipima byombi nga tonnalowooza nti kyaggibwawo.
Soma ekitundu kino • Sserva eziteekebwawo zibalirira ebiwandiiko by'esserva ebikwatiddwa. • Running Now eraga ebiwandiiko ebiriko mu kiseera kino ebikubiddwa nga bikubiddwa. • CPU Usage ne RAM Usage byogera ku PC yonna, so si Synix yokka. • Ensonga z'omuzannyi zibeerawo bwokka ng'omuzannyo gw'otaddewo gutegeeza ensibuko eyesigamiziddwa.
EBIKWALA BYAKA BONNA • Tandika, Ssaawo, era Ddamu Okutandika okufuga olupapula olukoleddwa. • Okuteekawo kuggula enkambi z'okuteekawo. • Okubeera omwetegefu kukakasa ensonga eziyinza okumulemesa okukola obulungi. • Server Options erimu fayiro, okulabirira, okukwataganya, n'ebikozesebwa eby'omuzannyo. • Bw'oba oyagala okukebera obulungi olupapula olwo, genda ku lugero olumu.
Akakiiko k'Obulamu n'Okugonjoola Kulaga Enkulaakulana n'Okulabula okw'Amagezi. Soma obubaka obusembayo nga tonnaddamu kukola kintu kyonna. CLEAR efulumya ekitundu eky'emirimu ekirabika; si kiragiro eky'okuggyawo fayiro zonna ez'olukuŋŋaana.
Enkola ey'okutambula tekitegeeza nti abazannyi baba beetegefu. Okuteekawo, okusitula ensi yonna, endagaano, n'okuteekawo ebintu mu ngeri ey'eggonjebwa kisobola okweyongera oluvannyuma lw'enteekateeka okulabika. Kakasa nti oli mwetegefu mu kiwandiiko ky'omuzannyo n'okwenyigira.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Open Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager ku fayiro ekwataganyizibwa. Synix ekakasa ebitundu ebyateekebwawo n'ebifo ebikwataganyizibwa; Ekitabo ekyo tekirina buli kimu kye kikozesa.
YINGIRIZA EBIKWALA 1. Backups ensi, add-ons eziriwo, n'obutonde obukoleddwa. 2. Ssaabazza omuweereza okuyita mu Synix n'olinda ekibiina kyayo eky'enkola okufuluma. 3. Weekenneenye add-on system eyazuulibwa, ekitundu eky'okuteekawo, n'olukalala lw'obukuumi. 4. Salawo Okuteeka okuva mu fayiro oba Okuggya Package ku fayiro eyesigamiziddwa, ZIP, oba folda ya mod yonna. Eby'okwesalirawo ebisangibwa bisinziira ku nkola y'omuzannyo. 5. Weekenneenye ekifo w'ogenda, ebivudde mu kunoonyereza, okulabula, n'okukakasa. 6. Leka okuteeka ebintu mu bifo eby'enjawulo, okubyekuuma, n'okubiteeka mu bifo eby'enjawulo bikome. 7. Synix efulumya olukalala ng'okuteeka kumalirizibwa. Bwe kiba kyetaagisa, yaddamu okutandikawo, oluvannyuma otandike okunoonyereza ku lunyiriri lw'omuzannyo n'olw'omukwano gw'omugenyi.
Olukalala lulaga ekitundu eky'okuteeka kye walondawo. Kozesa Search okuzuula add-on ng'erina erinnya, ennyanjula, oba ekkubo. Yongera okukebera ekintu ekyo n'akigikuuma nga kikyaliwo. Okulaba ebintu mu ngeri ennyangu kikweka ebintu ebimu eby'obutebenkevu.
Weekuume ekidirisa nga kigguddwa ng'okukebera oba okukola enkyukakyuka bigenda mu maaso. Synix ekendeeza ku bikolwa ebikontana okutuusa lwe biggwaawo. Bwe kiba nti ekimu ku bikolwa ebyo tekyatuukirira, soma ensobi yaakyo n'ogisuubira okuddamu okugezaako.
ENNANYA Z'emirimu Ebitambula by'emirimu ebikwataganyizibwa bizingiramu Minecraft JAR packages, Rust Oxide/uMod plugins, local 7 Empaka za Days to Die, Empyrion scenarios ne server mods, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, ne ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. Enkola ezimu zeeyolekaganye n'okuzuula oba zeetaaga entegeka yazo esooka.
Synix ekozesa enkola y'okuteeka mu nkola emanyiddwa ng'omupiira/omupayoniya awaayo ebintu. Ebintu ebitalina kukolebwa ku kompyuta tebisobola kusuulibwa mu kitundu.
EBIKWALA BISobola Okukola n'Ebitasobola Okukola Ebintu eby'omuwendo ebikeberebwa okukebera enteekateeka y'ebipakiti n'ebifo ebigendereddwamu era n'okugaana amakubo agatali ga bukuumi, akakwataganyizibwa, ebintu ebitakkirizibwa okukolebwamu, ebipakiti ebinene ennyo, ebifo ebikyusibwamu, n'okubikkulirwa kw'ekiddukanya ekikyamu.
Okweyonja Defender okutaliimu oba okutaliimu bujulizi kwe kulabula, so si bukakafu bwa malware. Okukebera obulungi n'okuwandiisa hash nabyo tebikakasa nti ekipakiti ky'omuntu ow'okusatu kya bwesige. Mods zigenda mu maaso n'eddembe lya Windows ery'okuweereza.
EBIGAMBO, OKUKOLA EBIGAMBO, N'OKUKOLA EBIGAMBO Browse Catalog evula webusayiti y'omuwanika. Tekigonjoola bitakkirizibwa oba okuteekawo modpack yonna.
Yimiriza omuddugavu nga tonnaddayo kutunda. Kino kireetawo okukyuka kwonna okw'ebitundu ebyakolebwa, ebiyinza okuba nga birimu ebintu ebirala bingi. Eddamu okuggya ebintu ebikyasigaddewo n'okuggyawo fayiro ezaaleetebwawo. Okuggyawo ebintu ebipya bye batunda nga bakubaganyaako fayiro; Synix yagaana okuwandiika ku fayiro ezikyusiddwa ebweru w'ebiwandiiko byayo ebikwatiddwa oba okukozesa ebiwandiiko eby'omu nfuufu ebilemereddwa okukebera obutuufu bw'ebiwandiiko. Ebiwandiiko eby'okuggya ebikadde tebisobola kubaamu hashs ez'ebiwandiiko ebikuumibwa.
Bwe kituuka ku ID eyakulemberwa abawadde, Remove Selected evaamu ID eyo okuva mu mpisa z'oku Synix ezikozesebwa; si ky'okuzza obuggya ekivvulu ky'omu kitundu. Synix erimu enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa, so si buli nkyusa ey'omukutu. Weeyongere okukuuma eby'okuziyiza ebikozesebwa ku muddwaaliro: okuggyawo mod kiyinza okuleetera ensi yonna okuggibwawo oba okuggyawo ebikozesebwa mu mod.
Tebifulumiziddwa kitegeeza nti tebikwatagana n'ekitundu ky'okuteeka n'okunoonya. Fuba okunoonyereza n'okunoonyereza ku fayiro, olupapula, n'ekitundu nga tonnaba kulowooza nti fayiro zonna eziri ku disk zaanoonyerezebwa.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Ggula Add Server → Game Support Catalog okukebera Synix ky'emanyi ku muzannyo nga tonnatandikawo. Katalogi ekozesa ennyinnyonnyola eziri mu nkola yo eyateekebwawo.
1. Funa erinnya ly'omuzannyo. 2. Kozesa enkola y'okuteekawo, omuzannyi-data, crosssplay, okugobereragana, oba okutegeeza okuvvuunuka olukalala. 3. Londawo omuzannyo oguli mu katabo ako, oba kkiriza ku lugero olwo. 4. Soma enkola ey'okuteekawo, programu ya server, ebisaanyizo, n'obukakafu.
Funa obubonero bw'omuzannyo bw'oba nga tolisuubirwa. Minecraftbye bye Java era Bedrock Enkola y'okuteeka mu nkola enkola y'okukolera mu kifo ky'okuteeka mu nkola enkola y'okuteeka mu nkola enkola y'okuteeka mu nkola.
Soma Obusobozi Bwo n'Obwegendereza Polofayili esobola okuwa enkola ey'okuteeka mu nkola, okuteekebwawo okukubirizibwa, okutandika okuteeka mu nkola, oba obuyambi obutonotono/obwesigika. Ekiwandiiko ekiragiddwa ekiragibwa oba Steam AppID kinnyonnyola engeri enteekateeka gye yeeyisaamu; tekakasa buli kifulumiziddwa mu mizannyo.
Obwetaavu bwa SteamCMD obwesigamiziddwa butegeeza nti profayili esaba okuyingira mu akaawunti. Omwami w'emizannyo n'amateeka g'omufulumizi bayinza okuteekawo ebisaanyizo ebirala.
Ebitundu eby'Obuwangwa Obwesigamiziddwa ku Bintu Ebitono Omutindo gw'ekibuga ky'okukebera gwekuumibwa tegulaga nti omuwuliriza w'okukebera abaddewo oba nti alina okukwekebwa. Kozesa enkola y'omuzannyo n'ebisaanyizo by'enkola.
Katalogi y'ekifo eky'okwekebera mu nnyinnyonnyola eziriwo. Ebiwandiiko by'obukakafu obwa bulijjo biraga ekyo ekiragiddwa ku kompyuta eno, so si bibala bya buli mutimbagano gw'emmotoka oba mod.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Ggula akabonero k'ekyuma ku dashboard okusobola okumanya ebisaanyizo eby'okukolera mu nkola yonna. Kozesa akalulu ka Configure ka server ku nteekateeka eza server eyo yokka.
BULAMU • Kulaga enkola y'okukebera Server Console Window oba nga abaweereza abawagiddwa balaga enkola yaabwe ey'oku nsi. Olutindo olufiiriddwa tekitegeeza nti omuweereza agumiddwa. • Embeera ey'ekizikiza etera okukyusa ekiruubirirwa ky'okukozesa. • SteamCMD Download Speed esalawo sipiidi yonna oba ekkomo ly'okukyusa. • Enkyukakyuka ez'olulimi zaali zisaanyiziddwa mu nnukuta z'okuvuganya, n'obubaka obukwata ku mbeera.
Empapula endala zirimu ebifo eby'okuddaabiriza n'okufulumya ebintu, eby'obukuumi/eby'okwerinda, okutegeeza ebizibu, n'ebintu eby'enjawulo. Teweetaaga kussaawo by'osobola okukola okusobola okuteekawo olupapula olutuukiridde.
ENDOWOOZA Londa mu nnimi eziweereddwa mu ky'okulonda. Synix ebikuuma, ebiwandiiko eby'okuyamba, n'obubaka obuva mu programu bikozesa olulimi olulondeddwa. Ebiragiro by'omuzannyo, ebisaanyizo eby'okuteekawo, n'ebyo ebyava ku muddubuzi tebikuvvuunulwa. Ebiwandiiko by'ebitabo eby'obujjanjabi birina ebigambo byabyo eby'olubereberye.
Ennyanjula z'omuzannyo tezivvuunulwa: ebiragiro, obubonero n'ebisaanyizo, amannya g'empapula, engeri, amannya g'ebiwandiiko, ensonga ez'okutandikawo, ebimanyirizi, n'ennyanjula ez'okumanya ebyava mu muzannyo zirina okusigala nga ziri mu ngeri omuzannyo gye gwagala.
Okukyusa olulimi lwa interface tekikyusa bigambo bya mukolo gw'omuzannyo oba okuvvuunula ebyaconsole byayo. Bwe kiba nti enkola y'okuvvuunula Synix etera okulabika ng'eyonoonese, jjukira ebigambo byayo ebituufu, akasanduuko ke, n'olulimi lw'oyogedde.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Open Settings → Privacy & Security nga tonnaba kussaawo kifaananyi oba okwetegereza eby'okwerinda.
OMUTUNDO gw'Eby'Omuntu Amasiki ag'ekika ky'obukuumi gaawangayo ebiragalalagala eby'omunda, gamba ng'amannya n'obubaka. Tekikyusa IP yo ey'obwannannyini, tekikakasa traffic ya network, oba tekigonjoola buli game log ne configuration file.
Weekenneenye ekifaananyi ky'ekizikiza nga tonnakigabana nakyo. Ekikolwa eky'okukopya ku ttaka erikwekeddwa kisobola okukopya omuwendo gwa ddala.
EBIGAMBO N'EBIGAMBO EBIGAMBA Synix ekuuma ebigambo eby'ekiddukiro ebikwatiddwa, obubonero, n'omugaso gwa webhook eri omukozesa wa Windows. Omuzannyo guyinza n'okwetaagisa obujulizi obusobola okusomebwa mu nteekateeka yaagwo oba mu nsonga z'okutandika.
Okuteeka kopi y'olupapula mu akaawunti endala ya Windows tekitegeeza nti ebisaanyizo ebyo ebyakuumibwa bisobola okuggulwa. Kozesa omutendera gw'emirimu ogw'okuyingiza mu ngeri ey'okuteekebwawo okusobola okukyusa ebisaanyizo.
EBIWANJA BY'EBIWANJA Yanguza Synix n'abaweereza b'omuzannyo aba bulijjo nga balina ebisaanyizo bya Windows. Enkyukakyuka emu ey'omu nkola oba omutambi w'omuzannyo ayinza okusaba okuyimirirwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo; si nsonga y'okutwala buli kimu mu maaso ng'omulabirizi.
Ensonga z'okuyonja enkomera z'omuliro ezisaanyizza Synix ezikwata ku mateeka agatali ga bulijjo. Okwekenneenya amateeka agategekeddwa nga tebannakkiriza kuggyibwawo. Tekukuuma buli folda ey'enjawulo oba okukakasa okuggyawo amateeka agatali gamu ag'ekizikiza.
Singa ekyama kibikkulibwa, kikwasibwe mu kifo ky'ekyo oba kiggibwe ku ofiisi eyagifulumya. Okubikka munda oba okuggyawo kopi ya Synix eyateekebwawo tekivunaanyizibwa ku bujulizi obwo mu kifo ekirala.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Okusiba eddirisa ly'omwana, okukendeeza ku Synix, n'okufuluma mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa bye bikolwa eby'enjawulo. Weekenneenye engeri gy'obadde otambuzaamu ebintu n'engeri yonna gy'oyinza okufulumamu.
OKUKOLA BULI KY'OKUKONDA Synix esobola okumanya enkola z'abaweereza eziyimirirwa nga zikyagenda mu maaso n'okuziggya. Leka okukebera entandikwa okuggwa nga tonnaba kutandika ntandikwa endala.
Okukakasa enkola erina okukwatagana n'ekizimbe ekirondebwa, so si linnya erimanyiddwa. Ebirungo eby'enjawulo oba obuweereza obukozesebwa ebweru biyinza okwetaaga okulabirirwa.
EBIKWALA Enkola y'okuteekawo ku Windows entegeka y'okutandika/ey'okuteekawo ku mukolo gw'obuweereza esobozesa okwetegereza. Tebasaanidde kutandika kuweereza wo eyasooka.
Omulimu oguteekebwawo gwetaaga enkola oba omukozi wa Synix, ekitundu kya Windows ekirimu, n'enkola ey'okuwummula. Okutandika okuyingira tekitegeeza nti omulimu gujja kugenda mu maaso ng'emmotoka eggyiddwawo.
BWE TUTANNAKUBIRA WINDO Okumaliriza okuteeka ebintu mu ndabirwamu, okubikuba, n'okubikuba. Yiga emizannyo okuyita mu Synix basobole okuteekawo mu ngeri entuufu, oluvannyuma bagende oba batandike Windows.
Tokitwala nti ekitebe ky'emizannyo eky'ekyama kiyimiridde oba nti okukomya ekizikiza ky'okukebera kikomya omuzannyo. Weekenneenye ekipande ky'obukodyo n'okukozesa ebintu ebikozesebwa ku bulamu bw'omuntu.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Ggula ekivudde mu Kwetegekera kwa server eyalondeddwa okukakasa ekimu ku bintu ebikoleddwa. Ekiseera eky'okutambuliramu ekikwataganyizibwa ne Synix tekikendeeza ku byetaago eby'enjawulo eby'omuzannyo.
EBIGAMBO BYA DLL EBIKA Ensobi ezikwata ku MSVCP140.dll oba VCRUNTIME140.dll zitera okulaga obwetaavu bwa Visual C ++ runtime. Kozesa ekiragiro ky'omuzannyo n'ekikwatagana ekiriko Microsoft ekigabanyiziddwa.
Ebikwata ku Microsoft ebiyinza okugabulwa: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Teweerabiranga fayiro za DLL ez'enjawulo okuva ku mikutu gy'eby'empuliziganya oba okuteeka DLL ezitali zimu okumpi n'omupiira ogusobola okukolebwa.
EBIKWALA BINNA Omuzannyo guyinza okwetaagisa akaawunti, eddembe ly'okuweereza, ekiseera ekimu eky'okutambuza Java, engeri ya Windows, oba ebikozesebwa. Buulira ebisaanyizo ebyo nga tonnakyusa mabbali agatali gamu oba nga tonnassaawo nteekateeka.
Ku Minecraft Java, kozesa enkola y'okukoppolola eya Synix. Bedrock terikozesa Java.
Bwe kiba kyetaagisa okuteeka mu nkola Hyper-V oba hardware virtualization, weetegereze okukebera okwetegekedde omuzannyo. Tokkiriza bikolwa by'ensimbi oba genda buli muddubuzi ng'omulabirizi bwokka okweggyako okulabula.
Oluvannyuma lw'okukkakkanya ekwetaagisa, fuba okutandika omulundi ogumu n'okwetegereza ensobi eyasooka ey'omugaso mu katabo k'omuzannyo bw'eba ng'ekikyamu.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
EKY'OBUGANYA KIKULU KY'EKYetaagisa:
1. Synix efuluma Space Engineers Official Dedicated Server Manager era bulijjo agikuumira mu maaso.
2. Londa "Local/Console", londa "Continue to server configuration", genda ku nteekateeka z'omupiira n'ez'ensi, oluvannyuma welonda "Save & start".
3. Kozesa omulabirizi w'ebintu eby'enjawulo, ensi, mods, abafuzi, n'ekifo eky'okuwummuliramu. Ebitonde by'omuddugavu bikuumibwa mu kino Synix omuddugavu Instance folda.
4. Enkola ya Local/Console ey'olubereberye tewetaaga ddembe lya maneja. Enkola ya Windows ey'okuweereza ebaawo.
5. Ebisaanyizo: .NET Framework 4.8 oba empya, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 ne 2017, waakiri 6 GB wa system RAM, ne UDP port 27016 ekkirizibwa okuyitira mu Firewall ya Windows n'okutumbula eri abazannyi ba Intaneeti.
6. Ekiwandiiko Ekiragiddwa: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Open Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg and set use g_console "1". Tandikawo omuzannyo gwa Euro Truck Simulator 2 ogw'akabonero, loda enkola yo n'ekabi lyo, kkiriza ~ okuggula ekiteeso, era otambule export_server_packages. Ggalawo omuzannyo, oluvannyuma kkulira ku Start mu Synix nate. Synix ejja kuggya fayiro ezikoleddwa mu butereevu.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Kozesa akatabo kano nga LAN play ekola naye ng'ekibuuzo ky'abantu bonna tekikola.
EBIGAMBO BY'OBA BYE WALI OTULYIMIRIZA Ebimu ku byuma ebikulembera tebinywerera ku NAT loopback, eyitibwa hairpinning. Enkolagana okuva munda w'ennyumba eri olukuŋŋaana lwayo olw'omu lujjudde eyinza okugwa wadde ng'abazannyi ab'ebweru basobola okuyingira.
Kozesa emu ku ndagiriro z'omu maka go era weebuuze omuntu omulala ali ku nkolagana y'oku Intaneeti akole okwekebera. Okulemererwa kw'omulembe gwa WAN mu PC wekka si bukakafu bw'okulemererwa kwa Internet.
OKUYINGIRIRA mu maaso tekyawukana Fuba okulaba omuterekero omulala ogugenda waggulu, NAT ey'emirundi ebiri, oba NAT ey'omutambuzi (CGNAT). Geraageranya obubaka bwa WAN bw'omukulembeze n'ennukuta ey'abantu bonna era weebuuze ISP oba enkuŋŋaana eziyingira ziwagirwa.
Etteeka ery'okuweereza ku mutwazi wo terisobola kufumbulula NAT eyakulemberwa ISP. Okusinziira ku nkolagana, kiyinza okwetaagisa obuweereza obw'olukuŋŋaana olunene, VPN/tunnel entuufu, oba server ey'okubeerawo. Bano be nteekateeka ez'ebweru, so si ngeri za Synix ez'omunda.
TEKYALABIRA BUKULU n'OBUGANDA bw'Omubanja Enkolagana ey'okukangavvula okuva ewala n'ey'omuzannyi w'omuzannyo bye bimu ku byo. Okuyamba okutegeeza API oba Discord mu kitundu tekitegeeza nti omuzannyo guyinza okukolebwa ku Intaneeti.
Weeyongere okukebera ku mikutu gy'empuliziganya ng'otunuulira ekibuga n'obukodyo bw'omuzannyo. Bw'oba osaba obuyambi, tofulumizanga bigambo by'okukozesa, tokeni, ebifaananyi eby'okuzannya n'omuntu oba obubaka obukwata ku mikutu gy'abantu.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Kozesa ekitabo ekirina akakwate n'ekitundu ekyalemererwa.
EBIKOLWA BYA SYNIX Activity & Diagnostics ekiraga enkulaakulana n'okulabula okukwata ku bakozesa ku dashboard. Okuggyawo ekitundu ekyo kiggyawo obubaka obulabika bwokka; tekiggyawo bubonero bwonna obw'okuzuula obulwadde.
EBIKA BYA KUKOLA Synix ebitabo eby'ennukuta n'obubaka bw'okugwa mu kabenje bubeera ku: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Olupapula lw'okwogera olw'okukemebwa luyinza okutegeeza erinnya ly'ekiwandiiko ekimu. Kozesa ekkubo eryo n'ekiseera eky'okulemererwa okunoonya ekiwandiiko ekikwata ku nsonga eyo.
Enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa mu kutegeeza obulwadde zisobola okuwandiikibwa mu ndagaano y'obubaka nga tezilabika ku dashboard. Enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa mu nkola y'ebitabo tezitera kuba bujulizi bwa kukosa kw'okukozesa.
OLUBAKA LWA GAME Kozesa ekitabo ky'omuzannyo ekya server eyalondeddwa okunoonyereza ku nsobi z'okuzikiza ensi, ez'okuteekawo, ez'okukyusakyusa, n'ez'okukozesa emizannyo. Ekifo kyayo kikwatagana n'omuzannyo era kisobola okubeera ebweru w'omuggo gw'okuteeka.
GASOMEBE MU KITUNDU Weetegereze ekikolwa n'ekiseera, oluvannyuma weetegereze obubaka obukwata ku butali bwenkanya obwasooka. Enkola ey'okuyimirira ku nkomerero eyinza okuba ensibuko mu kifo ky'ensonga.
Nga tonnaba kugabula kintu kyonna, fuba okuggyawo ebigambo eby'okuggya, obubonero, webhooks, amadiresi g'obuntu, n'amakubo. Satisfactory'ekitebe ky'okubikkula/ennukuta kye kisobola okuba n'akabonero k'omulabirizi. Weeyongere okukuuma obuwandiike obw'omukuumi bw'okunoonyereza.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Okuzzaawo kisobola okudda mu kifo ky'okuteeka ebintu ku muddubuzi gw'olondawo. Londa omupiira omulungi era weekuumire ebintu ebipya nga tonnatandika.
1. Ssaamu omuddugavu n'okola kopi ey'enjawulo y'ebiwandiiko by'oyinza okwetaaga. 2. Yanguza omutendera gw'emirimu oguyitibwa Restore backup mu Server Options. 3. Londa ekiwandiiko ky'obadde oyagala era weetegereze olupapula lwe, olunaku, omuwendo, n'embeera y'obwesigwa. 4. Weekenneenye nga tonnaba kuddamu. Synix eby'obugagga ebirina ebiwandiiko bya SHA-256 bisobola okukakasibwa ku biwandiiko ebyo; Ebiwandiiko eby'edda biyinza okutegeerekeka ng'obusika. 5. Soma okulabula okw'okuddaabiriza n'okakasa nga kino kye kifo ky'oyagala okuwonawo. 6. Leka okutendekebwa n'okuddaabiriza bikomekkerezebwe awatali kuziba Synix oba okuggyawo ebyuma ebikuumibwa. 7. Ssaamu omuddugavu n'okakasa nti ensi n'obutonde by'ogenda okuddaabiriza byazzaawo.
EKY'EKYAKOLA OKUKIBA Okukebera obugolokofu kutegeeza enkyukakyuka ezikwata ku kaadi. Tekiraga nti ensi yali nnungi bwe yawonyezebwawo oba nti ebyawandiikibwa omuntu omulala bye yawandiika byesigika.
BWE KY'OBA OKULAMUKA Weekuumire ebiwandiiko n'ebiwandiiko byonna eby'okuddaabiriza oba okuddaabiriza. Soma obubaka obw'okuddaabiriza nga tonnagezaako kuddamu kuggyawo oba okuggyawo fayiro endala.
Teweerabiranga ZIP ku muddubuzi atambula. Bwe kiba nti omuzannyo gukuuma ebitabo ebiriko ebitabo ebikyali ebweru w'olupapula lw'okuteekawo, bikomezebwewo mu ngeri ey'enjawulo ng'okozesa enkola y'omuzannyo.
Weeyongere okukuuma ensibuko y'ekika kino okutuusa lw'onookebera olupapula oluddemu okuddaabirizibwa n'okugatta kw'omugenyi.

data.name: Content.730545B3639C062E1741
data.value: Mods ezikwatagana zigenda mu Mods/UserCode. Genda ku Eco's version of API era weekuumire ebintu ebyetaagisa ebikwatagana nabyo.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Import Existing Server ekwata enteekateeka ey'okuteeka ku diski. Si y'okuzzaawo era ya njawulo ku kuyingiza Synix enkola ey'okufulumya.
NGA TONAYINGIRIZE Fuba okuddaabiriza ekitundu ekimu, nga mw'otwalidde n'ebiwandiiko byonna ebikuŋŋaanyizibwa ebisangibwa ebweru w'olupapula lw'okuteekawo. Ssaamu server n'okulema omulabirizi omulala oba omutegeka w'enteekateeka eyandisobodde okugitandika nga Synix agikolera.
LOWOOZA OKUTEEKA 1. Funa Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Londa olupapula lw'okuteekawo omuddugavu, so si shortcut, fayiro ya ZIP, oba olupapula lw'omugenyi w'omuzannyo. 3. Leka Synix okukebera, oluvannyuma okakasize omuzannyo ogwategekeddwa, edition, executable, ne settings. 4. Waayo ekiwandiiko erinnya ery'enjawulo era omenye ebisaanyizo byonna ebibulako. 5. Kumalirizza okuggya, ggula Configure, era otunuulire amakubo gaayo n'ebibuga. 6. Yanguza Obwetegefu, oluvannyuma otandike okutandika okukangavvulwa. Gezaako okukakasa nti ensi n'entegeka byetaagibwa byali biterekeddwa.
EBIKYAMBA EBIKYAMBA Okuwandiisa tekusobozesa kusengula nteekateeka, okuzitooloola nate, oba okudda mu kifo kyayo. Ebikolwa eby'oluvannyuma by'osalawo, gamba nga Update, Validate, oba configuration repair, bisobola okukyusa fayiro.
Ebirungo eby'okutandika, ebikozesebwa, ebigambo eby'okuggya, n'ebintu eby'okwerinda eby'ebweru tebisobola kutegeerekeka butereevu. Ekkubo ly'okuteeka limu terisobola kuteekebwa emirundi ebiri.
BWE KYAGALA OKULABIRA Gezaako okukakasa nti olonda ekizimbe ky'okuweereza ekikwataganyizibwa n'akabonero ako. Tokyusakyusa linnya ly'omuntu atali wa luganda olw'okuteeka mu nkola. Buulira omuzannyo n'olupapula lw'olupapula olukoleddwa okusobola okukebera amakulu gawo.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Kozesa ekitabo kino ng'omukulembeze w'enteekateeka agamba nti waliwo ekifo ekikyamu ekikulemberwamu, enkola etakkirizibwa, oba obutaba nga bukwatagana na template.
FUMIRA EKY'OSOBOLA • Okuteekawo obuggya obutuufu obuwagira ebisaanyizo mu nteekateeka eyalondeddwa. • Okuddaabiriza kwogera ku kizibu ekiragiddwa. • Okuddamu okuteekawo kuggyawo ebisaanyizo mu template era kisobola okuggyawo ebisaanyizo eby'enjawulo.
Okuddamu okuteekawo si kye kkubo erisooka eri obutali bwenkanya bwa buli muddu. Ebiseera by'okuzannya emizannyo ebbulako, ebifo ebyatwalibwa, n'ebintu ebikyamu tebisobola kuggibwawo ng'okozesa enkola y'okuteeka mu kifo ky'ebiwandiiko.
BWE TUTANNAba kukyusa Leka emizannyo, weeyongere okukuba kopi y'ebiwandiiko ebikwataganyizibwa n'ekizibu ekyo, era osome enkyukakyuka ze weetaaga okukola. Ebiwandiiko ebimu birina empandiika ez'omugaso; Abalala basuubira nti omuzannyo gujja kuggya fayiro ku ntandikwa y'olubereberye oba nti gujja kuba gwetaaga okuteekebwawo mu mikono.
Synix egamba nti tag ezisaanyiziddwa zibula mu kifo ky'okulowooza nti esobola okudda mu kifo kya buli mugero mu ngeri ey'obukuumi. Okukola enkyukakyuka mu template ey'obuvunaanyizibwa kisobola okukuuma kopi ey'olumu eyitibwa .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
OLUVANNYUMA lw'Okufiirwa oba Okuddaabirizibwa Weekuume fayiro yonna ey'okuziika oba ey'okuzzaawo era osome obubaka obw'okuzzaawo. Geraageranya enkola y'emu n'eyo eyakyusiddwa nga tonnasalawo ku ekyo ky'oyagala okuzzaawo. Teweerabiranga bujulizi ng'ogezaako okuzzaawo.
Oluvannyuma lw'okuwona, fuba okutandika omulundi gumu n'okebera akawandiiko k'omuzannyo. Kakasa nti asoma ekkubo eddungi era nti ebisaanyizo by'olina bikyaliwo.
