data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune ekozesa enkola ey'okuweereza ey'ebweru ng'erimu emizannyo egiri mu mikono gy'abantu era n'ekitundu eky'ekibiina ky'olutalo. Si sseriva y'omuzannyo eya bulijjo.
EBIKWALA Soma Synix's readiness checks for system memory, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, and a supported Professional-or higher Windows edition. Ebisaanyizo by'okujjukira ebintu bisinziira ku kibinja ky'olutalo ne ku mmapa z'okola.
Synix tekikkiriza virtualization oba okuteeka Hyper-V. Fuba okumaliriza ebisaanyizo by'omuzannyo nga tonnaba kutandika.
Okuteeka n'okutangira 1. Ssaawo ekiwandiiko kya Dune: Awakening n'okwetegereza ebisaanyizo byakyo n'olupapula lw'okuteekawo. 2. Weeyongere okugitandika. 3. Synix eyatandika ekikozesebwa kya battlegroup.bat eky'obuyinza ng'akozesa omulabirizi gw'ekikozesebwa. 4. Funa initial-setup mu kyuma ky'omuzannyo era weeyongere okuwa ekirabo kyo. 5. Weeyongere okutonda VM, network, n'ebibinja by'okulwanyisa mu kyuma ekyo.
Funa Token eya Self-Host okuyitira mu mukutu gwa Funcom oguyitibwa official account portal ng'okozesa enkola y'okukkirizibwa/okuteekateeka: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Teeka akabonero mu nkukutu. Okukulaakulana kw'ekikozesebwa kino tekitegeeza nti buli muddu wa Synix asaanidde okutambulira ng'omulabirizi.
ENKONDO Z'OKUKOLA N'OKUKOLA Kozesa entegeka y'ekikonde ekiriko host/VM n'ebifo ebyetaagibwa. Metadata y'ekitundu ky'ekibuuzo mu Synix ekiikirira RMQ, so si omuwuliriza w'ekibuuzo kya A2S.
Olugoye lw'omusuubuzi olusigala nga lukutte tekiraga nti ebyuma byayo eby'ekyama byalekera awo okukola. Yongera okukakasa embeera y'omuddukiro n'okukozeseza ebikolwa by'ekibinja ky'olutalo ng'okozesa obuyinza bw'okuteekawo omuzannyo.
Synix esobola okuteekawo, okukyusakyusa, okutandika, n'okuddaabiriza endagiriro y'okuteekawo eyalondeddwa. Tokitwala nti okukomekkerezebwa kw'enteekateeka, okubuuza abazannyi, oba okuzzaawo omukuumi kuyinza okufuga obuweereza obw'ebweru. Okutunda fayiro ez'okufulumya teziweereddwa ku kabonero kano.
Kozesa enkola z'okukomya n'okuziyiza ezikozesebwa mu mizannyo ku ddata za VM/database ezisigaddewo. ZIP yokka y'ekikopo ky'okuteeka mu nkola si ye ndagaano ey'obwesigika.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Omutwe guno gukozesebwa basomi n'abakola emirimu egya waggulu. Teweetaaga byuma by'okukulaakulanya okuteekawo server okuva ku fayiro eyesigamiziddwa.
Engeri Ebitonde gye Bikolebwamu Ensonga z'omuzannyo ezizimbiddwa ziraga downloads, executables, Steam AppIDs n'ebisaanyizo eby'okuyingira, okufulumya ensonga, ebifo, empisa ez'okuteekawo, ebisaanyizo ebisooka, n'obusobozi bw'omulabirizi.
Ennyinnyonnyola z'alonda empisa ezikozesebwa. Tebasobola kuddamu kukola bintu ng'ebyo mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa, oba okuteekawo ebitabo. Okuteeka fayiro ya JSON mu folda y'okukozesa eyateekebwawo tekyongera ku firimu empya ey'omuzannyo.
OKUKONJEZEGANYA oba Okuggyako EBIKWANO 1. Tandika n'obulagirizi obw'omuddugavu omwetegefu era n'ebiwandiiko by'enteekateeka ebikolebwa. 2. Kozesa amakubo agakwatagana n'omuggo gw'obubbi bw'ensimbi nga bwe kiba kyetaagisa era n'ebimanyiso ebituukira ku mizannyo. 3. Weeyongere okuteekawo empandiika ez'enjawulo mu bifo we ziteekeddwa obulungi. 4. Okukyusakyusa enkola y'okuteeka mu nkola entegeka/enkola y'okuteeka mu nkola entegeka/empaka. 5. Yogera ku bitabo, yikola ku SDK ekwetaagibwa mu pulojekiti, era okole ebigezo ebyenkanankana. 6. Gezaako okuteekawo, okutandika, okukomya, n'okuddaabiriza ng'okozesa omuzannyo ogwo nga tonnaba kutegeeza.
Definition Builder kye kimu ku by'okuzimba eby'okukulaakulanya, so si kyetaago eky'okussa mu nkola.
OMUTUNZI WA KY'OBUGANDA • UI: Ebipangu eby'enjawulo. • ServerHandler: Abafuga emizannyo n'okuteekamu ku baweereza. • SynixEngine: Obulamu bw'ebikozesebwa, obukuumi, okukola emikwano, okuddaabiriza, n'obutebenkevu. • Enkola ey'okukulaakulanya ebintu: Abalala balina okubikolerako, emisingi gyabyo, n'ebintu ebirala ebinaabayamba okukulaakulanya. • Database/GameDefinitions: Ebiwandiiko by'omuzannyo n'ebitontome. • Database/ModSystems: Emitendera gy'emirimu egiddako egiwagirwa. • Enkola y'okubeerawo: Katalogi z'omukutu n'abazimbye. • Ebigezo: Ebigezo eby'enjawulo.
Bwe kituuka ku nkyusa, weeyongere okukyusakyusa olulimi lwonna n'okusigala ng'oli mu kifo kyalwo. Weeyongere okuwandiika ebitundu ebikuyamba, obukodyo obw'okuzuula obulwadde, ekyawandiikibwa ekiraga nti omuntu asobola okubukolerako, n'ebifaananyi ebyogera ku mizannyo. Tokyusizza biragiro, amakubo, obubonero, ebisaanyizo by'omukozesa, oba ebibonero eby'okumanya ebyafulumizibwa. Ebiwandiiko eby'olubereberye tebikyusiddwa.
Soma License & Proprietary Terms nga tonnaba kusasulira koodi oba okuzimba. Weewale ebiragalalagala eby'amazima n'ennukuta ez'enjawulo ez'ebiwandiiko.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Ssaawo enteekateeka y'okuddaabiriza ya server oluvannyuma lw'okugezesa engeri gye yeeyisaamu mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, okukyusakyusa, okukomya, n'okutandika.
1. Ggula ebisaanyizo byayo eby'obutekinika/ebisaanyizo n'osobozesa ebisaanyizo. 2. Londa ennaku n'ekiseera. 3. Yamba Smart Maintenance era welonda eby'okuvuganya ebikozesebwa. 4. Tandikawo okusalawo obanga olina okulindirira abazannyi n'okuteekawo ekiseera ekisingawo. 5. Weeyongere okukebera n'okwekebera mu kiseera ky'obukuumi bw'oyinza okulabirira.
Ebiragiro bikolera ku ssaawa ya PC. Weeyongere okukakasa nti ssaawa n'ekifo kyayo bikwatagana bulungi.
BWE KY'OBA OKUTEEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKEKE Synix esobola okulinda abazannyi abakwataganyizibwa, oluvannyuma n'okutegeka okukomya ekibinja ky'enkola ekikakasibwa, okuddaabiriza nga kiyimiriddwa, okukyusakyusa, n'okuddamu okutandika okusinziira ku by'osalawo.
Obulindaala obusingawo buliko ekkomo, so si kisuubizo kya kulindirira emirembe gyonna. Okukuuma kusobola okukolebwa ng'ekiseera kyabwo kituuse, wadde ng'abazannyi basigalawo. Obudde obw'okuddaabiriza obutasobola kubaawo, tekitegeeza kiseera kya kulindirira.
AMABANYUGAMBO G'OMUBAZI GAALINA ENKONDO Okulindirira kwesigamye ku bubaka omuzannyo gw'olonda bwe gusobola okuwa. Sserva ya API ekwataganyizibwa ne Satisfactory ejjanjaba ebisaanyizo eby'edda oba ebitabeerawo mu kiseera ky'okulinda. Kino tekitegeeza nti obubaka obutali mu buwandiike bw'okusaba obwesigika.
Buulira abazannyi nga bukyali era osome obubaka bw'emirimu. Okutegeeza kwa Discord kusobola okutegeeza ebintu eby'okuddaabiriza ebikwataganyizibwa ng'enguudo zabyo zitegekeddwa.
PC erina okuba nga yeebase era n'enkola ya Synix ekwata ku nsonga eno oba omutwazi w'oludda oluwaggula alina okuba ng'agenze mu maaso. Kompyuta eyazimbibwa oba ey'ekiro tekisobola kukozesa bizinensi ez'enjawulo.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Ggula Windows Terminal oba PowerShell era kozesa akabonero ak'okuteebereza akali wansi. Amateeka gano gafuga Synix yennyini, so si buli muweereza w'omuzannyo.
KY'OYINGIRIZA winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
LOWOOZA EBIYINGIRIZWA winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
OKUVULA MU NDOGO Ggala Synix n'okumaliriza omulimu gwayo nga tonnakozesa: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
GGYE W'OTEEKA APLICATION winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Weeyongere Okuba n'Ebyokulabirako Okuteekebwawo kw'abaweereza, okukuuma, n'okubikkula byawukana ku kitambi ky'ebikozesebwa. Teweerabiranga C:\Synix oba fayiro yonna ey'obubaka bw'olina okuggyako ng'oyagala okuggyawo obubaka obwo.
OMUKONDO bw'Alemererwa Soma ensonga eyo. WinGet bw'eba ng'eyogera ku butali bwenkanya bwa hash ey'okuteekawo, weewale okubutegeeza; teweerabira bukakafu bwa hash. Enkyukakyuka ez'enjawulo ezibuze zisobola okutegeeza nti entegeka y'ebitabo terina kyafulumiziddwa.
Okukkiriza kwa WinGet n'okukwatagana kw'okufuna hash tebikakasa Synix wadde okukakasa nti programu y'ebyokwerinda ya Windows ejja kugikwesiga.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Okusookera ddala, gezaako okukakasa nti omuzannyo gukola ku mukutu gwo. Enkyukakyuka z'omutambi tezisobola kuggyawo mupiira ogutandise oba ogutuuse ku ntikko.
Funa Enkolagana Ennungi • Ku kompyuta ya server: Kozesa akakwate ak'omuzannyo akaaliwo mu kitundu oba akaaliwo mu buwumbi. • Ku kyuma ekirala eky'omu mitwe gy'awaka: Kozesa endagiriro ya LAN ey'omupiira. • Ebweru w'ennyonyi yo: Kozesa essimu yo oba engeri y'okuzuula emizannyo.
Ebikwata ku Kukubaganya Ebirowoozo by'Ekintu ky'Okutunuulira Endagiriro ya LAN ey'ekyama tetusobola kugikozesa butereevu.
KY'EKIGENDERWA mu Kifo 1. Linda omuzannyo gukomekkerezebwe. 2. Weekenneenye ekifo ekikoleddwa n'ebivudde mu Server's Readiness. 3. Weegatta okuva ku kompyuta, oluvannyuma okuva ku kyuma ekirala ekya LAN. 4. Bwe kiba nti enkola y'okubeerawo kw'emirimu gya LAN eba egobeddwa, weetegereze ekitabo ky'omuzannyo n'enkola y'okubeerawo kw'omuliro gwa Windows olw'ekizikiza eky'okuweereza.
Kkiriza Abazannyi ba Intaneeti 1. Wanga omulabirizi ennamba ya LAN ey'obuvunaanyizibwa, ng'emirundi mingi erimu enkola y'okuteeka DHCP mu nkola. 2. Yiga ebifo ebyetaagibwa n'ebiwandiiko bya TCP/UDP ebyetaagibwa mu nteekateeka y'omuzannyo. 3. Genda ku nsonga ezo zokka ku lukalu lw'omulabirizi. 4. Kkiriza emizannyo egikwatagana okuyita mu Firewall ya Windows ku biwandiiko by'empuliziganya by'okukozesa. 5. Okugezesebwa okuva ku nkolagana ya Intaneeti ey'enjawulo.
Teweerabiranga DMZ, teweerabiranga firewall, oba teweerekanga buli kabangali y'eby'obufuzi ng'ekintu ekikulu. Weeyongere okukuuma obujulizi bw'omukulembeze obw'ekyama.
Synix y'omulabirizi w'ekitebe ky'omu kitundu. Tewalimu web panel oba public relay ey'okukuuma ebisaanyizo bino eby'omu mitwe.

data.value: Scenarios ne API mods ze nkola ez'enjawulo. Scenarios zeetaaga folda yaabwe yonna n'okuteekawo okulonda; Ebifaananyi by'omutendesi si bya API eby'okuweereza.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD etereeza fayiro z'omuddugavu omwetegefu ez'emizannyo gya Steam egiwagirwa. Synix ateekateeka kopi ye eyagabanyizibwamu butereevu; enkola y'okuteekawo omuddugavu ey'enkalakkalira teyeetaaga tab eya SteamCMD ey'enjawulo.
GENDERERA OKUKOLA N'osalawo ku muddu n'osoma Activity & Diagnostics. Ekifaananyi ku dashboard kiraga nti omulimu gw'okuteeka gukolebwa. SteamCMD esobola okukyusakyusa wakati w'okuddaabiriza, okugabana, okuggulawo, n'okukakasa, n'olwekyo obuggya bwe tebuwa buli kiseera omuwendo ogutuukiridde oba ekiseera eky'obwesige ekisigadde.
Leka diski emale okukola wadde ng'okuyitira kw'empapula kukendeera. Soma obubaka obw'enkomerero bw'obuwanguzi oba obulemereddwa nga tonnaba kutandika mulimu omulala.
ENKONDO Y'Okussaawo Obudde Open Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Funa enkola ey'okukugira ekwataganyizibwa n'okuteekawo omuwendo ogukozesebwa, oba funa omuwendo gwonna ogukozesebwa.
Kino kikwata ku SteamCMD downloads, so si bandwidth y'abazannyi, buli game's non-Steam downloader, oba traffic yonna ku PC.
Okutandika n'Okulemererwa Ebiwandiiko ebimu eby'omuzannyo byetaaga akaawunti ya Steam eyakkirizibwa n'okukkiriza kwa Steam Guard. Kozesa Synix's sign-in prompt; tebassa biwandiiko bya buwandiike mu biwandiiko oba mu alipoota ez'abantu bonna.
Bw'oba ng'olina ekizibu eky'okuddaabiriza, soma ensobi ya SteamCMD era weetegereze obudde obw'oku ddisiki obwesigika, okuyingira mu ffooda, okuyingira mu kisaawe, n'ebintu byonna ebisaanyiziddwa ku akaawunti. Okukakasa kuyinza okuddamu okuggya fayiro ezikozesebwa omuteesi, bw'atyo weekuumire enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa nga tonnazikozesa.

data.name: Content.8B7975E13D85AB64E0E6
data.value: plugin_list_file eyateekebwawo (ng'eky'obuvunaanyizibwa default_plugins.txt) esalawo Plugins za AngelScript. Okuvvuunula ekyawandiikibwa tekyongera ku lunyiriri olwo; okukuuma fayiro za map/script ez'okuwagira era n'okugattibwa n'enkola ya server.

data.value: Packet zigenda mu server's Packages directory nga buli packet erimu fayiro za Server, Client ne Shared. Index.lua n'obutonde bw'omutungo bwerina okukakasa nti omutwalo guliwo; londa packet ezikkirizibwa mu nteekateeka ya server.

data.value: Windows Mods z'abaweereza ab'enjawulo zeetaaga omukutu ogukwatagana n'abaweereza Info.json, fayiro mu katabo ka Workshop akalondebwa, n'ebiwandiiko bya PackageName awamu bGlobalEnableMod mu Mods/PalModSettings.ini. -workshopdir eggyayo ekkubo era -NoMods eggyayo Mods. Omuzannyo gukwata amateeka g'okuteekawo; Synix teyeekolera ku bulagirizi obuli mu kyuma.

data.name: Content.90BE6DA54C138D083F44

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Empyrion scenarios ne server-code mods zaawukana. Mu Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, welonda Empyrion scenarios oba Empyrion server mods. Ssaamu omuddugavu n'okukuuma ekiwandiiko ekiddukanya eky'omuddugavu nga tonnakola nkyukakyuka.
YINGIRIZA SCENARIO 1. Browse Catalog evula Steam Workshop. Weeyongere okuwandiikira ekifaananyi ekyo n'olindako Steam okumaliriza okukikuba. Ebifaananyi n'ebiwandiiko eby'omu masomero tebiri mu mbeera z'abaweereza. 2. Genda ku Import Package, oluvannyuma Genda ku Folder. Londa olupapula lw'ebikopo eby'enjawulo ebiri mu katabo ko Steam mu tterekero steamapps\workshop\content\383120 folda. Osobola n'okulonda ekifaananyi ekituukiridde ekya ZIP. 3. Yingira erinnya ly'olupapula lw'obubonero olutegeerekeka. Tosaanidde kukozesa namba ya Workshop ID yokka. Weekuume erinnya eryo ery'olupapula oluliwo mu biseera eby'omu maaso. 4. Weekenneenye obuvvulu n'oludda lw'ogenda, oluvannyuma okakasize okuleetawo. Synix ekoppolola ekifaananyi kyonna mu Content\Scenarios awatali kukikyala oba okukyusa nsi yonna. 5. Londa Scenario olukalala lw'ebifaananyi ebyateekebwa. Funa emu n'okwetegereza erinnya ly'okuwonya. Okudda ku mbeera endala kyetaagisa erinnya eriggya ery'okukuuma eritalina kukozesebwa; Synix eraga nti waliwo n'ekimu era n'aleka ebikozesebwa ebikyaliwo nga bitakwatiddwa. 6. Weeyongere okukozesa ekiteeso, otandike okuweereza, era weetegereze entegeka yaayo n'enkolagana y'omugenyi. Ebimu ku bintu ebiyinza okubaawo bisobola okubaamu ebintu ebirala oba ebisaanyizo ebirala ebyawandiikibwa omuwandiisi wabyo.
Ennyiriri ye GameConfig.CustomScenario; Erinnya ly'ensi eyasumululwa ye GameConfig.GameName. Synix ekakasa dedicated.yaml nga tannaba kukyusa bifo bino n'okukuuma enkola y'omuddugaza mu kiseera kye kimu. Tekizzaawo ensigo, ebigambo eby'okukozesa, oba ebintu ebirala.
Ssaawo enkola ya SERVER Kozesa Empyrion server mods profile ne Import Package okulonda mod ZIP oba folda ya mod ey'omugaso. Gimulimu DLL ze, ebintu ebikwatagana nabyo, ebyesigamiziddwa ku byo, ne _Info.yaml bw'oba ng'ogabiddwa. Synix ebassa wansi wa Content\Mods; Omuzannyo gutandika ng'ogutandise. Enkola ey'okukoppolola koodi y'ensibuko n'okuteekawo ebikozesebwa ku bwereere teziweebwa buwagizi.
Synix teyeetaba mod loader oba okugonjoola mod ey'okulema mu butereevu. Goberera ebisaanyizo by'omuwandiisi, nga mw'otwalidde n'ebirala byonna eby'okuzitoowereramu, enkola y'okuteekawo, n'okuteekawo omusirikale. Okuyingiza obulungi tekukakasa nti mod ekwatagana n'omuzannyo ogukoleddwa oba emizannyo emirala egyateekebwawo.
EBIKULIZIBWA N'OBUYONGO Steam efulumya ekitundu kyayo eky'omu Workshop, so si ekya server ekifulumiziddwa Synix. Okusobola okukyusakyusa, leka omuddugaza akomewo n'ofulumya akapapula akaakyusakyusiddwa ng'okozesa erinnya ly'ekikopo ekimu. Weetegereze obanga omuwandiisi yeetaaga okufiirwa. Ebiwandiiko ebizze bifulumizibwa bifuna kopi ez'okuddaabiriza; okuggya enkola ey'okukyusakyusa tekitegeeza kuddamu kutuuka ku ntikko era tekuggyawo fayiro ezibuze mu kivvulu ekipya.
Okuzza obuggya ku lukalala lw'ebiwandiiko byonna mu kifo ky'okuwandiika buli kintu. Okuteekebwawo (tekukakasibwa) kitegeeza nti okuleeta kwateekebwawo, so si nti buli fayiro eyateekebwawo esobeddwa omulundi ogw'okubiri. Roll Back Import etera okuggyawo ebintu byonna ebyakolebwa, nga mw'otwalidde n'ebintu ebirala ebiri mu kivvulu kye kimu, era yagaana okuddaabiriza fayiro ezaakyusiddwa ebweru wa Synix. Ebintu ebyakolebwa mu mbeera ez'enjawulo n'ebintu ebyakolebwa mu mbeera ez'enjawulo ebyetaagibwa mu nsi eziwonyezeddwa bitukuumibwa okuggibwawo; ekiwandiiko ekikyasobola okuggibwawo ku biwandiiko ebikyaliwo.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Open Configure → Network & RCON okukebera endpoints eziwagirwa omuzannyo gw'olonda. Kozesa enkola y'omuzannyo, so si lukalala lw'ebibuga.
EBIKABWA • Ekibuga ky'omuzannyo: Emmotoka y'abazannyi. • Ekibuga ky'okukebera: Ensonga z'okuweereza oba okuzuula, bwe kiba nti enkola y'okukebera ekozesebwa. • RCON/admin port: Enkola y'obuvunaanyizibwa ey'okwesalirawo. • Port ya App/API: Omuweereza ow'okukolera awamu oba ow'okulabirira omuzannyo.
TCP ne UDP bikolwa eby'enjawulo. Enkola bbiri ez'enjawulo zisobola okukozesa ennamba y'ekitundu kye kimu, naye abaweereza babiri tebasobola kussa kimu ku nsonga z'okuwuliriza. Synix era yeetegereza ebiwandiiko ebikuumibwa ku nsonga z'obutategeeragana, nga mw'otwalidde n'ebiwandiiko ebiyimiriddwa.
Okukakasa nti endpoints ezikkirizibwa ze zikozesebwa mu mbeera ez'enjawulo era n'okukuuma enkolagana yonna eyetaagibwa omuzannyo wakati w'ebibuga. Tokitwala nti emizannyo gyonna gya UDP oba nti buli kitundu ky'ekibuuzo kikiikirira omuwuliriza ow'amazima.
OKUYINGIRIZA KUKOLA EKITONDO Abazannyi abasinga tebeetaaga kuyingira RCON oba ekifo ekirala eky'okulambula. Weeyongere okutwala obukulembeze ng'obwo, okuggyako ng'olina enteekateeka ey'okulabirira abantu okuva ewala.
Ebyokulabirako Ebikwata ku Ky'Okuzannya • Minecraft Java ne Bedrock bakozesa empisa ez'enjawulo ez'okugatta; Goberera ekitundu ky'olondawo. • Satisfactory's local API uses its configured game/API port; Omutindo gw'ekikopo ky'ekiwandiiko ekiyitibwa Synix. • Dune's query-field metadata ekiikirira RMQ yayo okutambuza port, so si Steam A2S obuweereza obw'okubuuza. • Rust+ ng'oggyeko emizannyo ekozesa endpoint ye.
Enkola ey'okuteekawo enkola y'okutandika, so si y'okuteekawo enkola y'okuteekawo enkola y'okuteekawo enkola. Weetegereze omutegeevu mu butuufu nga tonnakyusa tteeka lya firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening ekozesa enteekateeka ey'okuteekawo abaweereza ab'enjawulo. Hyper-V ne hardware virtualization erina okukolebwa, era Windows Pro oba Enterprise yeetaaga. Ku ntandikwa, Synix etandika battlegroup.bat ng'omulabirizi. Funa initial-setup era weeteekerateekera Token yo eya Self-Host. Synix esobola okuteekawo, okukyusakyusa, okuddaabiriza, n'okutandika okuteekebwawo, naye omuzannyo gulimu emmotoka ez'enjawulo n'embeera yaabwe. Akakiiko akaakulembeddwamu: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks zituma ebintu ebyakolebwa ku muddu eri ekika. Biki bye bubaka, so si Discord bot ey'okukuuma Synix.
Weeteekerateekera Ekiruubirirwa 1. Ssaawo oba funa webhook y'ennyonyi gy'oba olina obuyinza okufuga. 2. Ggula olupapula Configure → Discord olwa server eyalondeddwa. 3. Yingira mu webhook era olonde eby'okulonda ebikozesebwa. 4. Weeyongere okuteeka mu nkola. 5. Kozesa ekikolwa eky'okugezesebwa singa kiweebwayo, oba okukakasa okuleetawo mu kiseera ky'ekikemo ekitegekeddwa.
Okutandika, okukomya, okuddaabiriza, okuddaabiriza, n'okuddaabiriza obubaka bikwatagana n'enguudo ezikkiriziddwa n'okuba nti omulimu gwabaddewo ddala.
KINYONYA OW'Olupapula Lwo URL ya webhook erimu obujulizi bw'okuwandiika. Omuntu yenna bw'ayinza okugifuna asobola okusindika obubaka ku mukutu ogwo. Gwewala ebifaananyi eby'amasannyalaze, ebitundu, ebyawandiikibwa, n'empuliziganya.
Synix ekuuma webhook ye eyakuumibwa eri omukozesa wa Windows. Bw'oba ng'olunyiriri olwo luli mu Discord, lukyuse oba oluggyewo, oluvannyuma updated destination of Synix. Laba amannya g'abaweereza n'ebimu ku bintu ebibaddewo ebyasindikibwa ku mukutu gw'okuyimba.
Singa Obubaka Tebutuuka Weekenneenye ekkubo ly'omukolo eryakusaliddwa, URL, channel/webhook eriwo, n'okuba nti PC esobola okutuuka Discord. Weekenneenye ensobi eyogeddwako nga tonnafulumya URL yonna.
Okutegeeza kukwata ku nkolagana eya Discord. Tebeetaagisa kuggula ekibuga ky'okufuga eky'omuterekero.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Fuba okusalawo obanga ojja kuggyawo ekitebe ky'okufuga kyokka oba era ogggyeko n'ebidduka by'obadde otambuza. Ebintu ebyo bya njawulo.
GGYE KUKOLA APLICATION yokka 1. Okumaliriza okuteekawo, okukyusakyusa, oba okuddaabiriza ebintu byonna ebikozesebwa. 2. Yimiriza abaweereza bo okuyita mu Synix, weekuumire nga bamalirizza okukuuma, era fuba okuva mu Synix. 3. Weeyongere okubaako ebintu ebikulu by'owandiika, fayiro z'okuteekawo, n'obubaka. 4. Ggyayo Synix okuyitira mu Windows Ebiwandiiko ebyateekebwawo oba omulabirizi w'ebiwandiiko byo.
Weekuumire C:\Synix, ffoda z'abaweereza ez'enjawulo, ebikwekweto by'omuzannyo eby'ebweru, n'ebifo eby'okuddaabiriza bw'oba oyagala okubikozesa nate. Okuddamu okuteeka mu nkola tekyetaagisa kuggyawo mpapula zino.
GGANYA omuweereza omu okuyingira Kozesa ekikolwa Delete ekya server eyalondeddwa mu Synix osome okukakasa. Okuggyawo ekiwandiiko ku dashboard tekitegeeza kukkiriza kuggyako fayiro z'okuteekawo oba eby'okuziika. Kakasa ddala obubaka obujja okuggibwawo.
Tokukozesa kuggyawo ng'ekkubo ly'okuvvuunuka obuzibu. Ekiwandiiko eky'okuziyiza ekikuumibwa mu katabo k'oyagala okuggyawo si kya kufuulibwa.
Bw'oba ogenda ku kibinja ekirala eky'okufuga, gezaako okukakasa nti kisobola okutandika okuteeka mu ngeri entuufu n'okutwala ensi gy'oyagala nga tonnaggyawo fayiro yo ey'edda.

data.name: Content.B4F7813ACC4371C7ADEF
data.value:
Londa ekitundu ekiri ku kkono osome ebiragiro byayo. Ebiwandiiko byonna eby'obuyambi bikolera ku kompyuta mu lulimi lw'olondawo.
Bipya ku SYNIX? Open First Time Setup Guide mu Getting Started & Setup.
KY'OKUKOLERERA Omuddugavu? Londa ekitundu ky'omulimu ogwo, gamba ng'okuteekawo, okukola emikwano, okukuuma eby'obugagga, oba okufuga omuzannyo.
Wanoonya Ensobi? Bw'oba okozesa Ctrl+F, gezaako okunoonya ekifaananyi, omuzannyo, oba ekitundu ekimala eky'omubaka. Okunoonyereza kukakasa nti ebitundu birina omutwe n'ekyawandiikibwa kyonna era kiyamba okulaba nti ebiwandiiko ebyo bikwatagana.
Kozesa akawuntaani "Clear-search" okudda ku nsonga zonna. Download n'obuyambi obuli ku mikutu gy'ogenda okuggula mu browser yo bwokka bw'osalawo.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: ATLAS yeetaaga entegeka y'abaweereza eyafulumiziddwa n'ensibuko ya Redis erimu nga ShooterGameServer.exe tennatandika. Synix ejja kuziyiza okutandika okutuusa ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json ne ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json lwe ziriwo. Ssaawo grid ng'okozesa Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor ey'omu butongole, ofiisa fayiro zombi mu fodaali ya ShooterGame, era otandike AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat nga tonnaba kutandika server ya ATLAS. Redis erina okusigala nga libeera ku 127.0.0.1 era port 6379 erina obutakkaanya na Intaneeti.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Londa olupapula n'okukozesa ebyuma byayo ebikakasa nti olukuŋŋaana lukyaliwo. Synix y'alonda okukebera okusinziira ku kibuuzo ky'omuzannyo ekiwagiddwa, TCP/UDP/HTTP, local API, n'obusobozi bw'okukebera.
Biki Ebisobola Okutuuka ku Buwanguzi Okuddibwamu okw'omutindo omutono tekulaga nti omuzannyi asobola okukakasa n'okuyingira. Enkola ey'okubeerawo era tekiraga nti obuweereza bwe obw'okunoonyereza bukyaliwo.
Omuwendo gw'abazannyi n'amannya g'abazannyi buyinza obw'enjawulo. Sserva esobola okutegeeza abazannyi bangi nga bali ku mutimbagano awatali kwogera linnya lyabo. Olukalala lw'abazannyi abatalina kintu kye bakola si bwe kityo.
Bikozesebwa eby'okwekweka OR N/A Ebimu ku ngeri za EOS zokka oba ez'okuzannya ez'enjawulo tezitegeeza kibuuzo kyesigika ekiragiddwa oba omukulembeze w'omuzannyi. Synix esobola okulaga N/A oba okulekerawo okugezesebwa mu kifo ky'okulaga ekivudde mu kubuzaabuza.
Weetegereze eddiini eyalondeddwa n'enkola y'obukulembeze eyateekebwawo ku Minecraft. Satisfactory Omuzannyi okubalirira kwesigamye ku ky'okusalawo kwe local API connection. Temuteekawo ebisaanyizo bya EOS eby'okukulaakulanya byokka okukaka okugezesa.
SERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Emizannyo mingi gya Steam gyakozesa ebibuuzo bya A2S, naye kino si kya bulijjo. Okuwandiisa, entekateeka z'omuzannyo, n'obuweereza bw'omukubi w'ebidduka bikwata ku kutegeera, era tewabaawo kiseera kya kutegeera.
Bwe kiba nti omuweereza talina mulabirizi, gezaako okukakasa engeri y'okukwatamu omuzannyo n'okwekebera. Okukyusa ebifo eby'okukebera ebitalina kakwate emirundi n'emirundi kiyinza okuleetawo ebizibu ebirala.

data.name: Content.BB037060CAFF94F24E5C
data.value: Rust mwetegefu okutandika. Bwe kiba nti Oxide yalondebwa, Synix yateekawo ekiseera ekituufu eky'okukozesa Oxide oluvannyuma lw'ebiwandiiko bya Steam. Synix terina kukozesa, kussaawo, kukyusa, oba okwesiga plugins; Add and manage your own plugins in oxide\plugins. Oluvannyuma lw'okukyusakyusa oba okukakasa buli Rust, Synix add back the latest official Oxide runtime before the server is started.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Kozesa Configure ku bifo ebya bulijjo Synix by'afuga. Kozesa enkola ey'okuteekawo fayiro mu Server Options bw'oba olina okukebera oba okukyusa enkola y'omuzannyo.
1. Ssaabala singa asoma fayiro ng'eyatandika oba ng'egenda mu maaso. 2. Fuba okuddaabiriza n'okukakasa nti server n'ekiwandiiko byakolebwa. 3. Soma ebisaanyizo ebiriwo n'ebigambo. 4. Kola enkyukakyuka z'oba oyagadde okukola. 5. Gonjoola ensobi z'omukulembeze w'ebiwandiiko n'okwetegereza okulabula kwe. 6. Weekuumire, otandike okuweereza ng'oyita mu Synix, era weetegereze olunaku lw'omuzannyo olupya.
EBIGAMBO EBIYIGIRWA Synix etuwa obuvunaanyizibwa obw'okumanya engeri z'ebintu eziri mu INI/Ebintu, JSON, XML, YAML, n'ebifaananyi ebirala eby'enjawulo. Si buli fayiro oba enkola erimu omubuulizi. YAML editing ewagira ebisaanyizo ebifulumirirwa, olukalala olw'ebifulumiziddwa, n'omugaso gw'olugendo lumu ng'okukuuma ebigambo n'ebifulumiziddwa. YAML obubonero obuzibu ennyo gamba ng'ebikonde, ebifo eby'okuyitamu, ebifo eby'okukuŋŋaanyiza ebirimu n'ebintu eby'olukalala tebikkirizibwa.
Weeyongere okukuuma obubonero, ebisaanyizo, amannya g'empapula, n'ebiragiro ng'omuzannyo bwe gutusuubira. Temuvvuunula bikwatagana n'olulimi olwogerwa.
OKUKUMANYA Si Kigezo Fayiro eyakolebwa obulungi esobola okuba n'enteekateeka ezitali zimu. Mods oba enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa mu mizannyo zisobola okuteekawo ebintu omubuulizi by'atalaba. Weetegereze nti omuzannyo gwasituse fayiro n'ensi gye yali ayagala oluvannyuma lw'okuddamu okubitandika.
Singa omubuulizi omulala oba omuzannyo gukyusa fayiro ng'ekyali kitegekeddwa, fuba okugizzaawo n'okugigeraageranya nga tonnagikuuma. Ebiwandiiko by'omuzannyo bisobola okubaamu ebigambo ebisomeka oba obubonero; bakubaganya ebirowoozo ku bintu ebyo n'okubikubaganyaako ebirowoozo.
Satisfactory's live API options belong to its Control Center and are separate from editing its on-disk configuration files.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Genda ku Configure for an existing server, oba kozesa ekifaananyi ky'okuteekawo ng'okozesa ekifaananyi ekyo. Fuba okukyusa ebifo byokka ebikola ku mizannyo gyo.
EBIGAMBO EBIBANZA N'EBIKULU Enkola ey'okutangula essa essira ku nteekateeka ez'enjawulo n'ekiragiro ekiragibwa eky'okulonda. Enkola ey'okukulaakulana eraga obuyinza obw'enjawulo, nga mw'otwalidde RCON era n'engeri ez'okulonda. Okukyusa enkola tekuggyawo muwendo oguyimiriddwa. Okutegeeza Discord kusobola okukolebwa mu ngeri zombi.
Biki buli olupapula lw'okukebera? • Bwonna: Erinnya ly'omupiira, omuzannyo, edition/version, n'ebyokulonda ebyesigamiziddwa ku gameplay-profile. • Ebyokwerinda: Enkola ey'okufunamu ebigambo eby'ekyama n'ebintu ebirala ebikwataganyizibwa n'obubonero. • Ekizadde eky'ensi yonna: Erinnya ly'ensi yonna, ensigo, omuwendo, n'engeri eziri mu nsi yonna. • Network & RCON: Empuliziganya y'omuzannyo, okubuuza, omuyambi/API, n'ebifo eby'enkomerero eby'obufuzi. • Obukodyo: Okuddaabiriza/okukyusakyusa ku ntandikwa n'okuddaabiriza okutegekeddwa. • Discord: Ebifo eby'okutegeeza n'okuteekateeka emikolo. • Okuteeka n'Okutandika: Olupapula lw'okuteeka n'engeri ez'okutandika okutegekebwa.
Ensi eziremeddwa ezikwata ku mizannyo zikoleddwa mu bugenderevu. Omuzannyo guyinza okuba nga gwennyini oba tegulina mugaso; Okuteeka ensonga ez'enjawulo mu buyinza si kintu kya bukuumi.
EBIKONDO BINNA eby'Okufumiitiriza Ensonga z'omupiira → Ebisaanyizo ebyetaagisa → Okwekenneenya → Okukuuma omupiira
Ebintu bino bikakasa nti enkola y'okuteekateeka eriwo, so si okukulaakulana kw'okuzannya oba okuteeka. Amangu ddala nga ebisaanyizo ebyetaagisa biwedde okukakasa, Synix efuluma ekiteeso 3 osobole okukeberawo eby'osalawo, olwo n'oggyako okuggula Save Server. Okukyusa enkola y'okuteeka ebikwekweto Save again until the updated choices are shown in Review. Osaanidde okusalawo Okwewonya; okuggula Okuvvuunuka tekukoma kuwonyezebwa. Soma obubaka obuli wansi w'olupapula nga waliwo ekintu ky'oyagala okulabirirwa.
Bw'oba olina okuteekawo olupapula, ggyamu okusooka singa enkyukakyuka eyo ekola ku fayiro oba ku bikulu ebisomebwa mu kutandika. Save Changes essaawo ekiwandiiko kyayo; tekitegeeza nti omuzannyo ogutambulira gukozesezza ebisaanyizo ebyo. Yongera okutandika ku Synix ng'omuzannyo bwe gugusaba.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Open Configure → Otomatiki eri server eyalondeddwa okulonda omulimu ogukolebwa nga tegunnatandika.
Okuddamu Okutandika Yamba kino okuteekawo entegeka y'obwesimbu ey'okuweereza eyayimiriddwa nga tannatandika. Set the backup root and retention in Application Settings → Backups.
Enkola ey'okuddaabiriza egenda etandika ng'omuntu asazeewo okulekera awo okukola emirimu gyayo. Okuteekawo ebitundu eby'okuddaabiriza ebikozesebwa mu kutandika si kye kisinga okukuuma ebifo eby'okuddamu okuddaabiriza nga tebinnabaawo nkyukakyuka ez'amaanyi.
OKUYINGIRIZA OKUTANGA Yamba kino okukola okukebera okukyusibwa kw'omuzannyo oguyambibwako nga tonnatandika. Ekyongera ku fayiro z'omukuumi w'emizannyo, so si programu ya Synix.
Okukebera okukyusakyusa tekitegeeza nti buli omu atandika okulonda fayiro. SteamCMD n'omutunzi w'omuzannyo basalawo ekirina okukolebwa.
OKUKONDA N'EBIGAMBO EBIGAMBA EBIGAMBA Ekikolwa kya Validate ekikozesebwa mu ddwaaliro kisobola okuddaabiriza oba okuddamu okuggyayo fayiro ezikoleddwa omuteesi. Okukuuma enkyukakyuka nga tezinnyonnyolwa oba nga tezinnyonnyolwa; Tokitwala nti fayiro ez'enjawulo bulijjo tezitwalibwa.
Gezaako Okwesalirawo Ssaawo ebisaanyizo era otandike okutandika. Soma ebivudde mu mulimu gw'okukuba akawungeezi, okukyusakyusa, n'okutandika. Omulimu gw'okukoppolola tegukakasa nti omuzannyo guno guwezebwa bulungi.
Teekawo ekifo ekimala eky'okukozesa ebiwandiiko eby'edda, ebitabo by'oyinza okussa ku kompyuta, fayiro ez'akaseera obuseera, n'omuzannyo gw'otaddewo. Bwe kiba nti omulimu ogutandikidde kutandika gutegeeza obutali bwenkanya, weetegereze ensonga eyogeddwako mu kifo ky'okutandika okuweereza gwe gumu ng'oli ebweru wa Synix okuguvvuunuka.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Open Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg era set use g_console "1". Tandikawo omuzannyo gwa American Truck Simulator ogw'akabonero, loda enkola yo n'ekabi lyo, kkiriza ~ okuggula ekiteeso, era otambule export_server_packages. Ggalawo omuzannyo, oluvannyuma kkulira ku Start mu Synix nate. Synix ejja kuggya fayiro ezikoleddwa mu butereevu.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Open Ready for the selected server before its first start or when something fails. Omuddugavu gw'otaddewo ng'anaatera okutandika oba ng'ekintu ekimu tekinnaggwaawo. Ekikuŋŋaanya obujulizi obwesigamiziddwa ku kabonero ako, gamba ng'ebiwandiiko, ebiro by'okutambuliramu, entegeka, ekifo ku diski, ebibuga, embeera y'enteekateeka, n'ennukuta ezikwata.
FUMIRA EKIKUVA mu Kwo • Okweteekerateekera: Tewaaliwo nsonga yonna ey'okuziyiza okuzuulibwa mu bujjanjabi obuliwo. • Okwekenneenya: Soma ebyazuuliddwa era osalewo obanga waliwo ky'osaanidde okukola. • Okuziyizibwa: Gonjoola ekizibu ky'otaddewo nga tonnagenda mu maaso.
Obwetegefu tebwesigamiziddwa ku kukola buli mulimu gw'okuddaabiriza ogukolebwa. Weekenneenye ekikolwa ekiteekeddwawo n'okukakasibwa.
Oluvannyuma lw'Okusonyiwa Olupapula Oluggya Ekisooka kisobola okussa fayiro ku kompyuta, okuteekawo ekiseera eky'okutambuliramu ekikwataganyizibwa, okuteekawo enkola, n'okulinda omuzannyo gutandike. Goberera obulagirizi bw'okusooka okutandika n'Ebikolwa n'Okugonjoola mu kifo ky'okutunuulira ekiwandiiko ekiriko ku dashboard ng'omuzannyo oguteekeddwawo.
Emizannyo emirala gyetaaga okukkiriziganya, obutuufu, oba okuteekawo ebisaanyizo mu muzannyo ng'omuntu yenna tannaba kuyingira. Weeyongere okukola ekiteeso ekyo mu kifo omuzannyo kye gwagala.
EKY'OKUKIRIZA OKUKOLERANYA Okuteekawo, Okutandika, Okukomya, n'Okulabirira ebivudde mu kuteekawo ebikolwa Synix bye yalaba. Tekukakasibwa kyokka kitegeeza nti tewali kivudde mu kutegeeza; tekitegeeza nti omuzannyo gumanyiddwa nga gusobeddwa.
Ekivudde mu kuteekateeka oba okukakasibwa okw'omu kitundu tekitegeeza nti osobola okufuna entambula ku Intaneeti, okukyusakyusa obulungi, oba okukwatagana n'omugenzi yenna. Okumaliriza ng'okebera ensi n'enkolagana.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Ekiwandiiko ky'obwesimbu eky'omuddugavu ekiragiddwa kikuuma fayiro mu folda y'okuteeka ku muddugavu oyo. Weetegereze engeri omuzannyo gye gukuumamu ensi yaagwo nga tonnesigama ku yo.
Funa Enkolagana ey'Oku Lusegere 1. Yimiriza omuweereza okuyita mu Synix n'olinda ebikolwa bye bifulume. 2. Londa ekikolwa eky'okuddaabiriza mu Server Options. 3. Weekenneenye ensibuko, ekiruubirirwa, omuwendo ogugeraageranyiziddwa, n'ekifo eky'okukozesa ku diski. 4. Kirage era olindirire okumaliriza. 5. Londa Open Backup Folder okusanga ebiwandiiko. Weeyongere okukwata akasiimo ke.
EBIKWALA Ekiwandiiko ky'obwesige kirimu olupapula lw'okuteeka, so si olupapula lw'okukuuma obutono. Emizannyo eminene giyinza okwetaagisa ebiseera bingi n'eby'okusula.
Ebikwekweto mu AppData, Documents, drive endala, oba kompyuta ey'omuzannyo eyinza okubeera ebweru w'olupapula olwo. Weeyongere okubikozesa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo ng'okozesa enkola y'omuzannyo.
EKIRAMBO N'EKITUNDU Ensibuko y'omuggo gwa C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups ekikuyamba okulonda omuggo omulala n'okussawo ekkomo ly'okukuuma.
Ekigendererwa kirina okubeera ebweru w'olupapula lw'omuddugaza omusingi. Okukyusa omuzira gw'obwesige tekuggyawo oba okukomya ebiwandiiko ebiriwo; Weekenneenye ekifo eky'edda okusobola okufuna ebitabo eby'edda.
Okukuuma kuggyawo ebiwandiiko eby'edda ng'omutindo oguteekebwawo guwedde mu kiseera ky'okuteekawo ekitundu eky'oludda oluvanyuma. Weeyongere okukuuma ebifo eby'okuddaabiriza ebisigadde ebweru w'ekifo ekyo.
Weekuumire kopi endala ey'ensi enkulu mu kifo ekyawukana. Diski eyalemererwa esobola okusaanyaawo omuddugavu n'ebiwandiiko ebikuumibwa ku diski y'emu. ZIP y'olupapula lw'okukozesa olw'ebweru si y'ekikozesebwa ekikwatagana ne VM oba database.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Soma obubaka obutuufu bwa Windows nga tonnaba kusalawo ky'olina okukyusa. Ekiwandiiko ekikugiddwa, ensobi ey'okufuna fayiro, n'ekiseera ky'omuzannyo ekibulako ebizibu bya njawulo.
SYNIX Tejja Kuteekebwa oba Okuggulwa Kozesa ekitabo ekivvuunuddwa mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka oba ekitundu ekituufu ekya WinGet ubidzz.Synix. Bw'oba oyimiridde mu fayiro ogugamba nti eddembe ly'okufuna fayiro ligaaniddwa, ggalawo ekitundu kya Synix ng'okozesa ekkubo eryo era gezaako nate. Weetegereze fayiro y'okufunamu obubaka n'obubaka bwa programu ey'ebyokwerinda singa ekizibu kigenda mu maaso.
Teweerabiranga fayiro z'omuddo oba teweerabiranga bukuumi ng'omulimu gw'okuddaabiriza.
OLUBAKA OLUTAMBA Okulabula okw'ekitiibwa kisobola okuwa Ebirala by'okumanya → Genda mu ngeri yonna, okusinziira ku mateeka ga Windows. Okubeerawo kw'ekintu ng'ekyo tekukakasa nti fayiro nnungi. Weekenneenye ensibuko y'obuyinza era weetegereze okulabula okwo nga tonnasalawo kugenda mu maaso.
OKUKONJOLOLA APP ya SMART Kino kisobola okulemesa programu Windows bw'atasobola kuteekawo obwesige obumala. Tekirina bypass ya muntu yenna ey'okukoppolola ne SmartScreen's Run. Teweerabira Windows ebikozesebwa mu by'obukuumi okuggyako okufulumya Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Fuba okunoonyereza ku ngeri y'okuzuula n'okukuba ebiwandiiko. Tokitwala nti okulabula kwa bulimba kubanga fayiro erina erinnya Synix. SHA-256 hash ekwatagana n'ekyo ekiraga fayiro eyaggibwawo; tekitegeka kwesigama oba okuteeka omukono ku kiwandiiko.
Yogera ku ngeri y'okulabula n'okuteekawo ng'ebigambo eby'ekyama biggiddwawo. Weewale okuggyako ebintu eby'omugaso oba okweggyako okukebera kwa hash ey'okuteekawo.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Kozesa Settings → Backups okuggya Synix mu bujjuvu. Kino kyawukana ku kwewandiisa olupapula lw'abaweereza oluliwo.
LOWOOZA EKINAAKYENKANYA Ensigo z'ekika kya C:\Synix. Sserva ez'enjawulo oba entegeka ez'oku dduka eziri ebweru we ne z'emizannyo ez'ebweru zeetaaga okukwatibwako mu ngeri ey'enjawulo. Bawandiike amakubo gaabwe nga tebannatandika. Ebisaanyizo Windows ebisanvu nabyo biyinza okwetaagibwa okwekebera ku kifo ky'okugenda.
EKY'OKUTUNDIRA 1. Tandika kuweereza n'okumalirawo, okulonda, n'okuziika. 2. Funa encrypted oba normal export. 3. Londa ekifo ky'ogenda okubeeramu ebweru w'omuti gw'olunyiriri n'okwetegereza obunene n'ebisaanyizo by'ekifo eky'ekiseera. 4. Bw'oba oyagala okuggyayo ebintu ebikoleddwa mu ngeri ey'akabonero, weeyongere okulonda ekigambo ky'okuyingiza eky'amaanyi. 5. Linda .synixbackup package okumaliriza, oluvannyuma okukakasa.
LWALIRA Okukuuma okw'Ekituufu Okutunda okuteekebwawo kukuuma akapakiiti n'okuwagira okuggyawo obujulizi obwesigamiziddwa ku akaawunti ya Windows ey'okugenda.
Okutunda mu nsi ezitali zimu tekubikkuliddwa. Ebiwandiiko by'omuzannyo n'ebiwandiiko ebirimu bisobola okutegeeza ebintu eby'ekyama. Okuvvuunula emitindo egiri mu Windows tekitegeeza nti gisobola kukozesebwa ku akaawunti endala.
ENDIGA 1. Okusookera ddala genda ku Synix. 2. Ggula obuyinza obw'okutangira ebitundu eby'okufulumya/okukebera n'olonda ekivvulu ekigendereddwako. 3. Bw'oba oyagadde, gamba ebigambo eby'ekizingirwawo n'okukuba akawunti. 4. Weekenneenye ekifo w'ogenda, ebisaanyizo ebiri ku diski, n'okuwandiika ku kulabula. 5. Leka okutendekebwa, okukakasibwa, n'okuvvuunuka bikome. 6. Fuba okukebera amakubo g'obuwagizi, ebibuga, embalirira, ebifo eby'okukuuma, n'obumanyirivu nga tonnaba kutandika kintu kyonna.
Yongera okukwataganya Satisfactory singa obumanyirivu bwayo obw'omu kitundu oba enkolagana ey'obukuumi tezikwatagana. Weekuumire ekitundu eky'olubereberye n'obubaka obupya okutuusa ng'abaweereza abafulumiziddwa bagezeseddwa.
Enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa mu by'enkola z'eby'enkola ziyinza okukuuma kopi y'enkyukakyuka ezikoleddwa nga tezinnabaawo. Singa okufulumya oba okusengukira kubulaba, bumba kopi eyo n'obubaka obw'okuzzaawo mu kifo ky'okukyusa ekitebe ky'eby'okukozesa nga Synix ekola.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch erimu olupapula lw'omuddugavu olwasonnyiddwa n'engeri ze z'osobola okutambuzaamu. Kwata ekiragiro ekiragiddwa okuggyako ng'otegeera ebigambo by'omuzannyo.
EKY'OKUTEEKA EBIKWANO Kozesa enkola ey'okukulaakulana bwe kiba kyetaagisa ensonga ezisooka. Weekenneenye ebivvuunulwa, amakubo ag'okukozesa, n'amannya g'eby'okulonda. Synix kale ebawa ensonga ezikozesebwa; Okuteeka kopi endala kiyinza okuleetawo enjawulo.
Temuvvuunula bitambi oba okudda mu kifo ky'ekintu ekiteeberezebwa eky'omuganyulo n'ekifaananyi kye. Teweeyongere ku kiragiro ekimu ng'oyagala okukikoppolola.
AMAFIRIMI G'Okutandika Okutunda mu Buwambe Ku biwandiiko ebikwataganyizibwa, Server Options → Create Batch File yandika ekiragiro ekyesigamiziddwa ku kutandika mu script.
Ekiwandiiko ekyo kiyinza okubaamu ebigambo eby'okukozesa ebisobola okusomebwa oba obubonero bw'obuweereza okusobola okukikozesa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo. Kwekkaanya n'okukebera nga tonnagisasaanya.
Okutambulira mu script ebweru wa Synix tekitegeeza nti Synix erina okuteekebwa mu nkola yonna, okutegekebwa kw'omukuumi, okuddaabirizibwa, oba okulabirirwa. Tokitambuza nga Synix ekiddukiro ekyo kikyali mu nkola.
EBIWALA eby'ebweru Ebiwandiiko ebimu eby'omuzannyo bitandika okukozesa ebikozesebwa byabwe mu kifo ky'okukolera ku nkola emu ey'okuweereza. Ebikozesebwa ebyo biyinza okwetaagisa okuwandiisa enzikiriza ey'enjawulo era tebisobola kuyamba kutunda fayiro z'okutandika. Goberera ekiragiro ky'omuzannyo mu kifo ky'okuteeka mu kifo ky'ekimu eky'okuzannya oba eky'okuzingiramu.

data.name: Content.E795D683EF9E7EA6D310
data.value: Kozesa ekitundu eky'okuweereza ekiweereddwa ekya loader ya AlienX. Plugins zigenda mu ModLoader / Plugins directory okumpi ne server binary era zeetaaga enkola z'omukutu ezituukagana n'obutonde obuvuddemu. Enkyusa ya kasitoma ya njawulo.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Kozesa ekiwandiiko ekiragiddwa. Kitwaliramu .NET runtime ze Synix yeetaaga; abaweereza b'emizannyo bayinza okuba nga bakyalina ebisaanyizo byabwe.
LWALA ENKONDO y'Okussaamu • MSI: Download SynixSetup.msi, gukaabye, oluvannyuma oggule Synix Control Panel okuva mu Start menu. Ekifo ekisanja eky'okukozesa buli mukozesa kye %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Kozesa ekibboozi kyennyini.Synix. Ekitundu WinGet Okuteeka n'Okuzuula kirimu ebiragiro. • Enkola ey'okufulumya: Weeteeka enkola ey'okufulumya ey'okufulumya mu katabi akayinza okuwandiikibwa, era weeyongere okukikolamu. Okufulumya ekiwandiiko ekyo tekitegeeza kuggyawo sseriva zo zonna.
Ebivvuunulwa ebikozesebwa ku mukutu guno: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
OKUKOLA EBIKOLWA 1. Okumaliriza okuvvuunula, okukuuma ebitabo, n'okuddaabiriza. 2. Yimiriza abaweereza bo b'omuzannyo okuyita mu Synix era gumalako Synix mu ngeri entuufu. 3. Kozesa enkola ey'okukyusakyusa oba ey'okuteekawo ku ngeri gy'otaddewo. 4. Yongera okuggula Synix n'okukebera oba nti entambula z'omuddugavu zo n'amakubo byo bituufu.
Bw'oba oyingiza EXE ey'edda mu kifo ky'eya MSI, sooka oggyemu enkola ey'edda. Weekuumire obubaka bwa server n'amafooda ag'omupiira agategekeddwa. Teweerabiranga C:\Synix okukyusakyusa programu.
Enkola ey'okukyusakyusa tekyusakyusa mizannyo gy'obadde osembeza. Kozesa ekikolwa kya Update ekya server eyalondeddwa okukola ekyo.
Bwe kiba nti Windows egamba nti okuyingira kwagaaniddwa ng'ogenda okukyusa ekiteekebwawo, gezaako okulaba nti kopi egenda okukyusibwa tekyaddayo mu maaso. Teweerabiranga programu eba etambula oba okweggyamu data ya server okukendeeza ku nsobi.

3. Ekiwandiiko Ekiragiddwa: https://hellletloose.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_Hosting

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix efuba okukebera omutindo gw'ebyuma nga tegunnatandika kutandika okukendeeza ku buzibu bw'okweraliikirira omulabirizi. Bwe kiba nti okutandika kukyusiddwa oba okuziyizibwa, soma ekibuuzo ekikwata ku nsibuko.
Weeyongere Okubeeranga mu Kifo eky'Okusanyukiramu Leka okujjukira kwa Windows n'ebiwandiiko eby'oludda oluvuganya awamu n'omuzannyo. Weekuumire ekifo ku diski osobole okufuna ebikyusiddwa, fayiro ez'akaseera obuseera, ebintu by'oyinza okukuuma, n'ebintu ebirala.
Omutindo gw'okujjukira Minecraft ogukoleddwa gukwata ku biseera bye eby'okuzannya. Si kikomo kya nsi yonna eri buli kikolebwa buli lugoye.
Okukebera eby'obugagga tekitegeeza nti omuweereza asuuliddwa mu kasanduuko ka CPU/RAM oba nti Windows tasobola kumala kufuna by'obugagga. Kozesa omulabirizi w'eby'obugagga n'ebivvuunulwa ku dashboard ya PC yonna okutegeera omutwalo gwabyo.
ABALUNDI B'Omukuumi Enkola ey'okulangirira ku mitwe egirabika obulungi yeetegereza embeera ezitali zisanvu ez'obugazi/ez'eby'obugazi era n'ebikwata ku mulimu ogumanyiddwa ogwa SteamCMD okukendeeza ku kulabula okw'obulimba.
Si kya Firewall, si kya traffic filter, oba si kya DDoS. Ekiwandiiko ky'obwegendereza tekitegeeza nti wabaddewo omulumba oba nti wabaddewo okulumba.
Bw'oba olowoozezza ku kino, geraageranya ebintu by'okozesa n'ebyo by'okozesa. Buulira ebiwandiiko ebikwataganyizibwa nga tonnakyusa mpisa z'ebyokwerinda oba ez'amasannyalaze.

data.name: Content.F797B7FAAA8293240799
data.value:
EKY'OBUGANYA KIKULU KY'EKYetaagisa:
1. Yiga 'server-settings.json' okuteekawo obujulizi bw'obuweereza bwa Factorio obwa ofiisi era n'ekintu eky'okukozesa ekinaakozesebwa mu kiseera ky'obutonde.
2. Ekiwandiiko ky'Obuyinza: https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Salawo Profiili ya Rust n'okwetegereza ensi ye, obumanyirivu bwe, entambula ye, ebibuuzo bye, n'ebisaanyizo byayo nga tonnaba kutandika.
OKUKOLA KWA SERVER Synix efulumya omuwendo gwa +server.identity oguyambibwako okuva ku butonde bw'omuddugavu. Okukuuma ebikozesebwa eby'enjawulo n'obwenkanankana obw'ebitundu eby'enjawulo basobole obutasobola kugabana nsi oba enkola.
RUST+ Ssaawo App Port ey'enjawulo eyesigamiziddwa ku buweereza obw'omugenzi, oluvannyuma ogoberere Rust's pairing and network requirements. Endpoint yayo yeyawukana ku gameplay y'omuzannyi ne RCON administration ey'okwesalirawo.
Weekenneenye ebibuga ebikwatiddwa mu kifo ky'okukopya etteeka okuva ku muddubuzi omulala wa Rust. Okukuuma ebisaanyizo bya RCON n'obutabifulumya okuyamba abantu okwegatta.
VANILLA AND OXIDE Vanilla akozesa fayiro z'abaweereza. Okulonda Oxide kweyongerayo enkola y'obuyinza eyesigamiziddwa oluvannyuma lw'ebiwandiiko bya Steam. Enkola y'okuteeka endagiriro teyeeyongedde ku kulonda oba okukebera buli plug-in.
Kozesa Mod & Plugin Manager's local workflow eyesigamiziddwa ku kabonero ka Oxide/uMod akazuulibwa. Plugins zikyagenda mu maaso nga zeetaaga enkyusa ezituukagana n'ensulo ez'obwesige.
Synix addamu okukwata obudde bwa Oxide obuweereddwa oluvannyuma lwa Rust okukyusibwa oba okukakasibwa ng'omutendera ogwo gutondebwa. Okusobola okudda ku fayiro za Vanilla ez'obuyinza, nkyusa ekiteeso ky'olupapula n'otambuza enkola ey'okukyusakyusa oba ey'okukakasa.
Nga tonnakola nkyukakyuka mu nteekateeka oba mu mizannyo, bumba ensi, enkola y'ebintu, n'enkola ya Plugin. Okukebera obubonero bw'omuzannyo n'obw'Oxide oluvannyuma lw'okuddamu okutandika; okuggulawo ekiteeso tekiraga nti buli plugin eyatwalibwa mu ngeri entuufu.

data.name: Content.F89E75BB7B8DECBE4C2B
data.value: ServerModSetup ebiwandiiko mu dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua download Workshop mods; modoverrides.lua ebasobozesa n'ebyokulonda byabwe ku nsi/shard. Kozesa enkola y'okuteeka ku server n'entambula eziri mu cluster. Mods z'omugenyi zokka ze zaawukana; okukuuma eby'okuziyiza ebibiina nga tonnakyusa server mods.

data.name: Content.F94C68FF92382707E0C1
data.value: Enkola y'okuteekawo entegeka ya Nuclei ey'omupiira ogwetegekeddwa ekozesa omutwalo gwa mod ogwesigamiziddwa ku mizannyo. Okukakasa loader, plugin version n'ebiragiro by'okutandika okuweereza; Mods z'omugenyi ez'enjawulo si bukakafu obumala.

data.name: Content.F98EB917B82734969B03
data.value: Synix efuga olukalala lw'ekika ky'ekikonde ekirongooseddwa; ARK eggyayo era n'eggyayo ebintu bya CurseForge ng'obuweereza butandise.

data.name: Content.FAB3F6D90467A47EBA5C
data.value: Kyetaagisa entegeka ya Metamod:Source ne SourceMod ezituukagana ku kivvulu kino. .smx plugins zigenda mu doi/addons/sourcemod/plugins; Enkyusa, gamedata n'ebiwandiiko ebikwatagana nabyo bibeera mu buwandiike bwabyo.

data.name: Content.FBD81544AC3A1FEB96C9
data.value:
EKY'OBUGANYA KIKULU KY'EKYetaagisa:
1. Genda ku muddubuzi omulundi gumu okuzimba 'GameUserSettings.ini', oluvannyuma oggyemu.
2. Yiga enkola ya INI ey'okukungula n'okufuga abafuzi.
3. Ekiwandiiko Ekiragiddwa: https://darkandlight.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Weekenneenye amateeka ga layisensi nga tonnakkiriza ntandikwa ya server esooka.

data.name: Content.FC8AD725F17E1C50CF67
data.value: Sserva erimu PCServer-AFFGame.ini. Synix ekuuma fayiro yonna eyateekebwawo n'okuzuula ebiwandiiko by'erinnya ly'omuddugavu, omulabirizi-ekigambo ky'ekizingirizi, n'ebiwandiiko eby'ekifo ky'omuzannyi byokka.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: ATLAS ye server ey'ebibiina era tasobola kukola fayiro zino ng'atandika server. Kozesa Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor okussaawo n'okuggyawo grid. Kopya ServerGrid.json ne ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json mu firimu ya ShooterGame ey'omuweereza. Nga tonnatandika ATLAS, genda AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat n'oleka Redis okutambula. Kwata Redis ku 127.0.0.1; teweerekereza port 6379 ku LAN, router, oba Internet. Omuwandiisi w'ekitongole: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor

data.name: Content.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Weekenneenye engeri Synix gy'ezimba ekiragiro ekikozesebwa okutandika okuweereza kuno.

data.name: Content.FF6EEAB0A9848FC8CD5C
data.value: Synix ekola entegeka ya serverconfig.xml ey'okuweereza era efulumya erinnya ly'omupiira, ekigambo ky'ekizingirwa, ekibuga, ekkomo ly'omuzannyi, ensi, ensigo, n'obukulu bw'ensi. Ebintu ebirala eby'omuzannyo bibeera bikyasobola okutegekebwa mu mpereza ya configuration.

data.name: Language.Description
data.value: Londa olulimi lw'okozesa Synix. Ebiragiro by'omuzannyo n'obubonero obuterekeddwa tebivvuunulwa.

data.name: Uninstall.AppOnly
data.value: Ggyamu app yokka (kuuma servers ne data)

data.name: Uninstall.Everything
data.value: Ggyamu app, servers eziddukanyizibwa ne data ya Synix

data.name: Uninstall.Keep
data.value: Ggyawo Synix enkola y'ebikozesebwa, cache, fayiro ez'akaseera obuseera n'ebiwandiiko by'okutandika. Kuuma C:\Synix yonna, servers z'emizannyo, ebiwandiiko eby'okuddaabiriza n'okuzzaawo fayiro. Kuumira olukalala lw'abaserver n'okuteeka mu SynixData\servers.json. Kozesa olukalala olwo oluterekeddwa n'okuteeka okwo nga Synix ezzeemu okussibwawo.

data.name: Uninstall.Review
data.value: Kebera fayiro n'empapula eziri wansi nga tonnaziggyako. Ebifo ebirondeddwa okukuumibwa tebijja kuggibwawo. Okuggibwawo kwa lubeerera. Singa enkola eremererwa okuggyawo oluvannyuma, fayiro zino zijja kuggyibwawo.

data.name: Uninstall.Confirm
data.value: Nnina byonna bye nneetaaga. Njagala okuggyawo fayiro zino emirembe gyonna.

data.name: Uninstall.Stop
data.value: Ggala Synix n'okuyimiriza serveri zonna ez'omuzannyo nga tonnaggyako biwandiiko bya serveri.

data.name: Uninstall.Changed
data.value: Ebiwandiiko by'abakozi byaakyuka. Yongera okwekebera mu buwandiike nga tonnaggyawo kintu kyonna.

data.name: Uninstall.Failed
data.value: Okuggyamu kukomekkerezebwa. Empapula ezimu ziyinza okuba nga zimaze okuggibwawo. Synix ekyassibwawo. Weekenneenye fayiro ezisigaddewo nga tonnagezaako nate.

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsOption
data.value: Era ggyako ebiwandiiko bya serveri eby'okuddaabiriza n'okuzzaawo fayiro

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsDelete
data.value: Backups ne fayiro ez'okuzzaawo ezirondeddwa okusibwa:

data.name: Uninstall.NoBackups
data.value: Tewaaliwo biwandiiko bya ndagaano mu biwandiiko bya Synix ebimanyiddwa.

data.name: Uninstall.KeptLocations
data.value: Ebifo ebyekuumibwa (okusazeeko ebikozesebwa eby'okuziyiza ebyalondeddwa waggulu):

data.name: Uninstall.CloseApp
data.value: Ggala Synix nga tonnaba kugiggyamu. Singa enkola eggyibwawo, seva z'omuzannyo zisobola okweyongera okutambula.

data.name: History.Unavailable
data.value: Ebyafaayo tebyasobola kusomebwa wadde okukuumibwa. Fuba okukebera fayiro n'ekifo ku diski.

data.name: History.Recovered
data.value: Ebiwandiiko ebimu eby'ebyafaayo ebitaasobola kusomebwa byaggibwawo.

data.name: History.Retention
data.value: Bikwekeddwa wakati w'emirimu gya Synix. Okutuukira ddala ku {0} ebiwandiiko ebikyasembayo buli server. Enkola ey'okukozesa n'ekiragiro eky'okutangula bikyaliwo.

data.name: History.Details
data.value: Ebimu ku bintu eby'omugaso (olonda ekitundu ky'oyinza okukoppolola)

data.name: BackupHealth.Notice
data.value: Okusinziira ku fayiro n'ebiwandiiko, so si okukebera obugolokofu. Backups ez'edda okusinga 7 ez'ennaku zikubiddwa.

data.name: History.Empty
data.value: Tewabaddewo mulimu gwonna oguteekebwawo ku mudduula ono.

data.name: History.NoMatches
data.value: Tewali kintu kyonna ekikwatagana n'ebyuma byo.

data.name: Appearance.Description
data.value: Salawo ekiruubirirwa, langi ey'ekitiibwa n'engeri gy'oyinza okukikolamu. Enkyukakyuka zitandika okukola amangu ddala era zifulumizibwa mu butanwa.

data.name: Settings.Privacy.ActivityCount.Description
data.value: Ekisaanyizo: ntuma koodi y'omukolo ku synix.info buli 10 eddakiika nga Synix ekola, nga mw'otwalidde ne mu nsibuko. Tewaabaddewo bitonde bya server. Ebisaanyizo biwedde oluvannyuma lwa 15 mins. Ng'eky'obuvunaanyizibwa. Osobola okukikomya wano.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Gatta kompyuta eno ku akaawunti yo okulaba, okutandika, okuyimiriza, okuddamu okutandika n'okuddaabiriza seva okuva ku kibanja kya Synix. Okubeerawo okuva ewala kulemeseddwa okutuusa ng'okkirizza okukwatagana kuno.

data.name: RemoteManager.Heading
data.value: Funa kompyuta eno ku mukutu gwa Synix

data.name: RemoteManager.ComputerName
data.value: Erinnya lya kompyuta eryolesebwa ku mukutu gwa Intaneeti

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Yingira ku kibanja ky'omukutu n'oyingiza code eno. Kkiriza erinnya lyo ly'omukozesa lyokka wano.
Kuuma Synix ng'eyanjuluzibwa oba nga yakendeezebwako. Enkolagana ey'ekyama ewuliriza okuyingira. Ebikwata ku seva bifulumizibwa buli ddakiika 10 ng'olabibwa. Okuggyamu obufumbo kikugira okuyingira okw'ewala awatali kuyimiriza seva.

data.name: RemoteManager.CodeExpired
data.value: Kkoodi yaakamala. Yiga koodi empya ey'okukwataganya.

data.name: RemoteManager.ClaimFormat
data.value: Obukuumi bw'okusaba akaawunti: {0} Okukkiriza okuggyako nga lino lye linnya lyo.

data.name: RemoteManager.CheckFailed
data.value: Tebasobodde kukakasa nti bagattibwa. Fuba okulaba ku nkolagana yo ne Internet.

data.name: RemoteManager.Unavailable
data.value: Teyasobola kwogera na maneja wa Synix. Nkwegayiridde gezaako nate.

data.name: RemoteManager.IdentitySoftware
data.value: Enkola y'okukozesa kompyuta: Windows-ekikuumibwa software key (TPM teririiko)

data.name: RemoteManager.RemovalPending
data.value: Baaggyiddwa mu kitundu. Gezaako okuddamu okuggyawo ng'okwatiddwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.LoadFailed
data.value: Okukwataganya tekyasobola kuzimbibwa. Enkola y'okutuuka ewala yalema.

data.name: RemoteManager.WaitingApproval
data.value: Okukkiriza okw'okuteekamu abantu mu kifo kyetaagisa.

data.name: RemoteManager.SaveFailed
data.value: Enkola ey'okutuuka ewala yalema. Ebisaanyizo eby'okugatta tebyasobola kukyusibwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.PairingRemoved
data.value: Okugatta ku siteegi kiggiddwawo. Enkola y'okutuuka ewala yalema.

data.name: RemoteManager.InvalidSettings
data.value: Enkola y'okuteeka omukono ku kyuma ekitaliimu.

data.name: RemoteManager.InvalidResponse
data.value: Omulabirizi wa Synix yaddamu ekibuuzo ekitali kya bwenkanya.

data.name: RemoteManager.FinishUnpair
data.value: Yongera okukwataganya ne Intaneeti n'okusooka ggyako okuggyawo obufumbo obwasooka.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Tondawo ekigambo eky'obuggya eky'ekiseera wano. Kozesa ekigambo kino ne 2FA yo eyaliwo oba passkey okuyingira ku kibanja. Kale osalewo ekigambo ekiggya. Singa akaawunti yo yeetaaga enkola zombi, weetaaga enkola zombi. Ekigambo eky'ekiseera kisobola okukozesebwa omulundi gumu gwokka. Kiggwaawo oluvannyuma lw'eddakiika 10. Ekigambo kyo eky'entandikwa kikyaliwo okutuusa ng'okuwona kuwedde.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryExpired
data.value: Okusasula kuwedde oba kuggiddwawo. Yongera okutandika.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryLimited
data.value: Okusaba kungi nnyo. Gezaako nate oluvannyuma.

data.name: Help.LicenseMissing
data.value: License ya Synix eyateekebwa mu kasanduuko kaakubuze.

data.name: Status.Activity.ReconnectedByPath
data.value: [SYNIX] Yakwatagana nate ku ssimu "{0}" esangibwa mu fayiro yaayo ey'okuteekawo (PID: {1}).

data.name: Settings.Backup.Transfer.RemoteAccessNotice
data.value: Okugatta ku ekyo, okuteeka omukono ku bantu ab'enjawulo tekujja kusindikibwa. Bw'oba okozesa entambula ey'oku wala, gattika kompyuta empya ku akaawunti yo ku manager.synix.info oluvannyuma lw'okuddaabiriza Synix.
